12.d: दृ॑शा॒नो रु॒क्म उ॒र्व्या व्य॑द्यौद्दु॒र्मर्ष॒मायुः॑ श्रि॒ये रु॑चा॒नः । अ॒ग्निर॒मृतो॑ अभव॒द्वयो॑भि॒र्यदे॑नं द्यौर्ज॒नय॑त्सु॒रेताः॑ ।।
12.e:
FAR hath he shone abroad like gold to look on, beaming
 imperishable life for glory.
 Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific
 Father Dyaus begat him.

12.d: नक्तो॒षासा॒ सम॑नसा॒ विरू॑पे धा॒पये॑ते॒ शिशु॒मेकँ॑ समी॒ची । द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ रु॒क्मो अ॒न्तर्वि भा॑ति दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाः ।।
12.e:
Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, meeting
 together, suckle one same infant.
 Golden between the heaven and earth he shineth. The
 wealth-possessing Gods supported Agni.

12.d: विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ प्रति॑ मुञ्चते क॒विः प्रासा॑वीद्भ॒द्रं द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे । वि नाक॑मख्यत्सवि॒ता वरे॒ण्यो नु॑ प्र॒याण॑मु॒षसो॒ वि रा॑जति ।।
12.e:
The Sapient One arrays himself in every form: for quadruped
 and biped he hath brought forth good.
 Excellent Savitar hath looked on heaven's high vault: he
 shineth after the outgoings of the Dawn.

12.d: सु॑प॒र्णो॑ सि ग॒रुत्माँ॑स्त्रि॒वृत्ते॒ शिरो॑ गाय॒त्रं चक्षु॑र्बृहद्रथन्त॒रे पक्षौ । स्तोम॑ आ॒त्मा छन्दाँ॒स्यङ्गा॑नि॒ यजूँ॑षि॒ नाम॑ । साम॑ ते त॒नूर्वा॑मदे॒व्यं य॑ज्ञाय॒ज्ञियं॒ पुच्छं॒ धिष्ण्याः॑ श॒पाः । सु॑प॒र्णो॑ सि ग॒रुत्मा॒न्दिवं॑ गच्छ॒ स्वः॑ पत ।।
12.e:
Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: thou hast the Trivrit for
 thy head.
 Gâyatra is thine eye, thy wings are Brihat and Rathantara.
 The hymn is self, the metres are his limbs, the formulas his
 name.
 The Vâmadevya Sâman is thy form, the Yajñâyajñiya thy
 tail, the fire-hearths are thy hooves.
 Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: go skyward, soar to
 heavenly light.

12.d: विष्णोः॒ क्रमो॑ सि सपत्न॒हा गा॑य॒त्रं छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह पृथि॒वीमनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व । विष्णोः॒ क्रमो॑ स्यभिमाति॒हा त्रै॑ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑हा॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व । विष्णोः॒ क्रमो॑ स्यरातीय॒तो ह॒न्ता जाग॑तं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह॒ दिव॒मनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व । विष्णोः॒ क्रमो॑ सि शत्रूय॒तो ह॒न्तानु॑ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह॒ दिशो नु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व ।।
12.e:
Thou art the riyal-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the
 Gâyatra metre: stride along the earth.
 Thou art the foe-destroying stride of Vishnu. Mount the
 Trishtup metre: stride along mid-air.
 Thou art the traitor-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the
 Jagatî metre: stride along the sky.
 Thou art the foeman-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount
 Anushtup metre: stride along the Quarters.

12.d: अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्नि स्त॒नय॑न्निव द्यौः॒ क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुधः॑ सम॒ञ्जन् । स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः ।।
12.e:
Agni roared out like Dyaus what time he thunders: licking
 full oft the earth round plants he flickered.
 At once, when born, he looked about, enkindled: he shineth
 forth between the earth and heaven.

12.d: अग्ने॑ भ्यावर्तिन्न॒भि मा॒ नि व॑र्त॒स्वायु॑षा॒ वर्च॑सा प्र॒जया॒ धने॑न । स॒न्या मे॒धया॑ र॒य्या पोषे॑ण ।।
12.e:
Return to me, thou still-returning Agni, with life, with
 lustre, progeny, and treasure,
 With profit, wisdom, riches, and abundance.

12.d: अग्ने॑ अङ्गिरः श॒तं ते॑ सन्त्वा॒वृतः॑ स॒हस्रं॑ त उपा॒वृतः॑ । अधा॒ पोष॑स्य॒ पोषे॑ण॒ पुन॑र्नो न॒ष्टमा कृ॑धि॒ पुन॑र्नो र॒यिमा कृ॑धि ।।
12.e:
A hundred, Agni Angiras! be thy ways, a thousand thy
 returns.
 With increment of increase bring thou back to us what we
 have lost. Again bring hitherward our wealth.

12.d: पुन॑रू॒र्जा नि व॑र्तस्व॒ पुन॑रग्न इ॒षायु॑षा । पुन॑र्नः पा॒ह्यँह॑सः ।।
12.e:
Return again with nourishment; Agni, again with food and
 life. Again preserve us from distress.

12.d: स॒ह र॒य्या नि व॑र्त॒स्वाग्ने॒ पिन्व॑स्व॒ धार॑या । वि॒श्वप्स्न्या॑ वि॒श्वत॒स्परि॑ ।।
12.e:
Agni, return with store of wealth. Swell with thine overflowing
 stream that feedeth all on every side.

12.d: आ त्वा॑हार्षम॒न्तर॑भूर्ध्रु॒वस्ति॒ष्ठावि॑चाचलिः । विश॑स्त्वा॒ सर्वा॑ वाञ्छन्तु॒ मा त्वद्रा॒ष्ट्रमधि॑ भ्रशत् ।।
12.e:
I brought thee: thou hast entered in. Stand stedfast and
 immovable.
 Lot all the people long for thee. Let not thy kingship fall
 away.

12.d: उदु॑त्त॒मं व॑रुण॒ पाश॑म॒स्मदवा॑ध॒मं वि म॑ध्य॒मँ श्र॑थाय । अथा॑ व॒यमा॑दित्य व्र॒ते तवाना॑गसो॒ अदि॑तये स्याम ।।
12.e:
Varuna, from the upmost bond release us, let down the
 lowest and remove the midmost.
 So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O
 thou Âditya.

12.d: अग्रे॑ बृ॒हन्नु॒षसा॑मू॒र्ध्वो अ॑स्थान्निर्जग॒न्वान्तम॑सो॒ ज्योति॒षागा॑त् । अ॒ग्निर्भा॒नुना॒ रुश॑ता॒ स्वङ्ग॒ आ जा॒तो विश्वा॒ सद्मा॑न्यप्राः ।।
12.e:
High hath the Mighty risen before the Mornings, and come
 to us with light from out the darkness.
 Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled
 at birth all human habitations.

12.d: हँ॒सः शु॑चि॒षद्वसु॑रन्तरिक्ष॒सद्धोता॑ वेदि॒षदति॑थिर्दूरोण॒सत् । नृ॒षद्व॑र॒सदृ॑त॒सद्व्यो॑म॒सद॒ब्जा गो॒जा ऋ॑त॒जा अ॑द्रि॒जा ऋ॒तम् । बृ॒हत् ।।
12.e:
The Hamsa homed in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest
 beside the altar, Guest within the house,
 Dweller in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born
 of flood, kine, truth, mountain, he is holy Law. The Great.

12.d: सीद॒ त्वं मा॒तुर॒स्या उ॒पस्थे॒ विश्वा॑न्यग्ने व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् । मै॑नां॒ तप॑सा॒ मार्चिषा॒भिशो॑चीर॒न्तर॑स्याँ शु॒क्रज्यो॑ति॒र्वि भा॑हि ।।
12.e:
Knowing all holy ordinances, Agni, be seated in the lap of
 this thy mother.
 Do not with heat or glowing flame consume her: shine thou
 within her with refulgent lustre.

12.d: अ॒न्तर॑ग्ने रु॒चा त्वमु॒खायाः॒ सद॑ने॒ स्वे । तस्या॒स्त्वँ हर॑सा॒ तप॒न्जात॑वेदः शि॒वो भ॑व ।।
12.e:
Within this Fire-pan with thy light, O Agni, in thy proper seat,
 Glowing with warmth, be gracious thou, O Jâtavedas, unto her.

12.d: शि॒वो भू॒त्वा मह्य॑मग्ने॒ अथो॑ सीद शि॒वस्त्वम् । शि॒वः कृ॒त्वा दिशः॒ सर्वाः॒ स्वं योनि॑मि॒हास॑दः ।।
12.e:
Being propitious unto me, O Agni, sit propitiously.
 Having made all the regions blest, in thine own dwelling
 seat thyself.

12.d: दि॒वस्परि॑ प्रथ॒मं ज॑ज्ञे अ॒ग्निर॒स्माद्द्वि॒तीयं॒ परि॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः । तृ॒तीय॑म॒प्सु नृ॒मणा॒ अज॑स्र॒मिन्धा॑न एनं जरते स्वा॒धीः ।।
12.e:
First Agni sprang to life from out of heaven, the second
 time from us came Jâtavedas.
 Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious
 lauds and kindles him Eternal.

12.d: वि॒द्मा ते॑ अग्ने त्रे॒धा त्र॒याणि॑ वि॒द्मा ते॒ धाम॒ विभृ॑ता पुरु॒त्रा । वि॒द्मा ते॒ नाम॑ पर॒मं गुहा॒ यद्वि॒द्मा तमुत्सं॒ यत॑ आज॒गन्थ॑ ।।
12.e:
Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know
 thy forms in many a place divided.
 We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know
 the source from which thou hast proceeded.

12.d: स॑मु॒द्रे त्वा॑ नृ॒मणा॑ अ॒प्स्व॒न्तर्नृ॒चक्षा॑ ईधे दि॒वो अ॑ग्न॒ ऊध॑न् । तृ॒तीये॑ त्वा॒ रज॑सि तस्थि॒वाँस॑म॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ महि॒षा अ॑वर्धन् ।।
12.e:
The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, Man's Viewer
 lit thee in the breast of heaven.
 There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Bulls
 increased thee in the waters’ bosom.

12.d: अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्नि स्त॒नय॑न्निव द्यौः॒ क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुधः॑ सम॒ञ्जन् । स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः ।।
12.e: Agni roared out, etc. (verse 6 repeated).

12.d: श्री॒णामु॑दा॒रो ध॒रुणो॑ रयी॒णां म॑नी॒षाणां॒ प्रार्प॑णः॒ सोम॑गोपाः । वसुः॑ सू॒नुः सह॑सो अ॒प्सु राजा॒ वि भा॒त्यग्र॑ उ॒षसा॑मिधा॒नः ।।
12.e:
The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of
 thoughts and guardian of the Soma,
 Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront
 of the Dawns he shines enkindled.

12.d: विश्व॑स्य के॒तुर्भुव॑नस्य॒ गर्भ॒ आ रोद॑सी अपृणा॒ज्जाय॑मानः । वी॒डुं चि॒दद्रि॑मभिनत्परा॒यञ्जना॒ यद॒ग्निमय॑जन्त॒ पञ्च॑ ।।
12.e:
Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, he sprang to life
 and filled the earth and heaven.
 Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the
 Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.

12.d: उ॒शिक्पा॑व॒को अ॑र॒तिः सु॑मे॒धा मर्त्ये॑ष्व॒ग्निर॒मृतो॒ नि धा॑यि । इय॑र्ति धू॒मम॑रु॒षं भरि॑भ्र॒दुच्छु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॒ द्यामिन॑क्षन् ।।
12.e:
So among mortals was immortal Agni stablished as cleansing,
 wise, and eager envoy.
 He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving
 to reach the heaven with radiant lustre.

12.d: दृ॑शा॒नो रु॒क्म उ॒र्व्या व्य॑द्यौद्दु॒र्मर्ष॒मायुः॑ श्रि॒ये रु॑चा॒नः । अ॒ग्निर॒मृतो॑ अभव॒द्वयो॑भि॒र्यदे॑नं द्यौर्ज॒नय॑त्सु॒रेताः॑ ।।
12.e: Far hath he shone, etc. (verse 1 repeated).

12.d: यस्ते॑ अ॒द्य कृ॒णव॑द्भद्रशोचे पू॒पं दे॑व घृ॒तव॑न्तमग्ने । प्र तं न॑य प्रत॒रं वस्यो॒ अच्छा॒भि सु॒म्नं दे॒वभ॑क्तं यविष्ठ ।।
12.e:
Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, makes thee
 a cake, O Agni, mixed with butter,
 Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed
 by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.

12.d: आ तं भ॑ज सौश्रव॒सेष्व॑ग्न उ॒क्थौ॑क्थ॒ आ भ॑ज श॒स्यमा॑ने । प्रि॒यः सूर्ये॑ प्रि॒यो अ॒ग्ना भ॑वा॒त्युज्जा॒तेन॑ भि॒नद॒दुज्जनि॑त्वैः ।।
12.e:
Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every, song of
 praise sung forth enrich him.
 Dear let him be to Sûrya, dear to Agni, preëminent with son
 and children's children.

12.d: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ यज॑माना॒ अनु॒ द्यून्विश्वा॒ वसु॑ दधिरे॒ वार्या॑णि । त्वया॑ स॒ह द्रवि॑णमि॒च्छमा॑ना व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तमु॒शिजो॒ वि व॑व्रुः ।।
12.e:
While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win
 themselves all treasures worth the wishing.
 Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed
 the stable filled with cattle.

12.d: अस्ता॑व्य॒ग्निर्न॒राँ सु॒शेवो॑ वैश्वान॒र ऋषि॑भिः॒ सोम॑गोपाः । अ॑द्वे॒षे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी हु॑वेम॒ देवा॑ ध॒त्त र॒यिम॒स्मे सु॒वीर॑म् ।।
12.e:
Agni, man's gracious Friend, the Soma's keeper, Vaisvânara,
 hath been lauded by the Rishis.
 We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities,
 give us wealth with hero children.

12.d: स॒मिधा॒ग्निं दु॑वस्यत घृतैर्बोधय॒ताति॑थिम् । आस्मि॑न्ह॒व्या जु॑होतन ।।
12.e:
Pay service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest
 with oil:
 In him present your offerings.

12.d: उदु॑ त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अग्ने॒ भर॑न्तु॒ चित्ति॑भिः । स नो॑ भव शि॒वस्त्वँ सु॒प्रती॑को वि॒भाव॑सुः ।।
12.e:
May all the Gods, O Agni, bear thee upward with their earnest
 thoughts:
 Not to be looked on, rich in light, be thou propitious unto us,

12.d: प्रेद॑ग्ने॒ ज्योति॑ष्मान्याहि शि॒वेभि॑र॒र्चिभि॒ष्ट्वम् । बृ॒हद्भि॑र्भा॒नुभि॒र्भास॒न्मा हिँ॑सीस्त॒न्वा॑ प्र॒जाः ।।
12.e:
Agni, go forth resplendent, thou with thine auspicious flames
 of fire.
 Shining with mighty beams of light harm not my people
 with thy form.

12.d: अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्नि स्त॒नय॑न्निव द्यौः॒ क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुधः॑ सम॒ञ्जन् । स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः ।।
12.e: Agni roared out, etc. (verse 21 repeated.)

12.d: प्रप्रा॒यम॒ग्निर्भ॑र॒तस्य॑ शृण्वे॒ वि यत्सूर्यो॒ न रोच॑ते बृ॒हद्भाः । अ॒भि यः पू॒रुं पृत॑नासु तस्थौ दी॒दाय दैव्यो॒ अति॑थिः शि॒वो नः॑ ।।
12.e:
Far famed is this the Bharata's own Agni: he shineth like
 the Sun with lofty splendour.
 He who hath vanquished Pûru in the battle, the heavenly
 Guest hath shone for us benignly.

12.d: आपो॑ देवीः॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत॒ भस्मै॒तत्स्यो॒ने कृ॑णुध्वँ सुर॒भा लो॒के । तस्मै॑ नमन्तां॒ जन॑यः सु॒पत्नी॑र्मा॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रं बि॑भृता॒प्स्वे॑नत् ।।
12.e:
Receive these ashes, ye celestial Waters, and lay them in a
 fair place full of fragrance.
 To him bow down the nobly-wedded Matrons! Bear this on
 waters as her son a mother.

12.d: अ॒प्स्व॑ग्ने॒ सधि॒ष्टव सौषधी॒रनु॑ रुध्यसे । गर्भे॒ सन्जा॑यसे॒ पुनः॑ ।।
12.e:
Agni, thy home is in the floods: into the plants thou forcest
 way,
 And as their child art born anew.

12.d: गर्भो॑ अ॒स्योष॑धीनां॒ गर्भो॒ वन॒स्पती॑नाम् । गर्भो॒ विश्व॑स्य भू॒तस्याग्ने॒ गर्भो॑ अ॒पाम॑सि ।।
12.e:
Thou art the offspring of the plants, thou art the offspring
 of the trees:
 The offspring thou of all that is, thou, Agni, art the Waters’
 Child,

12.d: प्र॒सद्य॒ भस्म॑ना॒ योनि॑म॒पश्च॑ पृथि॒वीम॑ग्ने । सँ॒सृज्य॑ मा॒तृभि॒ष्ट्वं ज्योति॑ष्मा॒न्पुन॒रास॑दः ।।
12.e:
With ashes having reached the womb, the waters, Agni
 and the earth,
 United with the mothers, thou blazing hast seated thee again.

12.d: पुन॑रा॒सद्य॒ सद॑नम॒पश्च॑ पृथि॒वीम॑ग्ने । शेषे॑ मा॒तुर्यथो॒पस्थे॒ न्तर॑स्याँ शि॒वत॑मः ।।
12.e:
Seated again upon thy seat, the waters, Agni! and the earth,
 In her, thou, most auspicious One, liest as in a mother's lap

40, 41 Return again, etc. Agni, return, etc. (verses 9 and 10
 repeated).

12.d: पुन॑रू॒र्जा निव॑र्तस्व॒ पुन॑रग्न इ॒षायु॑षा । पुन॑र्नः पा॒ह्यँह॑सः ।।
12.e:
Mark this my speech, Divine One, thou Most Youthful,
 offered to thee by him who gives most freely:
 One hates thee, and another sings thy praises. I thine
 adorer laud thy form, O Agni.

12.d: स॒ह र॒य्या नि व॑र्त॒स्वाग्ने॒ पिन्व॑स्व॒ धार॑या । वि॒श्वप्स्न्या॑ वि॒श्वत॒स्परि॑ ।।
12.e:
Be thou for us a liberal Prince, Giver and Lord of precious
 things.
 Drive those who hate us far away.
 To the Omnific One All-hail!

12.d: बोधा॑ मे अ॒स्य वच॑सो यविष्ठ॒ मँहि॑ष्ठस्य॒ प्रभृ॑तस्य स्वधावः । पीय॑ति त्वो॒ अनु॑ त्वो गृणाति व॒न्दारु॑ष्टे त॒न्वं॑ वन्दे अग्ने ।।
12.e:
Again let the Âdityas, Rudras, Yams, and Brahmans with
 their rites light thee, Wealth-bringer!
 Increase thy body with presented butter: effectual be the
 Sacrificer's wishes.

12.d: स बो॑धि सू॒रिर्म॒घवा॒ वसु॑पते॒ वसु॑दावन् । यु॑यो॒ध्य॒स्मद्द्वेषाँ॑सि । वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
12.e:
Go hence, depart, creep off in all directions, both ancient
 visitors and recent comers:
 Yama hath given a place on earth to rest in. This place
 for him the Fathers have provided.

12.d: पुन॑स्त्वादि॒त्या रु॒द्रा वस॑वः॒ समि॑न्धतां॒ पुन॑र्ब्र॒ह्माणो॑ वसुनीथ यज्ञैः । घृ॒तेन॒ त्वं त॒न्वं॑ वर्धयस्व स॒त्याः स॑न्तु॒ यज॑मानस्य॒ कामाः॑ ।।
12.e:
Knowledge art thou: accomplishment of wishes. In me be
 the fulfilment of thy wishes.
 Thou art the ashes, thou the mould of Agni. Rankers are
 ye, rankers around. Rankers right upward, be ye fixed.

12.d: अपे॑त॒ वी॑त॒ वि च॑ सर्प॒तातो॒ ये त्र॒ स्थ पु॑रा॒णा ये च॒ नूत॑नाः । अदा॑द्य॒मो॑ व॒सानं॑ पृथि॒व्या अक्र॑न्नि॒मं पि॒तरो॑ लो॒कम॑स्मै ।।
12.e:
This is that Agni where the longing Indra took the pressed
 Soma deep within his body.
 Winner of spoils in thousands like a courser, with prayer art
 thou exalted, Jâtavedas.

12.d: सं॒ज्ञान॑मसि । का॑म॒धर॑णम् । मयि॑ ते काम॒धर॑णं भूयात् । अ॒ग्नेर्भस्मा॑स्य॒ग्नेः पुरी॑षमसि । चित॑ स्थ परि॒चित॑ ऊर्ध्व॒चितः॑ श्नयध्वम् ।।
12.e:
The splendour which is thine in heaven, O Agni, in earth, O
 Holy One, in plants, in waters,
 Wherewith thou hast o’erspread mid-air's broad region, that
 light is brilliant, billowy, man-surveying.

12.d: अ॒यँ सो अ॒ग्निर्यस्मि॒न्त्सोम॒मिन्द्रः॑ सु॒तं द॒धे ज॒ठरे॑ वावशा॒नः । स॑ह॒स्रिणं॒ वाज॒मत्यं॒ न सप्तिँ॑ सस॒वान्त्सन्त्स्तू॑यसे जातवेदः ।।
12.e:
O Agni, to the flood of heaven thou mountest, thou tallest
 hither Gods, the thought-inspirers.
 The waters, those beyond the light of Sûrya, and those
 that are beneath it here, approach thee.

12.d: अग्ने॒ यत्ते॑ दि॒वि वर्चः॑ पृथि॒व्यां यदोष॑धीष्व॒प्स्वा य॑जत्र । येना॒न्तरि॑क्षमु॒र्वा॑त॒तन्थ॑ त्वे॒षः स भा॒नुर॑र्ण॒वो नृ॒चक्षाः॑ ।।
12.e:
May the Purîshya Agnis in accord with those that spring
 from floods,
 May they, benevolent, accept the sacrifice, full, wholesome
 draughts.

12.d: अग्ने॑ दि॒वो अर्ण॒मच्छा॑ जिगा॒स्यच्छा॑ दे॒वाँ ऊ॑चिषे॒ धिष्ण्या॒ ये । या रो॑च॒ने प॒रस्ता॒त्सूर्य॑स्य॒ याश्चा॒वस्ता॑दुप॒तिष्ठ॑न्त॒ आपः॑ ।।
12.e:
As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle,
 lasting, rich in marvels.
 To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this
 thy gracious will to us-ward.

12.d: पु॑री॒ष्या॑सो अ॒ग्नयः॑ प्राव॒णेभिः॑ स॒जोष॑सः । जु॒षन्तां॑ य॒ज्ञम॒द्रुहो॑ नमी॒वा इषो॑ म॒हीः ।।
12.e:
This is thine ordered place of birth whence, sprung to life,
 thou shonest forth.
 Knowing this, Agni, mount on high and cause our riches to
 increase.

12.d: इडा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दँसँ॑ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मँ हव॑मानाय साध । स्यान्नः॑ सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे ।।
12.e:
Ranker art thou: Angiras-like sit steady with that Deity.
 Ranker-round art thou: Angiras-like sit steady with that
 Deity.

12.d: अ॒यं ते॒ योनि॑रृ॒त्वियो॒ यतो॑ जा॒तो अरो॑चथाः । तं जा॒नन्न॑ग्न॒ आ रो॒हाथा॑ नो वर्धया र॒यिम् ।।
12.e:
Fill up the room, supply the void, then settle steady in thy
 place.
 Indr-Âgni and Brihaspati have set thee down in this abode.

12.d: चिद॑सि॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वा सी॑द । प॑रि॒चिद॑सि॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ।।
12.e:
The dappled kine who stream with milk prepare his draught
 of Soma juice—
 Clans in the birthplace of the Gods, in the three luminous
 realms of heaven.

12.d: लो॒कं पृ॑ण छि॒द्रं पृ॒णाथो॑ सीद ध्रु॒वा त्वम् । इ॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी त्वा॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒स्मिन्योना॑वसीषदन् ।।
12.e:
All sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea,
 The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord
 of Strength.

12.d: ता अ॑स्य॒ सूद॑दोहसः॒ सोमँ॑ श्रीणन्ति॒ पृश्न॑यः । जन्म॑न्दे॒वानां॒ विश॑स्त्रि॒ष्वा रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः ।।
12.e:
Combine ye two and harmonize together, dear to each other,
 brilliant, friendly-minded,
 Abiding in one place for food and vigour.

12.d: इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिरः॑ । र॒थीत॑मँ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑नाँ॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म् ।।
12.e:
Together have I brought your minds, your ordinances, and
 your thoughts.
 Be thou our Sovran Lord, Agni Purîshya; give food and
 vigour to the Sacrificer.

12.d: समि॑तँ॒ सं क॑ल्पेथाँ॒ सम्प्रि॑यौ रोचि॒ष्णू सु॑मन॒स्यमा॑नौ । इष॒मूर्ज॑म॒भि सं॒वसा॑नौ ।।
12.e:
Thou art Purîshya Agni, thou art wealthy, thou art prosperous.
 Having made all the regions blest, here seat thee in thine
 own abode.

12.d: सं वां॒ मनाँ॑सि॒ सं व्र॒ता समु॑ चि॒त्तान्याक॑रम् । अग्ने॑ पुरीष्याधि॒पा भ॑व॒ त्वं न॒ इष॒मूर्जं॒ यज॑मानाय धेहि ।।
12.e:
Be ye one-minded unto us, both of one thought, free from
 deceit.
 Harm not the sacrifice, harm not the Patron of the sacrifice.
 Be gracious unto us to-day, ye knowers of all things that be.

12.d: अग्ने॒ त्वं पु॑री॒ष्यो॑ रयि॒मान्पु॑ष्टि॒माँ अ॑सि । शि॒वाः कृ॒त्वा दिशः॒ सर्वाः॒ योनि॑मि॒हास॑दः ।।
12.e:
Even as a mother bears her son, Earth, Ukhâ hath borne
 within her womb Purîshya Agni.
 Maker of all, accordant with the All-Gods and Seasons, may
 Prajâpati release her.

12.d: भव॑तं नः॒ सम॑नसौ॒ सचे॑तसावरे॒पसौ॑ । मा य॒ज्ञँ हिँ॑सिष्टं॒ मा य॒ज्ञप॑तिं जातवेदसौ शिवौ भवतम॒द्य नः॑ ।।
12.e:
Seek him who pours not, offers not oblation; follow the
 going of the thief and robber.

This is thy way; leave us and seek some other. To thee,
 O Goddess Nirriti, be homage.

12.d: मा॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रं पृ॑थि॒वी पु॑री॒ष्य॑म॒ग्निँ स्वे योना॑वभारु॒खा । तां विश्वै॑र्देवैरृ॒तुभिः॑ संविदा॒नः प्र॒जाप॑तिर्वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ वि मु॑ञ्चतु ।।
12.e:
To thee, sharp-pointed Nirriti, full homage! Loose and
 detach this iron bond that binds him.
 Unanimous with Yama and with Yamî to the sublimest
 vault of heaven uplift him.

12.d: असु॑न्वन्त॒मय॑जमानमिच्छ स्ते॒नस्ये॒त्यामन्वि॑हि॒ तस्क॑रस्य । अ॒न्यम॒स्मदि॑च्छ॒ सा त॑ इ॒त्या नमो॑ देवि निरृते॒ तुभ्य॑मस्तु ।।
12.e:
Thou, Awful One, thou in whose mouth I offer for the unloosing
 of these binding fetters,
 Whom people hail as Earth with their glad voices, as Nirriti
 in every place I know thee.

12.d: नमः॒ सु ते॑ निरृते तिग्मतेजो य॒स्मयं॒ वि चृ॑ता ब॒न्धमे॒तम् । य॒मेन॒ त्वं य॒म्या सं॑विदा॒नोत्त॒मे ना॒के अधि॑ रोहयैनम् ।।
12.e:
The binding noose which Nirriti the Goddess hath fastened
 on thy neck that none may loose it,
 I loose for thee as from the midst of Âyus. Sped forward
 now, eat thou the food we offer:
 To Fortune, her who hath done this, be homage.

12.d: यस्या॑स्ते घोर आ॒सन्जु॒होम्ये॒षां ब॒न्धाना॑मव॒सर्ज॑नाय । यां त्वा॒ जनो॒ भूमि॒रिति॑ प्र॒मन्द॑ते॒ निरृ॑तिं त्वा॒हं परि॑ वेद वि॒श्वतः॑ ।।
12.e:
Establisher, the gatherer of treasures, he looks with might
 on every form and figure.
 Like Savitar the God whose laws are constant, like Indra,
 he hath stood where meet the pathways.

12.d: यं ते॑ दे॒वी निरृ॑तिराब॒बन्ध॒ पाशं॑ ग्री॒वास्व॑विचृ॒त्यम् । तं ते॒ वि ष्या॒म्यायु॑षो॒ न मध्या॒दथै॒तं पि॒तुम॑द्धि॒ प्रसू॑तः । नमो॒ भूत्यै॒ येदं च॒कार॑ ।।
12.e:
Wise, through desire of bliss with Gods, the skilful bind the
 traces fast, and lay the yokes on either side.

12.d: नि॒वेश॑नः सं॒गम॑नो॒ वसु॑नां॒ विश्वा॑ रू॒पाभि च॑ष्टे॒ शची॑भिः । दे॒व इ॑व सवि॒ता स॒त्यध॒र्मेन्द्रो॒ न त॑स्थौ सम॒रे प॑थी॒नाम् ।।
12.e:
Lay on the yokes and fasten well the traces; formed is the
 furrow sow the seed within it.
 Through song may we find hearing fraught with plenty:
 near to the ripened grain approach the sickle.

12.d: सीरा॑ युञ्जन्ति क॒वयो॑ यु॒गा वि त॑न्वते॒ पृथ॑क् । धीरा॑ दे॒वेषु॑ सूम्न॒या ।।
12.e:
Happily let the shares turn up the ploughland, happily go
 the ploughers with the oxen!
 Suna and Sîra, pleased with our oblation, cause ye our
 plants to bear abundant fruitage.

12.d: यु॒नक्त॒ सीरा॒ वि यु॒गा त॑नुध्वं कृ॒ते योनौ॑ वपते॒ह बीज॑म् । गि॒रा च॑ श्रु॒ष्टिः सभ॑रा॒ अस॑न्नो॒ नेदी॑य॒ इत्सृ॒ण्यः॑ प॒क्वमेया॑त् ।।
12.e:
Approved by Visvedevas and by Maruts, balmed be the
 furrow with sweet-flavoured fatness.
 Succulent, teeming with thy milky treasure, turn hitherward
 to us with milk, O Furrow.

12.d: शु॒नँ सु पाला॒ वि कृ॑षन्तु॒ भूमिँ॑ शु॒नं की॒नाशा॑ अ॒भि य॑न्तु वाहैः । शुना॑सीरा ह॒विषा॒ तोश॑माना सुपिप्प॒ला ओष॑धीः कर्तना॒स्मे ।।
12.e:
The keen-shared plough that bringeth bliss, good for the
 Soma-drinker's need,
 Shear out for me a cow, a sheep, a rapid drawer of the car,
 a blooming woman, plump and strong!

12.d: घृ॒तेन॒ सीता॒ मधु॑ना॒ सम॑ज्यतां॒ विश्वै॑र्देवै॒रनु॑मता म॒रुद्भिः॑ । ऊर्ज॑स्वती॒ पय॑सा॒ पिन्व॑माना॒स्मान्त्सी॑ते॒ पय॑सा॒भ्या व॑वृत्स्व ।।
12.e:
Milk out their wish, O Wishing-Cow, to Mitra and to Varuna,
 To Indra, to the Asvins, to Pûshan, to people and to plants.

12.d: लाङ्ग॑लं॒ पवी॑रवत्सु॒शेवँ॑ सोम॒पित्स॑रु । तदुद्व॑पति॒ गामविं॑ प्रप॒र्व्यं॑ च॒ पीव॑रीं प्र॒स्थाव॑द्रथ॒वाह॑नम् ।।
12.e:
Be loosed, inviolable, Godward-farers! We have attained
 the limit of this darkness: we have won the light.

12.d: कामं॑ कामदुघे धुक्ष्व मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय च । इन्द्रा॑या॒श्विभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णे प्र॒जाभ्य॒ ओष॑धीभ्यः ।।
12.e:
The year together with the darksome fortnights; Dawn with
 the ruddy-coloured cows about her; the Asvins with
 their wonderful achievements; the Sun together with his
 dappled Courser; Vaisvânara with Idâ and with butter.
 Svâhâ!

12.d: वि मु॑च्यध्वमघ्न्या देवयाना॒ अग॑न्म॒ तम॑सस्पा॒रम॒स्य ज्योति॑रापाम ।।
12.e:
Herbs that sprang up in time of old, three ages earlier than
 the Gods,—
 Of these, whose hue is brown, will I declare the hundred
 powers and seven.

12.d: स॒जूरब्दो॒ अय॑वोभिः स॒जूरु॒षा अरु॑णीभिः स॒जोष॑साव॒श्विना॒ दँसो॑भिः स॒जूः सूर॒ एत॑शेन स॒जूर्वै॑श्वान॒र इड॑या घृ॒तेन॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
12.e:
Ye, Mothers, have a hundred homes, yea, and a thousand are
 your growths.
 Do ye who have a thousand powers free this my patient from
 disease.

12.d: या ओष॑धीः॒ पूर्वा॑ जा॒ता दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्रियु॒गं पु॒रा । मनै॒ नु ब॒भ्रूणा॑म॒हँ श॒तं धामा॑नि स॒प्त च॑ ।।
12.e:
Be glad and joyful in the Plants, both blossoming and bearing
 fruit,
 Plants that will lead us to success like mares who conquer in
 the race.

12.d: श॒तं वो॑ अम्ब॒ धामा॑नि स॒हस्र॑मु॒त वो॒ रुहः॑ । अधा॑ शतक्रत्वो यू॒यमि॒मं मे॑ अग॒दं कृ॑त ।।
12.e:
Plants, by this name I speak to you, Mothers, to you the
 Goddesses:
 Steed, cow, and garment may I win, win back thy very self,
 O man.

12.d: ओष॑धीः॒ प्रति॑ मोदध्वं॒ पुष्प॑वतीः प्र॒सूव॑रीः । अश्वा॑ इव स॒जित्व॑रीर्वी॒रुधः॑ पारयि॒ष्ण्वः॑ ।।
12.e:
The Holy Fig tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna
 tree:
 Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.

12.d: ओष॑धी॒रिति॑ मातर॒स्तद्वो॑ देवी॒रुप॑ ब्रुवे । स॒नेय॒मश्वं॒ गां वास॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ तव॑ पूरुष ।।
12.e:
He who hath store of Herbs at hand like Kings amid a crowd
 of men,—
 Physician is that sage's name, fiend-slayer, chaser of disease.

12.d: अ॑श्व॒त्थे वो॑ नि॒षद॑नं प॒र्णे वो॑ वस॒तिष्कृ॒ता । गो॒भाज॒ इत्किला॑सथ॒ यत्स॒नव॑थ॒ पूरु॑षम् ।।
12.e:
Herbs rich in Soma, rich in steeds, in nourishment in strengthening
 power,
 All these have I provided here, that this man may be whole
 again.

12.d: यत्रौ॑षधीः स॒मग्म॑त॒ राजा॑नः॒ समि॑ताविव । विप्रः॒ स उ॑च्यते भि॒षग्र॑क्षो॒हामी॑व॒चात॑नः ।।
12.e:
The healing virtues of the Plants stream forth like cattle
 from the stall,—
 Plants that shall win me store of wealth, and save thy vital
 breath, O man.

12.d: अ॑श्वाव॒तीँ सो॑माव॒तीमू॒र्जय॑न्ती॒मुदो॑जसम् । आवि॑त्सि॒ सर्वा॒ ओष॑धीर॒स्मा अ॑रि॒ष्टता॑तये ।।
12.e:
Reliever is your mother's name, and hence Restorers are ye
 called.
 Rivers are ye with wings that fly: keep far whatever brings
 disease.

12.d: उच्छुष्मा॒ ओष॑धीनां॒ गावो॑ गो॒ष्ठादि॑वेरते । धनँ॑ सनि॒ष्यन्ती॑नामा॒त्मानं॒ तव॑ पूरुष ।।
12.e:
Over all fences have they passed, as steals a thief into the fold.
 The Plants have driven from the frame whatever malady was
 there.

12.d: इष्कृ॑ति॒र्नाम॑ वो मा॒ताथो॑ यू॒यँ स्थ॒ निष्कृ॑तीः । सी॒राः प॑त॒त्रिणी॑ स्थन॒ यदा॒मय॑ति॒ निष्कृ॑थ ।।
12.e:
When, bringing back the vanished strength, I hold these herbs
 within my hand,
 The spirit of disease departs ere he can seize upon the life.

12.d: अति॒ विश्वाः॑ परि॒ष्ठा स्ते॒न इ॑व व्र॒जम॑क्रमुः । ओष॑धीः॒ प्राचु॑च्यवु॒र्यत्किं च॑ त॒न्वो॒ रपः॑ ।।
12.e:
He through whose frame, O Plants, ye creep member by
 member, joint by joint,
 From him ye drive away disease like some strong arbiter of
 strife.

12.d: यदि॒मा वा॒जय॑न्न॒हमोष॑धी॒र्हस्त॑ आद॒धे । आ॒त्मा यक्ष्म॑स्य नश्यति पु॒रा जी॑व॒गृभो॑ यथा ।।
12.e:
Fly, Spirit of Disease, begone, with the blue jay and kingfisher.
 Fly, with the wind's impetuous speed, vanish together with
 the storm.

12.d: यस्यौ॑षधीः प्र॒सर्प॒थाङ्ग॑म्ङ्गं॒ परु॑ष्परुः । ततो॒ यक्ष्मं॒ वि बा॑धध्व उ॒ग्रो म॑ध्यम॒शीरि॑व ।।
12.e:
Help every one the other, lend assistance each of you to
 each,
 All of you be accordant, give furtherance to this speech of
 mine.

12.d: सा॒कं य॑क्ष्म॒ प्रप॑त॒ चाषे॑ण किकिदी॒विना॑ । सा॒कं वात॑स्य॒ ध्राज्या॑ सा॒कं न॑श्य नि॒हाक॑या ।।
12.e:
Let fruitful Plants, and fruitless, those that blossom, and
 the blossomless,
 Urged onward by Brihaspati, release us from our pain and
 grief;

12.d: अ॒न्या वो॑ अ॒न्याम॑वत्व॒न्यान्यस्या॒ उपा॑वत । ताः सर्वाः॑ संविदा॒ना इ॒दं मे॒ प्राव॑ता॒ वचः॑ ।।
12.e:
Release
 me from the curse's plague and woe that comes from
 Varuna;
 Free me from Yama's fetter, from sin and offence against the
 Gods.

12.d: याः प॒लिनी॒र्या अ॑प॒ला अ॑पु॒ष्पा याश्च॑ पु॒ष्पिणीः॑ । बृह॒स्पति॑प्रसूता॒स्ता नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वँह॑सः ।।
12.e:
What time, descending from the sky, the Plants flew earthward,
 thus they spake:
 No evil shall befall the man whom while he liveth we
 pervade.

12.d: मु॒ञ्चन्तु॑ मा शप॒थ्या॒दथो॑ वरु॒ण्या॑दु॒त । अथो॑ य॒मस्य॒ पड्वी॑शा॒त्सर्व॑स्माद्देवकिल्वि॒षात् ।।
12.e:
Of all the many Plants whose King is Soma, Plants of hundred
 forms,
 Thou art the Plant most excellent, prompt to the wish, sweet
 to the heart.

12.d: अ॑व॒पत॑न्तीरवदन्दि॒व ओष॑धय॒स्परि॑ । यं जी॒वम॒श्नवा॑महै॒ न स रि॑ष्याति॒ पूरु॑षः ।।
12.e:
O all ye various Herbs whose King is Soma, that o’erspread
 the earth,
 Urged onward by Brihaspati, combine your virtue in this
 Plant.

12.d: या ओष॑धीः॒ सोम॑राज्ञीर्ब॒ह्वीः श॒तवि॑चक्षणाः । तासा॑मसि॒ त्वमु॑त्त॒मारं॒ कामा॑य॒ शँ हृ॒दे ।।
12.e:
All Plants that hear this speech, and those that have
 departed far away,
 Come all assembled and confer your healing power upon
 this Herb.

12.d: या ओष॑धीः॒ सोम॑राज्ञी॒र्विष्ठि॑ताः पृथि॒वीमनु॑ । बृह॒स्पति॑प्रसूता अस्यै॒ सं द॑त्त वी॒र्य॑म् ।।
12.e:
Unharmed be he who digs you up, unharmed the man for
 whom I dig:
 And let no malady attack biped or quadruped of ours.

12.d: याश्चे॒दमु॑पशृ॒ण्वन्ति॒ याश्च॑ दू॒रं परा॑गताः । सर्वाः॑ सं॒गत्य॑ वीरुधो स्यै॒ सं द॑त्त वी॒र्य॑म् ।।
12.e:
With Soma as their Sovran Lord the Plants hold colloquy
 and say:
 O King, we save from death the man whose cure a Brâhman
 undertakes.

12.d: मा वो॑ रिषत्खनि॒ता यस्मै॑ चा॒हं खना॑मि वः । द्वि॒पाच्चतु॑ष्पाद॒स्माकँ॒ सर्व॑मस्त्वनातु॒रम् ।।
12.e:
Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant: thy vassals are the
 trees.
 Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to
 injure us.

12.d: ओष॑धयः॒ सम॑वदन्त॒ सोमे॑न स॒ह राज्ञा॑ । यस्मै॑ कृ॒णोति॑ ब्राह्म॒णस्तँ रा॑जन्पारयामसि ।।
ना॑शयि॒त्री ब॒लास॒स्यार्श॑स उप॒चिता॑मसि । अथो॑ श॒तस्य॒ यक्ष्मा॑णां पाका॒रोर॑सि॒ नाश॑नी ।।
12.e:
Thee did Gandharvas dig from earth, thee Indra and
 Brihaspati.
 King Soma, knowing thee, O Plant, from his Consumption
 was made free.

12.d: त्वां ग॑न्ध॒र्वा अ॑खनँ॒स्त्वामिन्द्र॒स्त्वां बृह॒स्पतिः॑ । त्वामो॑षधे॒ सोमो॒ राजा॑ वि॒द्वान्यक्ष्मा॑दमुच्यत ।।
12.e:
Conquer mine enemies, the men who challenge me do thou
 subdue.
 Conquer thou all unhappiness: victorious art thou, O Plant.

12.d: सह॑स्व मे॒ अरा॑तीः॒ सह॑स्व पृतनाय॒तः । सह॑स्व॒ सर्वं॑ पा॒प्मानँ॒ सह॑मानास्योषधे ।।
12.e:
Long-lived be he who digs thee, Plant, and he for whom I
 dig thee up.
 So mayst thou also, grown long-lived, rise upward with a
 hundred shoots.

12.d: दी॒र्घायु॑स्त ओषधे खनि॒ता यस्मै॑ च त्वा॒ खना॑म्य॒हम् । अथो॒ त्वं दी॒र्घायु॑र्भू॒त्वा श॒तव॑ल्शा॒ वि रो॑हतात् ।।
12.e:
Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant; thy vassals are the
 trees.
 Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to
 injure us.

12.d: त्वमु॑त्त॒मास्यो॑षधे॒ तव॑ वृ॒क्षा उप॑स्तयः । उप॑स्तिरस्तु॒ सो॒ स्माकं॒ यो अ॒स्माँ अ॑भि॒दास॑ति ।।
12.e:
May he not harm me who is earth's begetter, nor he whose
 laws are faithful, sky's pervades;
 Nor he who first begot the lucid waters. To Ka the God
 let us present oblation.

12.d: मा मा॑ हिँसीज्जनि॒ता यः पृ॑थि॒व्या यो वा॒ दिवँ॑ स॒त्यध॑र्मा॒ व्यान॑ट् । यश्चा॒पश्च॒न्द्राः प्र॑थ॒मो ज॒जान॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ।।
12.e:
Turn thyself hitherward, O Earth, to us with sacrifice and
 milk.
 Thy covering skin Agni, urged forth, hath mounted.

12.d: अ॒भ्या व॑र्तस्व पृथिवि य॒ज्ञेन॒ पय॑सा स॒ह । व॒पां ते॑ अ॒ग्निरि॑षि॒तो अ॑रोहत् ।।
अग्ने॒ यत्ते॑ शु॒क्रं यच्च॒न्द्रं यत्पू॒तं यच्च॑ य॒ज्ञिय॑म् । तद्दे॒वेभ्यो॑ भरामसि ।।
12.e:
I from this place have fed on strength and vigour, the
 womb of holy Law, stream of the mighty.
 In cows let it possess me and in bodies. I quit decline and
 lack of food, and sickness.

12.d: इष॒मूर्ज॑म॒हमि॒त आद॑मृ॒तस्य॒ योनिं॑ महि॒षस्य॒ धारा॑म् । आ मा॒ गोषु॑ विश॒त्वा त॒नूषु॒ जहा॑मि से॒दिमनि॑रा॒ममी॑वाम् ।।
12.e:
Agni, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily,
 thou rich in wealth of beams!
 Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with
 strength, the food that merits laud.

12.d: अग्ने॒ तव॒ श्रवो॒ वयो॒ महि॑ भ्राजन्ते अ॒र्चयो॑ विभावसो । बृह॑द्भानो॒ शव॑सा॒ वाज॑मु॒क्थ्यं॒ दधा॑सि दा॒शुषे॑ कवे ।।
12.e:
With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou
 liftest up thyself in light.
 Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou
 joinest close the earth and heaven.

12.d: पा॑व॒कव॑र्चाः शु॒क्रव॑र्चा॒ अनू॑नवर्चा॒ उदि॑यर्षि भा॒नुना॑ । पु॒त्रो मा॒तरा॑ वि॒चर॒न्नुपा॑वसि पृ॒णक्षि॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे ।।
12.e:
O Jâtavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in
 our fair hymns and songs.
 In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food,
 born nobly and of wondrous help.

12.d: ऊर्जो॑ नपाज्जातवेदः सुश॒स्तिभि॒र्मन्द॑स्व धी॒तिभि॑र्हि॒तः । त्वे इषः॒ सं द॑धु॒र्भूरि॑वर्पसश्चि॒त्रोत॑यो वा॒मजा॑ताः ।।
12.e:
Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth
 to us, Immortal God.
 Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou
 leadest us to conquering power.

12.d: इ॑र॒ज्यन्न॑ग्ने प्रथयस्व ज॒न्तुभि॑र॒स्मे रायो॑ अमर्त्य । स द॑र्श॒तस्य॒ वपु॑षो॒ वि रा॑जसि पृ॒णक्षि॑ सान॒सिं क्रतु॑म् ।।
12.e:
To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches
 under his control,
 Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest
 him wealth that conquers all.

12.d: इ॑ष्क॒र्तार॑मध्व॒रस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसं॒ क्षय॑न्तँ॒ राध॑सो म॒हः । रा॒तिं वा॒मस्य॑ सु॒भगां॑ म॒हीमिषं॒ दधा॑सि सान॒सिँ र॒यिम् ।।
12.e:
The men have set before them for their welfare Agni, strong,
 visible to all, the Holy.
 Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's
 generations magnify with praise-songs.

12.d: ऋ॒तावा॑नं महि॒षं वि॒श्वद॑र्शतम॒ग्निँ सु॒म्नाय॑ दधिरे पु॒रो जनाः॑ । श्रुत्क॑र्णँ स॒प्रथ॑स्तमं त्वा गि॒रा दै॑व्यं॒ मानु॑षा यु॒गा ।।
12.e:
Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers
 unite in thee.
 Be in the gathering-place of strength.

12.d: आ प्या॑यस्व॒ समे॑तु ते वि॒श्वतः॑ सोम॒ वृष्ण्य॑म् । भवा॒ वाज॑स्य संग॒थे ।।
12.e:
In thee be juicy nutriments united, and power and mighty
 foe-subduing vigour.
 Waxing to immortality, O Soma, win highest glory for
 thyself in heaven.

12.d: सं ते॒ पयाँ॑सि॒ समु॑ यन्तु॒ वाजाः॒ सं वृष्ण्या॑न्यभिमाति॒षाहः॑ । आ॒प्याय॑मानो अ॒मृता॑य सोम दि॒वि श्रवाँ॑स्युत्त॒मानि॑ धिष्व ।।
12.e:
Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy
 filaments, and be
 A friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.

12.d: आ प्या॑यस्व मदिन्तम॒ सोम॒ विश्वे॑भिरँ॒शुभिः॑ । भवा॑ नः सु॒श्रव॑स्तमः॒ सखा॑ वृ॒धे ।।
12.e:
May Vatsa draw thy mind away, even from thy loftiest
 dwelling-place,
 Agni, with song that yearns for thee.

12.d: आ ते॑ व॒त्सो मनो॑ यमत्पर॒माच्चि॑त्स॒धस्था॑त् । अग्ने॒ त्वांका॑मया गि॒रा ।।
12.e:
Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant
 homes
 Apart have turned to gain their wish.

12.d: तुभ्यं॒ ता अ॑ङ्गिरस्तम॒ विश्वाः॑ सुक्षि॒तयः॒ पृथ॑क् । अग्ने॒ कामा॑य येमिरे ।।
12.e:
In dear homes, Agni, the desire of all that is and is to be,
 Shines forth the One Imperial Lord.

13.d: मयि॑ गृह्णा॒म्यग्रे॑ अ॒ग्निँ रा॒यस्पोषा॑य सुप्रजा॒स्त्वाय॑ सु॒वीर्या॑य । मामु॑ दे॒वताः॑ सचन्ताम् ।।
13.e:
I TAKE within me Agni first, for increase of my wealth,
 good offspring, manly strength:
 So may the Deities wait on me.

13.d: अ॒पां पृ॒ष्ठम॑सि॒ योनि॑र॒ग्नेः स॑मु॒द्रम॒भितः॒ पिन्व॑मानम् । वर्ध॑मानो म॒हाँ आ च॒ पुष्क॑रे दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थस्व ।।
13.e:
Thou art the waters’ back, the womb of Agni, around the
 ocean as it swells and surges.
 Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread forth in
 amplitude with heaven's own measure.

13.d: ब्रह्म॑ जज्ञा॒नं प्र॑थ॒मं पु॒रस्ता॒द्वि सी॑म॒तः सु॒रुचो॑ वे॒न आ॑वः । स बु॒ध्न्या॑ उप॒मा अ॑स्य वि॒ष्ठाः स॒तश्च॒ योनि॒मस॑तश्च॒ वि वः॑ ।।
13.e:
Eastward at first was Brahma generated. Vena o’erspread
 the bright Ones from the summit,
 Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of existent
 and of non-existent.

13.d: हि॑रण्यग॒र्भः सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ भू॒तस्य॑ जा॒तः पति॒रेक॑ आसीत् । स दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमां कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ।।
13.e:
In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all
 created being.
 He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. Worship
 we Ka the God with our oblation.

13.d: द्र॒प्सश्च॑स्कन्द पृथि॒वीमनु॒ द्यामि॒मं च॒ योनि॒मनु॒ यश्च॒ पूर्वः॑ । स॑मा॒नं योनि॒मनु॑ सं॒चर॑न्तं द्र॒प्सं जु॑हो॒म्यनु॑ स॒प्त होत्राः॑ ।।
13.e:
The Drop leaped onward through the earth and heaven,
 along this place and that which was before it.

I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop still
 moving to the common dwelling.

13.d: नमो॑ स्तु स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ ये के च॑ पृथि॒वीमनु॑ । ये अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ ये दि॒वि तेभ्यः॑ स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नमः॑ ।।
13.e:
Homage be paid to Serpents unto all of them that are on
 earth,
 To those that dwell in air, to those that dwell in sky be
 homage paid.

13.d: या इष॑वो यातु॒धाना॑नां॒ ये वा॒ वन॒स्पतीँ॒स्तु । ये वा॑व॒टेषु॒ शेर॑ते॒ तेभ्यः॑ स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नमः॑ ।।
13.e:
To those that are the demons’ darts, to those that live upon
 the trees,
 To all the Serpents that lie low in holes be adoration paid.

13.d: ये वा॒मी रो॑च॒ने दि॒वो ये वा॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिषु॑ । येषा॑म॒प्सु सद॑स्कृ॒तं तेभ्यः॑ स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नमः॑ ।।
13.e:
Or those that are in heaven's bright sphere, or those that
 dwell in the Sun's beams:
 Serpents, whose home has been prepared in waters, homage
 unto them!

13.d: कृ॑णु॒ष्व पाजः॒ प्रसि॑तिं॒ न पृ॒थ्वीं या॒हि राजे॒वाम॑वाँ॒ इभे॑न । तृ॒ष्वीमनु॒ प्रसि॑तिं द्रूणा॒नो स्ता॑सि॒ विध्य॑ र॒क्षस॒स्तपि॑ष्ठैः ।।
13.e:
Put forth like a wide-spreading net thy vigour: go like a
 mighty King with his attendants.
 Thou, following thy swift net, shootest arrows: transfix the
 fiends with darts that burn most fiercely.

13.d: तव॑ भ्र॒मास॑ आशु॒या प॑त॒न्त्यनु॑ स्पृश धृष॒ता शोशु॑चानः । तपूँ॑ष्यग्ने जु॒ह्वा॑ पत॒ङ्गानसं॑दितो॒ वि सृ॑ज॒ विष्व॑गु॒ल्काः ।।
13.e:
Forth go in rapid flight thy whirling weapons: follow them
 closely glowing in thy fury.
 Spread with thy tongue the wingèd flames, O Agni: unfettered
 cast thy firebrands all around thee.

13.d: प्रति॒ स्पशो॒ वि सृ॑ज॒ तूर्णि॑तमो॒ भवा॑ पा॒युर्वि॒शो अ॒स्या अद॑ब्धः । यो नो॑ दू॒रे अ॒घशँ॑सो॒ यो अन्त्यग्ने॒ माकि॑ष्टे॒ व्यथि॒रा द॑धर्षीत् ।।
13.e:
Send thy spies forward, fleetest in thy motion: be, ne’er
 deceived, the guardian of this people
 From him who, near or far, is bent on evil, and let no
 trouble sent from thee o’ercome us.

13.d: उद॑ग्ने तिष्ठ॒ प्रत्या त॑नुष्व॒ न्य॒मित्राँ॑ ओषतात्तिग्महेते । यो नो॒ अरा॑तिँ समिधान च॒क्रे नी॒चा तं ध॑क्ष्यत॒सं न शुष्क॑म् ।।
13.e:
Rise up, O Agni, spread thee out before us, burn down our
 foes, thou who hast sharpened arrows.
 Him, blazing Agni! who hath worked us mischief, consume
 thou utterly like dried-up stubble.

13.d: ऊ॒र्ध्वो भ॑व॒ प्रति॑ वि॒ध्याध्य॒स्मदा॒विष्कृ॑णुष्व दैव्यान्यग्ने । अव॑ स्थि॒रा त॑नुहि यातु॒जूनां॑ जा॒मिमजा॑मिं॒ प्र मृ॑णीहि॒ शत्रू॑न् । अ॒ग्नेष्ट्वा॒ तेज॑सा सादयामि ।।
13.e:
Rise, Agni, drive off those who fight against us: make
 manifest thine own celestial vigour.
 Slacken the strong bows of the demon-driven: destroy our
 foemen whether kin or stranger.
 I settle thee with Agni's fiery ardour.

13.d: अ॒ग्निर्मू॒र्धा दि॒वः क॒कुत्पतिः॑ पृथि॒व्या अ॒यम् । अ॒पाँ रेताँ॑सि जिन्वति । इन्द्र॑स्य त्वौजसा सादयामि ।।
13.e:
Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth
 is he:
 He quickeneth the waters’ seed.
 I settle thee with the great strength of Indra.

13.d: भुवो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ रज॑सश्च ने॒ता यत्रा॑ नि॒युद्भिः॒ सच॑से शि॒वाभिः॑ । दि॒वि मू॒र्धानं॑ दधिषे स्व॒र्षां जि॒ह्वाम॑ग्ने चक्रिषे हव्य॒वाह॑म् ।।
13.e:
Thou art the leader of the rite and region to which with
 thine auspicious teams thou tendest.
 Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making
 thy tongue the oblation-bearer, Agni!

13.d: ध्रु॒वासि॑ ध॒रुणास्तृ॑ता वि॒श्वक॑र्मणा । मा त्वा॑ समु॒द्र उद्ब॑धी॒न्मा सु॑प॒र्णो व्य॑थमाना पृथि॒वीं दृँ॑ह ।।
13.e:
Steady art thou, sustainer, laid by Visvakarman in thy
 place.
 Let not the ocean nor the bird harm thee: unshaking, steady
 earth.

13.d: प्र॒जाप॑तिष्ट्वा सादयत्व॒पा पृ॒ष्ठे स॑मु॒द्रस्येम॑न् । व्यच॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्व पृथि॒व्य॑सि ।।
13.e:
Thee let Prajâpati settle on the waters’ back, in Ocean's
 course,
 Thee the capacious, widely spread. Thou art the Wide
 One: spread thee wide

13.d: भूर॑सि॒ भूमि॑र॒स्यदि॑तिरसि वि॒श्वधा॑या॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य ध॒र्त्री । पृ॑थि॒वीं य॑च्छ पृथि॒वीं दृँ॑ह पृथि॒वीं मा हिँ॑सीः ।।
13.e:
Thou art the earth, the ground, thou art the all-sustaining
 Aditi, she who supporteth all the world.
 Control the earth, steady the earth, do thou the earth no
 injury.

13.d: विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नायो॑दा॒नाय॑ प्रति॒ष्ठायै॑ च॒रित्रा॑य । अ॒ग्निष्ट्वा॒भि पा॑तु म॒ह्या स्व॒स्त्या छ॒र्दिषा॒ शंत॑मेन॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ।।
13.e:
For all breath, out-breath; through-breath, upward-breathing,
 for high position, for prescribed observance,
 May Agni keep thee safe with great well-being, with the
 securest shelter. As aforetime with Angiras, with that
 Deity lie steady.

13.d: काण्डा॑त्काण्डात्प्र॒रोह॑न्ती॒ परु॑षःपरुष॒स्परि॑ । ए॒वा नो॒ दूर्वे॒ प्र त॑नु स॒हस्रे॑ण श॒तेन॑ च ।।
13.e:
Upspringing from thine every joint, upspringing from each
 knot of thine,

Thus with a thousand, Dûrvâ! with a hundred do thou
 stretch us out.

13.d: या श॒तेन॑ प्रत॒नोषि॑ स॒हस्रे॑ण वि॒रोह॑सि । तस्या॑स्ते देवीष्टके वि॒धेम॑ ह॒विषा॑ व॒यम् ।।
13.e:
Thou spreading with a hundred, thou that branched with
 a thousand shoots,
 Thee, such, with our oblation will we worship, O celestial
 Brick.

13.d: यास्ते॑ अग्ने॒ सूर्ये॒ रुचो॒ दिव॑मात॒न्वन्ति॑ र॒श्मिभिः॑ । ताभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य सर्वा॑भी रु॒चे जना॑य नस्कृधि ।।
13.e:
Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun that with their beams
 o’erspread the sky,—
 With all of those assist thou us to-day to light and progeny.
 23. Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, or lights that are in
 kine and steeds,
 O Indra-Agni, with all those vouchsafe us light, Brihaspati!

13.d: या वो॑ दे॒वाः सूर्ये॒ रुचो॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु॒ या रुचः॑ । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ ताभिः॒ सर्वा॑भी॒ रुचं॑ नो धत्त बृहस्पते ।।
13.e:
The Far.-Refulgent held the light. The Self-Refulgent held
 the light.
 Thee, luminous, may Prajâpati settle upon the back of Earth.
 Give, to all breathing, all the light, to out-breath, to diffusive
 breath.
 Thy Sovran Lord is Agni. With that Deity, as with Angiras,
 lie firmly settled in thy place.

13.d: वि॒राड्ज्योति॑रधारयत् । स्व॒राड्ज्योति॑रधारयत् । प्र॒जाप॑तिष्ट्वा सादयतु पृ॒ष्ठे पृ॑थि॒व्या ज्योति॑ष्मतीम् । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नाय॒ विश्वं॒ ज्योति॑र्यच्छ । अ॒ग्निष्टे धि॑पति॒स्तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ।।
13.e:
Madhu and Mâdhava, the two Spring seasons—thou art
 the innermost cement of Agni.
 May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis
 help, separate, accordant, my precedence.
 May all the Fires ’twixt heaven and earth, one-minded,
 well-fitted, gather round these two Spring seasons,
 As the Gods gathering encompass Indra: firm with that
 Deity, Angiras-like, be seated.

13.d: मधु॑श्च॒ माध॑वश्च॒ वास॑न्तिकावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तःश्ले॒षो॑ सि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धयः॒ कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नयः॒ पृथ॒ङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय॒ सव्र॑ताः । ये अ॒ग्नयः॒ सम॑नसो न्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे वास॑न्तिकावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒सं वि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम् ।।
13.e:
Thou art Ashâdhâ, Conquering One. Conquer our foemen,
 conquer thou the men who fain would-fight with us.
 A thousand manly powers hast thou: so do thou aid and
 quicken me.

13.d: अषा॑ढासि॒ सह॑माना॒ सह॒स्वारा॑तीः॒ सह॑स्व पृतनाय॒तः । स॒हस्र॑वीर्यासि॒ सा मा॑ जिन्व ।।
13.e:
The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man
 who keeps the Law:
 So may the plants be sweet for us.

13.d: मधु॒ वाता॑ ऋताय॒ते मधु॑ क्षरन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः । माध्वी॑र्नः स॒न्त्वोष॑धीः ।।
13.e:
Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial
 atmosphere:
 Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.

13.d: मधु॒ नक्त॑मु॒तोषसो॒ मधु॑म॒त्पार्थि॑वँ॒ रजः॑ । मधु द्यौरस्तु नः पि॒ता ।।
13.e:
May the tall tree be full of sweets for us and, and full of
 sweets the Sun:
 May our milch-kine be sweet for us.

13.d: मधु॑मान्नो॒ वन॒स्पति॒र्मधु॑माँ अस्तु॒ सूर्यः॑ । माध्वी॒र्गावो॑ भवन्तु नः ।।
13.e:
Seat thyself in the deepness of the waters, lest Sûrya, lest
 Vaisvânara Agni scorch thee.
 With wing unclipped, survey created beings: may rain
 that cometh down from heaven attend thee.

13.d: अ॒पां गम्भ॑न्त्सीद॒ मा त्वा॒ सूर्यो॒ भि ता॑प्सी॒न्माग्निर्वै॑श्वान॒रः । अच्छि॑न्नपत्राः प्र॒जा अ॑नु॒वीक्ष॒स्वानु॑ त्वा दि॒व्या वृष्टिः॑ सचताम् ।।
13.e:
He crept across the three heaven-reaching oceans, the Bull
 of Bricks, the Master of the Waters.
 Clad in the world with his, the Well-Made's, vesture, go
 whither those before thee have departed.

13.d: त्रीन्त्स॑मु॒द्रान्त्सम॑सृपत्स्व॒र्गान॒पां पति॑र्वृष॒भ इष्ट॑कानाम् । पुरी॑षं॒ वसा॑नः सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के तत्र॑ गच्छ॒ यत्र॒ पूर्वे॒ परे॑ताः ।।
13.e:
May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our
 sacrifice,
 And feed us full with nourishments.

13.d: म॒ही द्यौः॑ पृथि॒वी च॑ न इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षताम् । पि॑पृ॒तां नो॒ भरी॑मभिः ।।
13.e:
Look ye on Vishnu's works whereby the Friend of Indra,
 close allied,
 Hath let his holy ways be seen.

13.d: विष्णोः॒ कर्मा॑णि पश्यत॒ यतो॑ व्र॒तानि॑ पस्प॒शे । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्यः॒ सखा॑ ।।
13.e:
Firm art thou, a sustainer. Hence engendered, forth from
 these wombs at first came Jâtavedas.
 By Gâyatrî, by Trishtup, by Anushtup, may he who knows
 bear to the Gods oblation.

13.d: ध्रु॒वासि॑ ध॒रुणे॒तो ज॑ज्ञे प्रथ॒ममे॒भ्यो योनि॑भ्यो॒ अधि॑ जा॒तवे॑दः । स गा॑य॒त्र्या त्रि॒ष्टुभा॑नु॒ष्टुभा॑ च दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒व्यं व॑हतु प्रजा॒नन् ।।
13.e:
Take thou thine ease for food, for store of riches, for might
 in splendour, and for strength and offspring.
 Thou art all-ruling, independent Ruler: both fountains of
 Sarasvatî protect thee!

13.d: इ॒षे रा॒ये र॑मस्व॒ सह॑से द्यु॒म्न ऊ॒र्जे अप॑त्याय । स॒म्राड॑सि स्व॒राड॑सि सारस्वतौ॒ त्वोत्सौ॒ प्राव॑ताम् ।।
13.e:
O radiant Agni, harness thou thy steeds which are most excellent!
 They bear thee as thy spirit wills.

13.d: अग्ने॑ यु॒क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वा॑सो देव सा॒धवः॑ । अरं॒ वह॑न्ति म॒न्यवे॑ ।।
13.e:
Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the
 Gods:
 As ancient Hotar take thy seat.

13.d: यु॒क्ष्वा हि दे॑व॒हूत॑माँ॒ अश्वाँ॑ अग्ने र॒थीरि॑व । नि होता॑ पू॒र्व्यः स॑दः ।।
13.e:
Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves
 in inmost heart and spirit.
 I look upon the flowing streams of butter: the golden reed
 is in the midst of Agni.

13.d: स॒म्यक्स्र॑वन्ति स॒रितो॒ न धेना॑ अ॒न्तर्हृ॒दा मन॑सा पू॒यमा॑नाः । घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि हिर॒ण्ययो॑ वेत॒सो मध्ये॑ अ॒ग्नेः ।।
13.e:
Thee for the praise-verse, thee for sheen, thee for bright
 splendour, thee for light.
 This hath become the energetic spirit of all the world and of
 Vaisvânara Agni.

13.d: ऋ॒चे त्वा॑ रु॒चे त्वा॑ भा॒से त्वा॒ ज्योति॑षे त्वा । अभू॑दि॒दं विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ वाजि॑नम॒ग्नेर्वै॑श्वान॒रस्य॑ च ।।
13.e:
Agni, all-luminous with light, splendid with splendour, golden
 One.
 Giver of thousands art thou: for a thousand thee.

13.d: अ॒ग्निर्ज्योति॑षा॒ ज्योति॑ष्मान्रु॒क्मो वर्च॑सा॒ वर्च॑स्वान् । स॑हस्र॒दा अ॑सि स॒हस्रा॑य त्वा ।।
13.e:
Balm thou with milk the unborn babe Âditya, wearing all
 forms, creator of a thousand.
 Spare, him with heat, nor plot against him: give him a
 hundred years of life while thou art building.

13.d: आ॑दि॒त्यं गर्भं॒ पय॑सा॒ सम॑ङ्धि स॒हस्र॑स्य प्रति॒मां वि॒श्वरू॑पम् । परि॑ वृङ्धि॒ हर॑सा॒ माभि मँ॑स्थाः श॒तायु॑षं कृणुहि ची॒यमा॑नः ।।
13.e:
The wind's impetuous rush, Varuna's navel! the horse that
 springs to life amid the waters!
 The rivers’ tawny child, based on the mountain, harm not,
 O Agni, in the loftiest region.

13.d: वा॒तस्य॑ जू॒तिं वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभि॒मश्वं॑ जज्ञा॒नँ स॑रि॒रस्य॒ मध्ये॑ । शिशुं॑ न॒दीनाँ॒ हरि॒मद्रि॑बुध्न॒मग्ने॒ मा हिँ॑सीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ।।
13.e:
Unwasting Drop, red, eager, pressing forward, Agni I worship
 with repeated homage.
 Forming thyself with joints in proper order, harm not the
 Cow, Aditi widely ruling!

13.d: अज॑स्र॒मिन्दु॑मरु॒षं भु॑र॒ण्युम॒ग्निमी॑डे पू॒र्वचि॑त्ति॒ नमो॑भिः । स पर्व॑भिरृतु॒शः कल्प॑मानो॒ गां मा हिँ॑सी॒रदि॑तिं वि॒राज॑म् ।।
13.e:
Her who is Tvashtar's guardian, Varuna's navel, the Ewe
 brought forth from out the loftiest region,
 The Asura's mighty thousandfold contrivance, injure not in
 the highest sphere, O Agni.

13.d: वरू॑त्रीं॒ त्वष्टु॒र्वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभि॒मविं॑ जज्ञा॒नाँ रज॑सः॒ पर॑स्मात् । म॒हीँ सा॑ह॒स्रीमसु॑रस्य मा॒यामग्ने॒ मा हिँ॑सीः प॒र्मे व्यो॑मन् ।।
13.e:
The Agni who from Agni had his being, from heat of Earth
 or also heat of Heaven,
 Whereby the Omnific One engendered creatures, him may
 thy fierce displeasure spare, O Agni.

13.d: यो ग्निर॒ग्नेरधि॒यजा॑यत॒ शोका॑त्पृथि॒व्या उ॒त वा॑ दि॒वस्परि॑ । येन॑ प्र॒जा वि॒श्वक॑र्मा ज॒जान॒ तम॑ग्ने॒ हेडः॒ परि॑ ते वृणक्तु ।।
13.e:
The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of
 Mitra, Varuna, and Agni.
 The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, the Sun hath
 filled the air, and earth and heaven.

13.d: चि॒त्रं दे॒वाना॒मुद॑गा॒दनी॑कं॒ चक्षु॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्या॒ग्नेः । आप्रा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षँ॒ सूर्य॑ आ॒त्मा जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॑श्च ।।
13.e:
Injure not, thousand-eyed, while thou art building for sacrifice,
 this animal, the biped.

Accept as pith man's counterfeit the victim, Agni: therewith
 building thy forms, be settled.
 Let thy flame reach man's counterfeit: let thy flame reach
 the man we hate.

13.d: इ॒मं मा हिँ॑सीर्द्वि॒पादं॑ प॒शुँ स॑हस्रा॒क्षो मेधा॑य ची॒यमा॑नः । म॒युं प॒शुं मेध॑मग्ने जुषस्व॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो॒ नि षी॑द । म॒युं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ।।
13.e:
Harm not this animal whose hooves are solid, the courser
 neighing in the midst of coursers.
 I dedicate to thee the forest Gaura: building thy bodies up
 with him be settled.
 Let thy flame reach the Gaura, let thy flame reach him whom
 we detest.

13.d: इ॒मं मा हिँ॑सी॒रेक॑शपं प॒शुं क॑निक्र॒दं वा॒जिनं॒ वाजि॑नेषु । गौ॒रमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो॒ नि षी॑द । गौ॒रं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ।।
13.e:
Thousandfold, with a hundred streams, this fountain,
 expanded in the middle of the waters,
 Infinite, yielding butter for the people, harm not, O Agni,
 in the highest region.
 This wild bull of the forest I assign thee: building thy
 bodies up therewith be settled.
 Let thy flame reach the wild hull, etc. (as in 48).

13.d: इ॒मँ सा॑ह॒स्रँ श॒तधा॑र॒मुत्सं॑ व्य॒च्यमा॑नँ सरि॒रस्य॒ मध्ये॑ । घृ॒तं दुहा॑ना॒मदि॑तिं॒ जना॒याग्ने॒ मा हिँ॑सीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् । ग॑व॒यमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो॒ नि षी॑द । ग॑व॒यं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ।।
13.e:
This creature clothed in wool, Varuna's navel, the skin of
 animals quadruped and biped,
 The first that was produced of Tvashtar's creatures, O Agni,
 harm not in the highest region.
 The forest buffalo do I assign thee: building, etc., as above

mutato mutando
.

13.d: इ॒ममू॑र्णा॒युं वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभिं॒ त्वचं॑ पशू॒नां द्वि॒पदां॒चतु॑ष्पदाम् । त्वष्टुः॑ प्र॒जानां॑ प्रथ॒मं ज॒नित्र॒मग्ने॒ मा हिँ॑सीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् । उष्ट्र॑मार॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो॒ नि षी॑द । उष्ट्रं॑ ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ।।
13.e:
From Agni's warmth the he-goat had his being: he looked
 at first upon his generator.
 Thereby the Gods at first attained to Godhead: those meet
 for worship to the height ascended.
 The forest Sarabha do I assign thee: building, etc.

13.d: अ॒जो ह्य॒ग्नेरज॑निष्ट॒ शोका॒त्सो अ॑पश्यज्जनि॒तार॒मग्रे॑ । तेन॑ दे॒वा दे॒वता॒मग्र॑मायँ॒स्तेन॒ रोह॑माय॒न्नुप॒ मेध्या॑सः । श॑र॒भमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो॒ नि षी॑द । श॑र॒भं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ।।
13.e:
Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer,
 hear their songs,
 Protect his offspring and himself.

13.d: त्वं य॑विष्ठ दा॒शुषो॒ नॄँः पा॑हि शृणु॒धी गिरः॑ । रक्षा॑ तो॒कमु॒त त्मना॑ ।।
13.e:
I set thee in the passage of the waters. I set thee in the
 swelling of the waters. I set thee in the ashes of the
 waters. I set thee in the lustre of the waters. I set
 thee in the way which waters travel. I set thee in the
 flood, the place to test in. I set thee in the sea, the place
 to rest in. I set thee in the stream, the place to rest in.
 I set thee in the water's habitation. I set thee in the
 resting-place of waters. I set thee in the station of the
 waters. I set thee in the meeting-place of waters. I set
 thee in the birthplace of the waters. I set thee in the
 refuse of the waters. I set thee in the residence of waters.
 I settle thee with the Gâyatrî metre. I settle thee with
 the Trishtup metre. I settle thee with the Jagatî metre.
 I settle thee with the Anushtup metre. I settle thee
 with the Pankti metre.

13.d: अ॒पां त्वेम॑न्त्सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वोद्म॑न्त्सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॒ भस्म॑न्त्सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॒ ज्योति॑षि सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वाय॑ने सादयामि । अ॑र्ण॒वे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयामि । स॑मु॒द्रे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयामि । स॑रि॒रे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॒ क्षये॑ सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॒ सधि॑षि सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॑ स॒धस्थे॑ सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॒ योनौ॑ सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॒ पुरी॑षे सादयामि । अ॒पां त्वा॒ पाथ॑सि सादयामि । गा॑य॒त्रेण॑ त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि । त्रै॑ष्टुभेन त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि । जाग॑तेन त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि । आनु॑ष्टुभेन त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि । पाङ्क्ते॑न त्वा॒ छन्द॑सा सादयामि ।।
13.e:
This, in front, is Bhuva. His offspring, Breath, is Bhauvâyana.
 Spring is Prânâyana. The Gâyatrî is the daughter
 of Spring. From the Gâyatrî comes the Gâyatra tune.
 From the Gâyatra the Upâmsu. From the Upâmsu the
 Trivrit. From the Trivrit the Rathantara. The Rishi
 Vasishtha. By thee, taken by Prajâpati, I take vital
 breath for creatures.

13.d: अ॒यं पु॒रो भुवः॑ । तस्य॑ प्रा॒णो भौ॑वना॒यः । व॑स॒न्तः प्रा॑ण्य॒नः । गा॑य॒त्री वा॑स॒न्ती । गा॑यत्र्यै गाय॒त्रम् । गा॑य॒त्रादु॑पाँ॒शुः । उ॑पाँ॒शोस्त्रि॒वृत् । त्रि॒वृतो॑ रथन्त॒रम् । वसि॑ष्ठ॒ ऋषिः॑ । प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॑ प्रा॒णं गृ॑ह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्यः॑ ।।
13.e:
This on the right, the Omnific. His, the Omnific's offspring,
 Mind. Summer sprang from Mind. The Trishtup is the
 daughter of Summer. From the Trishtup came the Svâra
 song. From the Svâra the Antaryâma. From the
 Antaryâma the Pañchadasa. From the Pañchadasa the
 Brihat. The Rishi Bharadvâja. By thee, taken by
 Prajâpati, I take Mind for creatures.

13.d: अ॒यं द॑क्षि॒णा वि॒श्वक॑र्मा । तस्य॒ मनो॑ वैश्वकर्म॒णम् । ग्री॒ष्मो मा॑न॒सः । त्रि॒ष्टुब्ग्रै॒ष्मी । त्रि॒ष्टुभः॑ स्वा॒रम् । स्वा॒राद॑न्तर्या॒मः । अ॑न्तर्या॒मात्प॑ञ्चद॒शः । प॑ञ्चद॒शाद्बृ॒हत् । भ॒रद्वा॑ज॒ ऋषिः॑ । प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॒ मनो॑ गृह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्यः॑ ।।
13.e:
This on the western side, the All-Embracer. His, the
 All-Embracer's offspring, the Eye. The Rains sprang from
 the Eye. The Jagatî is the daughter of the Rains.
 From the Jagatî came the Riksama. From the Riksama
 the Sukra. From the Sukra the Saptadasa. From the
 Saptadasa the Vairûpa. The Rishi Jamadagni. By thee,
 taken by Prajâpati, I take the Eye for creatures.

13.d: अ॒यं प॒श्चाद्वि॒श्वव्य॑चाः । तस्य॒ चक्षु॑र्वैश्वव्यच॒सम् । व॒र्षाश्चाक्षु॑ष्यः । जग॑ती वा॒र्षी । जग॑त्या॒ ऋक्स॑मम् । ऋक्स॑माच्छु॒क्रः । शु॒क्रात्स॑प्तद॒शः । स॑प्तद॒शाद्वै॑रू॒पम् । ज॒मद॑ग्नि॒रृषिः॑ । प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॒ चक्षु॑र्गृह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्यः॑ ।।
13.e:
This on the north side, heaven. This, heaven's offspring,
 the Ear. Autumn, the daughter of the Ear. The Anushtup
 sprang from Autumn. From the Anushtup came the
 Aida. From the Aida the Manthin. From the Manthin
 the Ekavimsa. From the Ekavimsa the Vairâja. The
 Rishi Visvâmitra. By thee, taken by Prajâpati, I take
 the Ear for creatures.

13.d: इ॒दं उ॑त्त॒रात्स्वः॑ । तस्य॒ शोत्रँ॑ सौ॒वम् । श॒रच्छ्रौ॒त्री । अ॑नु॒ष्टुप्शा॑र॒दी । अ॑नु॒ष्टुभ॑ ऐ॒डम् । अै॒डान्म॒न्थी । म॒न्थिन॑ एकविँ॒शः । ए॑कविँ॒शाद्वै॑रा॒जम् । वि॒श्वामि॑त्र॒ ऋषिः॑ । प्र॒जाप॑तिगृहीतया॒ त्वया॒ श्रोत्रं॑ गृह्णामि प्र॒जाभ्यः॑ ।।
13.e:
This above, Intellect. Its, Intellect's offspring, Speech.
 Winter the offspring of Speech. Pankti sprang from
 Winter. From Pankti the Nidhanavat. From the
 Nidhanavat came the Âgrayana. From the Âgrayana the
 Trinava and the Trayastrimsa. From the Trinava and
 the Trayastrimsa the Sâkvara and the Raivata. The
 Rishi Visvakarman. By thee, taken by Visvakarman,
 I take Speech for people.
 Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred
 songs, etc., three texts repeated from XII. 54-56.

14.d: ध्रु॒वक्षि॑तिर्ध्रु॒वयो॑निर्ध्रु॒वासि॑ ध्रु॒वं योनि॒मा सी॑द साधु॒या । उख्य॑स्य के॒तुं प्र॑थ॒मं जु॑षा॒णा । अ॒श्विना॑ध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ ।।
14.e:
WITH stedfast site and birthplace thou art stedfast: settle
 thou duly in thy stedfast birthplace, rejoicing in the
 Ukhya's first appearance.
 Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.

14.d: कु॑ला॒यिनी॑ घृ॒तव॑ती॒ पुरं॑धिः स्यो॒ने सी॑द॒ सद॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । अ॒भि त्वा॑ रु॒द्रा वस॑वो गृणन्त्वि॒मा ब्रह्म॑ पीपिहि सौभगाय । अ॒श्विना॑ध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ ।।
14.e:
Nesting, intelligent, dripping with butter, in the auspicious
 seat of earth be seated.
 Let Rudras, Vasus welcome thee with praises: fill full these
 prayers for our propitious fortune.
 Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus, seat thee.

14.d: स्वै॒र्दक्षै॒र्दक्ष॑पिते॒ह सी॑द दे॒वानाँ॑ सु॒म्ने बृ॑ह॒ते रणा॑य । पि॒तेवै॑धि सू॒नव॒ आ सु॒शेवा॑ स्वावे॒शा त॒न्वा॒ सं वि॑शस्व । अ॒श्विना॑ध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ ।।
14.e:
Here, Guard of Strength, with thine own powers be seated
 for the Gods’ happiness and great enjoyment.
 Even as a father to his son, be friendly: with easy entrance
 enter with thy body. Here let the Asvins, the Adhvaryus
 seat thee:

14.d: पृ॑थि॒व्याः पुरी॑षम॒स्यप्सो॒ नाम॒ तां त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒भि गृ॑णन्तु दे॒वाः । स्तोम॑पृष्ठा घृ॒तव॑ती॒ह सी॑द प्र॒जाव॑द॒स्मे द॑र्वि॒णा य॑जस्व । अ॒श्विना॑ध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ ।।
14.e:
Thou art the filling-stuff of earth called Apsas. May all the
 Gods celebrate thee with praises.
 Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas and butter, sit here
 and give us wealth with store of children.
 Here let the Asvins, etc.

14.d: अदि॑त्यास्त्वा पृ॒ष्ठे सा॑दयाम्य॒न्तरि॑क्षस्य ध॒र्त्रीं वि॒ष्टम्भ॑नीं दि॒शामधि॑पत्नीं॒ भुव॑नानामू॒र्मिर्द्र॒प्सो अ॒पाम॑सि वि॒श्वक॑र्मा त॒ ऋषिः॑ । अ॒श्विना॑ध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ ।।
14.e:
Upon the back of Aditi I lay thee the sky's supporter, pillar
 of the Quarters,
 Queen over creatures. Wave and drop of waters art thou;
 and Visvakarman is thy Rishi.

14.d: शु॒क्रश्च॒ शुचि॑श्च ग्रैष्मावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तःश्ले॒षो॑ सि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धयः॒ कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नयः॒ पृथ॒ङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय॒ सव्र॑ताः । ये अ॒ग्नयः॒ सम॑नसो न्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे ग्रै॒ष्मावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒सं वि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम् ।।
14.e:
Sukra and Suchi, seasons, both, of summer—thou art the
 innermost cement of Agni.
 May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help,
 separate, accordant, my precedence.

Let all the Agnis ’twixt the earth and heaven gather together
 round these summer seasons, as the Gods gather in their
 hosts round Indra,
 Firm, with that Deity, Angiras-like, be seated.

14.d: स॒जूरृ॒तुभिः॑ स॒जूर्वि॒धाभिः॑ स॒जूर्देवैः स॒जूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राया॒�॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ । स॒जूरृ॒तुभिः॑ स॒जूर्वि॒धाभिः॑ स॒जूर्वसु॑भिः स॒जूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राय�॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ । स॒जूरृ॒तुभिः॑ स॒जूर्वि॒धाभिः॑ स॒जू रुद्रैः स॒जूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राया॒॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ । स॒जूरृ॒तुभिः॑ स॒जूर्वि॒धाभिः॑ स॒जूरा॑दित्यैः स॒जूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒रा�॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ । स॒जूरृ॒तुभिः॑ स॒जूर्वि॒धाभिः॑ स॒जूर्विश्वै॑र्देवैः स॒जूर्देवैर्वयोनाधैर॒ग्नये॑ त्वा वैश्वान॒राया॒श्विना॑ध्व॒र्यू सा॑दयतामि॒ह त्वा॑ ।।
14.e:
Associate with the Seasons, with the Modes with the Gods,
 with the health-establishing Gods—may the Asvins the
 Adhvaryus settle thee here for Agni Vaisvânara.
 Associate.............with the Vasus, etc.
 Associate.............with the Rudras, etc.
 Associate.............with the Âdityas, etc.
 Associate.............with the Visvedevas, etc.

14.d: प्रा॒णं मे॑ पाहि । अ॑पा॒नं मे॑ पाहि । व्या॒नं मे॑ पाहि । चक्षु॑र्म उ॒र्व्या वि भा॑हि । श्रोत्रं॑ मे श्लोकय । अ॒पः पि॑न्व । ओष॑धीर्जिन्व । द्वि॒पाद॑व । चतु॑ष्पात्पाहि । दि॒वो वृष्टि॒मेर॑य ।।
14.e:
Guard thou my breath. Guard my out-breathing. Guard
 my through-breathing. Illume mine eye with far-reaching
 vision. Give power of hearing to mine ear. Pour
 forth waters. Quicken plants. Protect bipeds. Protect
 quadrupeds. Send rain from heaven.

14.d: मू॒र्धा वयः॑ प्र॒जाप॑ति॒श्छन्दः॑ । क्ष॒त्रं वयो॒ मयं॑दं॒ छन्दः॑ । वि॑ष्ट॒म्भो वयो धि॑पति॒श्छन्दः॑ । वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ वयः॑ परमे॒ष्ठी छन्दः॑ । व॒स्तो वयो॑ विव॒लं छन्दः॑ । वृष्णि॒र्वयो॑ विशा॒लं छन्दः॑ । पुरु॑षो॒ वय॑स्त॒न्द्रं छन्दः॑ । व्या॒घ्रो वयो ना॑धृष्टं॒ छन्दः॑ । सिँ॒हो वय॑श्छ॒दिश्छन्दः॑ । प॑ष्ठ॒वाड्वयो॑ बृह॒ती छन्दः॑ । उ॒क्षा वयः॑ क॒कुप्छन्दः॑ । ऋ॑ष॒भो वयः॑ स॒तोबृ॑हती॒ छन्दः॑ ।।
14.e:
The head is vital vigour. Prajâpati became the metre.
 Royalty is vital vigour, health-giving metre. The Supporter
 is vital vigour, the Sovran Lord the metre. Visvakarman
 is vital vigour, Parameshthin the metre. The he-goat is
 vital vigour, excellent the metre. The bull is vital vigour,
 extensive the metre. Man is vital vigour, languid the
 metre. The tiger is vital vigour, invincible the metre. The
 lion is vital vigour, covering the metre. The four-year
 bull is vital vigour, Brihatî the metre. The ox is vital
 vigour, Kakup the metre. The steer is vital vigour,
 Satobrihatî the metre.

14.d: अ॑न॒ड्वान्वयः॑ प॒ङ्क्तिश्छन्दः॑ । धे॒नुर्वयो॒ जग॑ती॒ छन्दः॑ । त्र्यवि॒र्वय॑स्त्रि॒ष्टुप्छन्दः॑ । दि॑त्य॒वाड्वयो॑ वि॒राट्छन्दः॑ । पञ्चा॑वि॒र्वयो॑ गाय॒त्री छन्दः॑ । त्रि॑व॒त्सो वय॑ उ॒ष्णिक्छन्दः॑ । तु॑र्य॒वाड्वयो॑ नु॒ष्टुप्छन्दः॑ । लो॒कं पृ॑ण छि॒द्रं पृ॒णाथो॑ सीद ध्रु॒वा त्वम् । इ॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी त्वा॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒स्मिन्योना॑वसीषदन् । ता अ॑स्य॒ सूद॑दोहसः॒ सोमँ॑ श्रीणन्ति॒ पृश्न॑यः । जन्म॑न्दे॒वानां॒ विश॑स्त्रि॒ष्वा रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः । इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिरः॑ । र॒थीत॑मँ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑नाँ॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म् ।।
14.e:
The bullock is vital vigour, Pankti the metre. The milch-cow
 is vital vigour, Jagatî the metre. The eighteen-month
 calf is vital vigour, Trishtup the metre. The two
 year old steer is vital vigour, Virâj the metre. The
 thirty-month old ewe is vital vigour, Gâyatrî the metre. The
 three year old steer is vital vigour, Ushnih the metre.
 The four year old ox is vital vigour, Anushtup the metre.
 Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred
 songs, etc. are three texts repeated from XII. 54-56.
 See also XIII. 58.

14.d: इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ अव्य॑थमाना॒मिष्ट॑कां दृँहतं यु॒वम् । पृ॒ष्ठेन॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं च॒ विबा॑धसे ।।
14.e:
Indra and Agni, in its place securely set the unshaking brick.
 Thou with thy back sunderest heaven and the broad earth
 and firmament.

14.d: वि॒श्वक॑र्मा त्वा सादयत्व॒न्तरि॑क्च्५अ॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे व्यच॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्वतीम॒न्तरि॑क्षं यच्छा॒न्तरि॑क्षं दृँहा॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ मा हिँ॑सीः । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नायो॑दा॒नाय॑ प्रति॒ष्ठायै॑ च॒रित्रा॑य । वा॒युष्ट्वा॒भि पा॑तु म॒ह्या स्व॒स्त्या छ॒र्दिषा॒ शंत॑मेन॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ।।
14.e:
On the air's back let Visvakarman set thee, thee the capacious,
 thee the far-extended.
 Control the air, fix firm the air, do thou the air no injury.
 For all breath, out-breath, through-breath, upward breathing,
 for high position, for prescribed observance,
 May Vâyu keep thee safe with great well-being, with securest
 shelter. In the manner of Angiras, with that Deity
 lie steady.

14.d: राज्ञ्य॑सि॒ प्राची॒ दिक् । वि॒राड॑सि॒ दक्षि॑णा॒ दिक् । स॒म्राड॑सि प्र॒तिची॒ दिक् । स्व॒राड॒स्युदी॑ची॒ दिक् । अधि॑पत्न्यसि बृह॒ती दिक् ।।
14.e:
Queen art thou, Quarter of the East. Wide-ruler, Quarter
 of the South. West Quarter, thou art Sovran. Thou
 Autocrat, Quarter of the North.
 Queen Paramount art thou, the Lofty Point.

14.d: वि॒श्वक॑र्मा त्वा सादयत्व॒न्तरि॑क्च्५अ॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे ज्योति॑ष्मतीम् । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नाय॒ विश्वं॒ ज्योति॑र्यच्छ । वा॒युष्टे धि॑पति॒स्तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ।।
14.e:
On the air's back may Visvakarman set thee luminous.
 Control all light for all breath, for out-breath, up-breath,
 through-breath.
 Thy Lord is Vâyu, with that Deity, Angiras-like, lie firm.

14.d: नभ॑श्च नभ॒स्य॑श्च॒ वार्षि॑कावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तःश्ले॒षो॑ सि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धयः॒ कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नयः॒ पृथ॒ङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय॒ सव्र॑ताः । ये अ॒ग्नयः॒ सम॑नसो न्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे वार्षि॑कावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒सं वि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम् ।।
14.e:
Two Rainy Seasons, Nabhas and Nabhasya—thou art the
 innermost cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).

14.d: इ॒षश्चो॒र्जश्च॑ शार॒दावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तःश्ले॒षो॑ सि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒प॒ ओष॑धयः॒ कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नयः॒ पृथ॒ङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय॒ सव्र॑ताः । ये अ॒ग्नयः॒ सम॑नसो न्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे शा॑र॒दावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒सं वि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम् ।।
14.e:
Isha and Ûrja, two Autumnal Seasons—thou art the innermost
 cement of Agni, etc.

14.d: आयु॑र्मे पाहि । प्रा॒णं मे॑ पाहि । अ॑पा॒नं मे॑ पाहि । व्या॒नं मे॑ पाहि । चक्षु॑र्मे पाहि । श्रोत्रं॑ मे पाहि । वाचं॑ मे पिन्व । मनो॑ मे जिन्व । आ॒त्मानं॑ मे पाहि । ज्योति॑र्मे यच्छ ।।
14.e:
Preserve my life. Preserve my breath. Guard mine
 out-breath. Preserve mine eyes. Preserve mine ears.
 Strengthen my voice. Quicken my mind. Preserve my
 self. Vouchsafe me light.

14.d: मा छन्दः॑ । प्र॒मा छन्दः॑ । प्र॑ति॒मा छन्दः॑ । अ॑म्री॒वय॒श्छन्दः॑ । प॒ङ्क्तिश्छन्दः॑ । उ॒ष्णिक्छन्दः॑ । बृ॑ह॒ती छन्दः॑ । अ॑नु॒ष्टुप्छन्दः॑ । वि॒राट्छन्दः॑ । गा॑य॒त्री छन्दः॑ । त्रि॒ष्टुप्छन्दः॑ । जग॑ती॒ छन्दः॑ ।।
14.e:
Mâ metre. Pramâ metre. Pratimâ metre. Âsrivayas metre.
 Pankti metre. Ushnih metre. Brihatî metre. Anushtup
 metre. Virâj metre. Gâyatrî metre, Trishtup metre.
 Jagatî metre.

14.d: पृ॑थि॒वी छन्दः॑ । अ॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ छन्दः॑ । द्यौ॒श्छन्दः॑ । समा॒श्छन्दः॑ । नक्ष॑त्राणि॒ छन्दः॑ । वाक्छन्दः॑ । मन॒श्छन्दः॑ । कृ॒षिश्छन्दः॑ । हिर॑ण्यं॒ छन्दः॑ । गौ॒श्छन्दः॑ । अ॒जा छन्दः॑ । अश्व॒श्छन्दः॑ ।।
14.e:
Earth metre. Sky metre. Heaven metre. Years metre.
 Nakshatras metre. Vâk metre. Mind metre. Husbandry
 metre. Gold metre. Cow metre. She-goat metre. Horse
 metre.

14.d: अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वता॑ । वातो॑ दे॒वता॑ । सूर्यो॑ दे॒वता॑ । च॒न्द्रमा॑ दे॒वता॑ । वस॑वो दे॒वता॑ । रु॒द्रा दे॒वता॑ । आ॑दि॒त्या दे॒वता॑ । म॒रुतो॑ दे॒वता॑ । विश्वे॑ दे॒वा दे॒वता॑ । बृह॒स्पति॑र्दे॒वता॑ । इन्द्रो॑ दे॒वता॑ । वरु॑णो दे॒वता॑ ।।
14.e:
The Deity Agni. The Deity Vita. The Deity Sûrya. The
 Deity Moon. The Deity Vasus. The Deity Rudras. The
 Deity Âdityas The Deity Maruts. The Deity Visvedevas.
 The Deity Brihaspati. The Deity Indra. The Deity
 Varuna.

14.d: मू॒र्धासि॒ राड्ध्रु॒वासि॑ ध॒रुणा॑ ध॒र्त्र्य॑सि॒ धर॑णी । आयु॑षे त्वा॒ वर्च॑से त्वा कृष्यै त्वा॒ क्षेमा॑य त्वा ।।
14.e:
Chief art thou, bright, supporting, firm, thou art the great
 sustainer, Earth.
 Thee for life, thee for lustre, thee for tillage, thee for peace
 and rest.

14.d: यन्त्री॒ राड्य॒न्त्र्य॑सि॒ यम॑नी ध्रु॒वासि॒ धरि॑त्री । इ॒षे त्वो॒र्जे त्वा॑ रय्यै त्वा॒ पोषा॑य त्वा । लो॒कं पृ॑ण छि॒द्रं पृ॒णाथो॑ सीद ध्रु॒वा त्वम् । इ॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी त्वा॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒स्मिन्योना॑वसीषदन् । ता अ॑स्य॒ सूद॑दोहसः॒ सोमँ॑ श्रीणन्ति॒ पृश्न॑यः । जन्म॑न्दे॒वानां॒ विश॑स्त्रि॒ष्वा रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः । इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिरः॑ । र॒थीत॑मँ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑नाँ॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म् ।।
14.e:
Controller, brilliant art thou, managing controller, firm
 sustainer. For strength, for energy thee, for riches thee,
 for prosperity thee.
 Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred
 songs, etc. (as in 10).

14.d: आ॒शुर्त्रि॒वृत् । भा॒न्तः प॑ञ्चद॒शः । व्यो॑मा सप्तद॒शः । धरु॑ण एकविँ॒शः । प्रतू॑र्तिरष्टाद॒शः । तपो॑ नवद॒शः । अ॑भीव॒र्तः स॑विँ॒शः । वर्चो॑ द्वाविँ॒शः । सं॒भर॑णस्त्रयोविँ॒शः । योनि॑श्चतुर्विँ॒शः । गर्भाः॑ पञ्चविँ॒शः । ओज॑स्त्रिण॒वः । क्रतु॑रेकत्रिँ॒शः । प्र॑ति॒ष्ठा त्र॑यस्त्रिँ॒शः । ब्र॒ध्नस्य॑ वि॒ष्टपं॑ चतुस्त्रिँ॒शः । नाकः॑ षट्त्रिँ॒शः । वि॑व॒र्तो॑ ष्टाचत्वारिँशः । ध॒र्त्रं च॑तुष्टो॒मः ।।
14.e:
This Swift, the triple praise-song. The Shining, the
 Pañchadasa hymn. Heaven, the Saptadasa. The Supporter, the
 Ekavimsa. Speed, the Ashtâdasa. Ardour, the Navadasa.
 Triumphant Onset, Savimsa, Vigour, Dvâvimsa. Maintenance,
 Trayovimsa. Womb, Chaturvimsa. Embryos,
 Pañchavimsa. Energy, the Trinava. Intention, the Ekatrimsa.
 The Basis, the Trayastrimsa. The Bright One's
 Station, the Chatustrimsa. The Vault of Heaven, the
 Shattrimsa. The Revolving One, the Ashtâchatvârimsa.
 The Support, the Four-divisioned praise-song.

14.d: अ॒ग्नेर्भा॒गो॑ सि दी॒क्षाया॒ आधि॑पत्यं॒ ब्रह्म॑ स्पृ॒तं त्रि॒वृत्स्तोमः॑ । इन्द्र॑स्य भा॒गो॑ सि॒ विष्णो॒राधि॑पत्यं क्स॒त्रँ स्पृ॒तं प॑ञ्चद॒शः स्तोमः॑ । नृ॒चक्ष॑सां भा॒गो॑ सि धा॒तुराधि॑पत्यं ज॒नित्रँ॑ स्पृ॒तँ स॑प्तद॒शः स्तोमः॑ । मि॒त्रस्य॑ भा॒गो॑ सि॒ वरु॑ण॒स्याधि॑पत्यं दि॒वो वृष्टि॒र्वात॑ स्पृ॒त ए॑कविँ॒श स्तोमः॑ ।।
14.e:
Thou art the portion of Agni, chief control of Consecration.
 The Priesthood is saved; the Trivrit Stoma.
 Thou art the portion of Indra, the sovranty of Vishnu. The
 Nobility is saved; the Pañchadasa Stoma.
 Thou art the share of the Man-beholders; the supremacy of
 the Creator; the birthplace is saved; the Saptadasa Stoma.
 Thou art the share of Mitra, the sovranty of Varuna. Rain
 of heaven and wind are saved; the Ekavimsa Stoma.

14.d: वसू॑नां भा॒गो॑ सि रु॒द्राणा॒माधि॑पत्यं॒ चतु॑ष्पात्स्पृ॒तं च॑तुर्विँ॒श स्तोमः॑ । आ॑दि॒त्यानां॑ भा॒गो॑ सि म॒रुता॒माधि॑पत्यं॒ गर्भा॑ स्पृ॒ताः प॑ञ्चविँश॒ स्तोमः॑ । अदि॑त्यै भा॒गो॑ सि पू॒ष्ण आधि॑पत्य॒मोज॑ स्पृ॒तं त्रि॑ण॒व स्तोमः॑ । दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुर्भा॒गो॑ सि॒ बृह॒स्पते॒राधि॑पत्यँ स॒मीची॒र्दिश॑ स्पृ॒ताश्च॑तुष्टो॒म स्तोमः॑ ।।
14.e:
Thou art the share of the Vasus, the sovranty of the Rudras.
 Quadrupeds are saved; the Chaturvimsa Stoma.
 Thou art the share of the Âdityas; the sovranty of the Maruts.
 The Embryos are saved; the
Pañchavimsa
 Stoma.
 Thou art the share of Aditi; the sovranty of Pûshan.
 Strength is saved; the Trinava Stoma.
 Thou art the share of God Savitar; the sovranty of Brihaspati.
 The universal Quarters are saved; the Chatushtoma
 Stoma.

14.d: यवा॑नां भा॒गो॒ स्यय॑वाना॒माधि॑पत्यं प्र॒जा स्पृ॒ताश्च॑तुश्चत्वारिँ॒श स्तोमः॑ । ऋ॑भू॒णां भा॒गो॑ सि॒ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वाना॒माधि॑पत्यं भू॒तँ स्पृ॒तं त्र॑यस्त्रिँ॒श स्तोमः॑ ।।
14.e:
Thou art the share of the Yavas; the sovranty of the Ayavas.
 Creatures are saved; the Chatuschatvârimsa Stoma.
 Thou art the share of the Ribhus; the sovranty of the
 Visvedevas. The Being is saved; the Trayastrimsa Stoma.

14.d: सह॑श्च सह॒स्य॑श्च हैमन्तिकावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तःश्ले॒षो॑ सि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धयः॒ कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नयः॒ पृथ॒ङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय॒ सव्र॑ताः । ये अ॒ग्नयः॒ सम॑नसो न्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे है॑मन्तिकावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒सं वि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम् ।।
14.e:
Sahas, Sahasya, the two Winter Seasons—thou art the innermost
 cement of Agni, etc. (as in XIII. 25).

14.d: एक॑यास्तुवत प्र॒जा अ॑धीयन्त प्र॒जाप॑ति॒रधि॑पतिरासीत् । ति॒सृभि॑रस्तुवत॒ ब्रह्मा॑सृज्यत॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒रधि॑पतिरासीत् । प॒ञ्चभि॑रस्तुवत भू॒तान्य॑सृज्यन्त भू॒तानां॒ पति॒रधि॑पतिरासीत् । स॒प्तभि॑रस्तुवत सप्त ऋ॒षयो॑ सृज्यन्त धा॒ताधि॑पतिरासीत् ।।
14.e:
With one they praised; creatures were produced. Prajâpati
 was over-lord.
 With three they praised; the Priesthood was created. Brihaspati
 was over-lord.

With five they praised; beings were created. The Lord of
 Beings was over-lord.
 With seven they praised; the Seven Rishis were created.
 Dhâtar was over-lord.

14.d: न॒वभि॑रस्तुवत पि॒तरो॑ सृज्य॒न्तादि॑ति॒रध्नि॑पत्न्यासीत् । ए॑काद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत ऋ॒तवो॑ सृज्यन्तार्त॒वा अधि॑पतय आसन् । त्र॑योद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत॒ मासा॑ असृज्यन्त संवत्स॒रो धि॑पतिरासीत् । प॑ञ्चद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत क्ष॒त्रम॑सृज्य॒तेन्द्रो॑ धिपतिरासीत् । स॑प्तद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत ग्रा॒म्याः प॒शवो॑ सृज्यन्त॒ बृह॒स्पति॒रधि॑पतिरासीत् ।।
14.e:
With nine they praised; the Fathers were created. Aditi
 was Sovran Lady.
 With eleven they praised; the Seasons were created. The
 Season-Lords were over-lords.
 With thirteen they praised; the Months were created. The
 Year was over-lord.
 With fifteen they praised; the Nobility was created. Indra
 was over-lord.
 With seventeen they praised; domestic animals were created.
 Brihaspati was over-lord.

14.d: न॑वद॒शभि॑रस्तुवत शूद्रा॒र्याव॑सृज्येतामहोरा॒त्रे अधि॑पत्नी आस्ताम् । एक॑विँशत्यास्तुवतैकशपाः प॒शवो॑ सृज्यन्त॒ वरु॑णो धिपतिरासीत् । त्रयो॑विँशत्यास्तुवत क्षु॒द्रां प॒शवो॑ सृज्यन्त पू॒षाधि॑पतिरासीत् । पञ्च॑विँशत्यास्तुवतार॒ण्याः प॒शवो॑ सृज्यन्त वा॒युरधि॑पतिरासीत् । स॒प्तविँ॑शत्यास्तुवत॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी व्यै॑तां॒ वस॑वो रु॒द्रा आ॑दि॒त्या अ॑नु॒व्या॑यँ॒स्त ए॒वाधि॑पतय आसन् ।।
14.e:
With nineteen they praised; Sûdra and Arya were created.
 Day and Night were Sovran Ladies.
 With twenty-one they praised; solid-hoofed animals were
 created. Varuna was over-lord.
 With twenty-three they praised; small animals were created.
 Pûshan was over-lord.
 With twenty-five they praised; forest animals were created.
 Vâyu was over-lord.
 With twenty-seven they praised; earth and heaven came
 apart. Vasus, Rudras, Âdityas followed separately, so
 they were over-lords.

14.d: नव॑सिँशत्यास्तुवत॒ वन॒स्पत॑यो सृज्यन्त॒ सोमो धि॑पतिरासीत् । एक॑त्रिँशतास्तुवत प्र॒जा अ॑सृज्यन्त॒ यवा॒श्चाय॑वा॒श्चाधि॑पतय आसन् । त्रय॑स्त्रिँशतास्तुवत भू॒तान्य॑शाम्यन्प्र॒जाप॑तिः परमे॒ष्ठ्यधि॑पतिरासीत् । लो॒कं पृ॑ण छि॒द्रं पृ॒णाथो॑ सीद ध्रु॒वा त्वम् । इ॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी त्वा॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒स्मिन्योना॑वसीषदन् । ता अ॑स्य॒ सूद॑दोहसः॒ सोमँ॑ श्रीणन्ति॒ पृश्न॑यः । जन्म॑न्दे॒वानां॒ विश॑स्त्रि॒ष्वा रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः । इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिरः॑ । र॒थीत॑मँ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑नाँ॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म् ।।
14.e:
With twenty-nine they praised; Trees were created. Soma
 was over-lord.
 With thirty-one they praised; creatures were created. The
 Yavas and the Ayavas were over-lords.
 With thirty-three they praised; living beings. were happy.
 Prajâpati, the Supreme in Place, was over-lord.
 Fill up the room, etc. The dappled kine, etc. All sacred
 songs, etc. Repeated from XII. 14-16.

15.d: अग्ने॑ जा॒तान्प्र णु॑द नः स॒पत्ना॒न्प्रत्यजा॑तान्नुद जातवेदः । अधि॑ नो ब्रूहि सु॒मना॒ अहे॑डँ॒स्तव॑ स्याम॒ शर्मँ॑स्त्रि॒वरू॑थ उद्भौ ।।
15.e:
DRIVE our born enemies away, O Agni; drive from us foes
 unborn, O Jâtavedas.
 Graciously-minded, free from anger, bless us: may we enjoy
 my firm thrice-guarding shelter.
 Drive off with might our foemen born and living: keep off
 these yet unborn, O Jâtavedas.
 Benevolent in thought and spirit bless us. May we remain
 alive: drive off our foemen.

15.d: सह॑सा जा॒तान्प्र णु॑दा नः स॒पत्ना॒न्प्रत्यजा॑तान्जातवेदो नुदस्व । अधि॑ नो ब्रूहि सुमन॒स्यमा॑नो व॒यँ स्या॑म॒ प्र णु॑दा नः स॒पत्ना॑न् ।।
15.e:
The Sixteenfold Stoma, strength and wealth. The Forty-
 fourth Stoma, splendour and wealth.
 Apsas art thou, the complement of Agni. As such may all
 the Gods greet thee with praises.
 Enriched with songs of praise, Prishthas, and butter, sit here
 and give us wealth with store of children.

15.d: षो॑ड॒शी स्तोम॒ ओजो॒ द्रवि॑णम् । च॑तुश्चत्वारिँ॒श स्तोमो॒ वर्चो॒ द्रवि॑णम् । अ॒ग्नेः पुरी॑षमस्य॒ अप्सो॒ नाम॒ तां त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒भि गृ॑णन्तु दे॒वाः । स्तोम॑पृष्ठा घृ॒तव॑ती॒ह सी॑द प्र॒जाव॑द॒स्मे द्र॑वि॒णा य॑जस्व ।।
15.e:
Course metre. Space metre. Happy metre, Encompassing
 metre. Covering metre. Mind metre. Expanse
 metre. River metre. Sea metre. Water metre. Kakup
 metre. Trikakup metre. Kâvya metre. Ankupa metre
 Aksharapankti metre. Padapankti metre. Vishtârapankti
 metre. Kshurabhrâja metre.

15.d: एव॒श्छन्दः॑ । वरि॑व॒श्छन्दः॑ । शं॒भूश्छन्दः॑ । प॑रि॒भूश्छन्दः॑ । आ॒च्छच्छन्दः॑ । मन॒श्छन्दः॑ । व्यच॒श्छन्दः॑ । सिन्धु॒श्छन्दः॑ । स॑मु॒द्रश्छन्दः॑ । स॑रि॒रं छन्दः॑ । क॒कुप्छन्दः॑ । त्रि॑क॒कुप्छन्दः॑ । का॒व्यं छन्दः॑ । अ॑ङ्कु॒पं छन्दः॑ । अ॒क्षर॑पङ्क्ति॒श्छन्दः॑ । प॒दप॑ङ्क्ति॒श्छन्दः॑ । वि॑ष्टा॒रप॑ङ्क्ति॒श्छन्दः॑ । क्षु॒रो भ्राज॒श्छन्दः॑ ।।
15.e:
Covering metre. Clothing metre. Collecting metre. Parting
 metre. Brihat metre. Rathantara metre, Group
 metre. Vivadhra metre. Swallower metre. Bright metre.
 Samstup metre. Anushtup metre. Course metre. Space
 metre. Vigour metre. Vigour-giving metre. Emulating
 metre. Spacious metre, Inaccessible metre. Slow metre.
 Ankânka metre.

15.d: आ॒च्छच्छन्दः॑ । प्र॒च्छच्छन्दः॑ । सं॒यच्छन्दः॑ । वि॒यच्छन्दः॑ । बृ॒हच्छन्दः॑ । र॑थन्त॒रं छन्दः॑ । नि॑का॒यश्छन्दः॑ । वि॑व॒धश्छन्दः॑ । गिर॒श्छन्दः॑ । भ्रज॒श्छन्दः॑ । सँ॒स्तुप्छन्दः॑ । अ॑नु॒ष्टुप्छन्दः॑ । एव॒श्छन्दः॑ । वरि॑व॒श्छन्दः॑ । वय॒श्छन्दः॑ । व॑य॒स्कृच्छन्दः॑ । विच्५ष्प॑र्धा॒श्छन्दः॑ । वि॑शा॒लं छन्दः॑ । छ॒दिश्छन्दः॑ । दू॑रोह॒णं छन्दः॑ । त॒न्द्रं छन्दः॑ । अ॑ङ्का॒ङ्कं छन्दः॑ ।।
15.e:
With the ray for truth quicken thou truth. With advance
 by duty quicken duty. With following by heaven quicken
 heaven. With union by middle air quicken middle air.
 With Pratidhi by Earth quicken Earth. With support
 by rain quicken rain. With blowing away by day quicken
 day. With following by eight quicken night. With
 clarified butter by the Vasus quicken the Vasus. With
 perception by the Âdityas quicken the Âdityas.

15.d: र॒श्मिना॑ स॒त्याय॑ स॒त्यं जि॑न्व । प्रेति॑ना॒ धर्म॑णा॒ धर्मं॑ जिन्व । अन्वि॑त्या दि॒वा दिवं॑ जिन्व । सं॒धिना॒न्तरि॑क्षेणा॒न्तरि॑क्षं जिन्व । प्र॑ति॒धिन्पृ॑थि॒व्या पृ॑थि॒वीं जि॑न्व । वि॑ष्ट॒म्भेन॒ वृष्ट्या॒ वृस्टिं॑ जिन्व । प्र॒वयाह्नाह॑र्जिन्व । अ॑नु॒या रत्र्या॒ रात्रीं॑ जिन्व । उ॒शिजा॒ वसु॑भ्यो॒ वसू॑न्जिन्व । प्र॑के॒तेना॑दि॒त्येभ्य॑ आदि॒त्यान्जि॑न्व ।।
15.e:
With the thread by prosperity quicken prosperity. With
 the creeper by revelation quicken revelation. With
 refreshment by plants quicken plants. With the best by
 bodies quicken bodies. With the invigorating by religious
 study quicken religious study. With the victorious by
 brilliance quicken brilliance.

15.d: तन्तु॑ना रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण रा॒यस्पोषं॑ जिन्व । सँ॒सर्पे॑ण श्रु॒ताय॑ श्रु॒तं जि॑न्व । अै॒डेनौ॑षधीभि॒रोष॑धीर्जिन्व । उ॑त्त॒मेन॑ त॒नूभि॑स्त॒नूर्जि॑न्व । व॑यो॒धसाधी॑तेअ॒नाधी॑तं जिन्व । अ॑भि॒जिता॒ तेज॑सा॒ तेजो॑ जिन्व ।।
15.e:
Thou art Pratipad, for Pratipad thee. Thou art Anupad,
 for Anupad thee. Thou art Sampad, for Sampad thee.
 Thou art brilliance, for brilliance thee.

15.d: प्र॑ति॒पद॑सि प्रति॒पदे॑ त्वा । अ॑नु॒पद॑स्यनु॒पदे॑ त्वा । स॒म्पद॑सि स॒म्पदे॑ त्वा । तेजो॑ सि॒ तेज॑से त्वा ।।
15.e:
Trivrit (triple) art thou, thee for Trivrit. Pravrit art thou,
 thee for Pravrit. Vivrit art thou, thee for Vivrit. Savrit
 art thou, thee for Savrit. Thou art attack, thee for attack.
 Thou art concurrence, thee for concurrence. Thou art
 ascent, thee for ascent. Thou art upstriding, thee for
 upstriding. With Energy as
over-lord
 quicken
 food-essence.

15.d: त्रि॒वृद॑सि त्रि॒वृते॑ त्वा । प्र॒वृद॑सि प्र॒वृते॑ त्वा । वि॒वृद॑सि वि॒वृते॑ त्वा । स॒वृद॑सि स॒वृते॑ त्वा । आ॑क्र॒मो॑ स्याक्र॒माय॑ त्वा । सं॑क्र॒मो॑ सि संक्र॒माय॑ त्वा । उ॑त्क्र॒मो॑ स्युत्क्र॒माय॑ त्वा । उत्क्रा॑न्तिर॒स्युत्क्रा॑न्त्यै त्वा । अधि॑पतिनो॒र्जोर्जं॑ जिन्व ।।
15.e:
Thou art the Queen, the Eastern region. The bright Vasus
 are thine overlords. Agni is thy warder-off of hostile
 weapons. May the Trivrit Stoma assist thee on earth.
 The Âjya Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The
 Rathantara Sâman establish thee in the sky for secure
 station. May the first-born Rishis extend thee among the

Gods by the measure and amplitude of heaven. May
 this Disposer and the Over-Lord extend thee. May all,
 concordant, settle thee on the ridge of heaven in the
 world of Svarga.

15.d: राज्ञ्य॑सि॒ प्राची॒ दिग्वस॑वस्ते दे॒वा अधि॑पतयो॒ ग्निर्हे॑ती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्ता त्रि॒वृत्त्वा॒ स्तोमः॑ पृथि॒व्याँ श्र॑य॒त्वाज्य॑मु॒क्थमव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नातु रथन्त॒रँ साम॒ प्रति॑ष्�त्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ता नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु ।।
15.e:
Thou art Far-ruling, the Southern region. The bright
 Rudras are thine over-lords. Indra is thy warder-off of
 arrows. May the Pañchadasa Stoma support thee on
 earth. The Praüga Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping.
 The Brihat Sâman establish thee in the sky, etc. (the rest
 as in 10).

15.d: वि॒राड॑सि॒ दक्षि॑णा॒ दिग्रु॒द्रास्ते॑ दे॒वा अधि॑पतय॒ इन्द्रो॑ हेती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्ता प॑ञ्चद�स्त्वा॒ स्तोमः॑ पृथि॒व्याँ श्र॑यतु॒ प्रउग॑मु॒क्थमव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नातु बृ॒हत्साम॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ता नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु ।।
15.e:
Thou art Universal Ruler, the Western region. The Âdityas
 are thine over-lords. Varuna is thy warder-off of missiles.
 The Saptadasa Stoma support thee on earth. The Marutvatîya
 Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The
 Vairûpa Sâman establish thee, etc. (as above).

15.d: स॒म्राड॑सि प्र॒तीची॒ दिगा॑दि॒त्यास्ते॑ दे॒वा अधि॑पतयो॒ वरु॑णो हेती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्ता स॑प्तद�स्त्वा॒ स्तोमः॑ पृथि॒व्याँ श्र॑यतु मरुत्व॒तीय॑मु॒क्थमव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नातु वैरू॒पँ साम॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ता नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु ।।
15.e:
Thou art Independent Ruler, the Northern region. (The
 rest is identical with 12, with the substitution of Maruts
 . . . Soma . . . .Vimsa Stoma . . . Nishkevalya Uktha. . . . Vairâja
 Sâman for the corresponding names).

15.d: स्व॒राड॒स्युदी॒च्य्दिङ्म॒रुत॑स्ते दे॒वा अधि॑पतयः॒ सोमो॑ हेती॒नां प्र॑तिधर्तैकविँ॒शस्त्वा॒ स्तोमः॑ पृथि॒व्याँ श्र॑यतु॒ निष्के॑वल्यमु॒क्थमव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नातु वैरा॒जँ साम॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ता नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु ।।
15.e:
Thou art Lady-Paramount, the Lofty region. (The rest as
 above, Visvedevas. . . Brihaspati . . .Trinava and Trayastrimsa
 Stomas . . .Vaisvadeva and Mâruta Ukthas . . . Sâkvara and
 Raivata Sâmans being substituted for the corresponding
 names.

15.d: अधि॑पत्न्यसि बृह॒ती दिग्विश्वे॑ ते दे॒वा अधि॑पतयो॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्हेती॒नां प्र॑तिध॒र्ता त्रि॑णवत्रयस्त्रिँशौ त्वा॒ स्तोमौ॑ पृथि॒व्याँ श्र॑यतां वैश्वदेवाग्निमारु॒ते उ॒क्थे अव्य॑थायै स्तभ्नीताँ शाक्वररैव॒ते साम॑नी॒ प्रति॑ष्ठित्या अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ ऋष॑यस्त्वा प्रथम॒जा दे॒वेषु॑ दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थन्तु विध॒र्ता चा॒यमधि॑पतिश्च॒ ते त्वा॒ सर्वे॑ संविदा॒ता नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठे स्व॒र्गे लो॒के यज॑मानं च सादयन्तु ।।
15.e:
This one in front, golden-tressed, with sunbeams; the leader
 of his host and his chieftain are Rathagritsa and Rathaujas,
 and Puñjikasthalâ: and Kratusthalâ his Apsarases.
 Biting animals are his weapon, homicide his missile weapon;
 to them be homage: may they protect us, may
 they have mercy upon us. In their jaws we place the
 man whom we hate and who hates us.
