15.d: अ॒यं पु॒रो हरि॑केशः॒ सूर्य॑रश्मि॒स्तस्य॑ रथगृ॒त्सश्च॒ रथौ॑जाश्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्या॑ । पु॑ञ्जिकस्थ॒ला च॑ क्रतुस्थ॒ला चा॑प्स॒रसौ॑ द॒ङ्क्ष्णवः॑ प॒शवो॑ हे॒तिः पौ॑रुषेयो व॒धः प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ वन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ।।
15.e:
This one on the right, the Omnific; the leader of his host
 and his chieftain are Rathasvana and Rathechitra, and
 Menakâ and Sahajanyâ his Apsarases. Yâtudhânas are
 his weapon, Râkshasas his missile weapon; to them be
 homage, etc. (as in 15).

15.d: अ॒यं द॑क्षि॒णा वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ तस्य॑ रथस्व॒नश्च॒ रथे॑चित्रश्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्या॑ । मे॑न॒का च॑ सहज॒न्या चा॑प्स॒रसौ॑ यातुधा॒ना हे॒ती रक्षाँ॑सि॒ प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ वन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ।।
15.e:
This one behind, the All-comprising; the leader of his
 host and his chieftain are Rathaprota and Asamaratha,
 and Pramlochantî and Anumochlantî are his Apsarases.
 Tigers are his weapon, Serpents his missile weapon; to
 them be homage, etc.

15.d: अ॒यं प॒श्चाद्वि॒श्वव्य॑चा॒स्तस्य॒ रथ॑प्रो॒तश्चास॑मरथश्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्या॑ । प्र॒म्लोच॑न्ती चानु॒म्लोच॑न्ती चाप्स॒रसौ॑ व्या॒घ्रा हे॒तिः स॒र्पा प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ न मोअ॑स्तु॒ ते नो॑ वन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ।।
15.e:
This one on the left, Lord of uninterrupted riches; the
 leader of his host and his chieftain are Târkshya and
 Arishtanemi, and Visvâchî and Ghritâchi his Apsarases.
 Water is his weapon, wind his missile weapon; to them
 be homage, etc.

15.d: अ॒यमु॑त्त॒रात्सं॒यद्व॑सु॒स्तस्य॒ तार्क्ष्य॒श्चारि॑ष्टनेमिश्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्या॑ । वि॒श्वाची॑ च घृ॒ताची॑ चाप्स॒रसा॒वापो॑ हे॒तिर्वातः॒ प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ वन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ।।
15.e:
This one above, Wealth-giver; the leader of his host and his
 chieftain are Senajit and Sushena, and Urvasi and Pûrvachitti
 his Apsarases. Thundering is his weapon and lightning
 his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.

15.d: अ॒यमु॒पर्य॒र्वाग्व॑सु॒स्तस्य॑ सेन॒जिच्च॑ सु॒षेण॑श्च सेनानीग्राम॒ण्या॑ । उ॒र्वशी॑ च पू॒र्वचि॑त्तिश्चाप्स॒रसा॑वव॒स्पूर्ज॑न्हे॒तिर्वि॒द्युत्प्रहे॑ति॒स्तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ वन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ।।
15.e:
Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth
 is he. He quickeneth the waters’ seed.

15.d: अ॒ग्निर्मू॒र्धा दि॒वः क॒कुत्पतिः॑ पृथि॒व्या अ॒यम् । अ॒पाँ रेताँ॑सि जिन्वति ।।
15.e:
This Agni is the Master of spoil thousandfold and
 hundredfold, the sapient one, the head of wealth.

15.d: अ॒यम॒ग्निः स॑ह॒स्रिणो॒ वाज॑स्य श॒तिन॒स्पतिः॑ । मू॒र्धा क॒वी र॑यी॒णाम् ।।
15.e:
Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the
 lotus-leaf, the head of Visva, of the Priest.

15.d: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ पुष्क॑रा॒दध्यथ॑र्वा॒ निर॑मन्थत । मू॒र्ध्नो विश्व॑स्य वा॒घतः॑ ।।
15.e:
Guide of the rite art thou and of the region to which with
 thine auspicious teams thou tendest.
 Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy
 tongue oblation-bearer, Agni.

15.d: भुवो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ रज॑सश्च ने॒ता यत्रा॑ नि॒युद्भिः॒ सच॑से शि॒वाभिः॑ । दि॒वि मू॒र्धानं॑ दधिषे स्व॒र्षां जि॒ह्वाम॑ग्ने चकृषे हव्य॒वाह॑म् ।।
15.e:
Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who
 cometh like a milch-cow.
 Like young trees shooting up on high their branches his
 flames are rising to the vault of heaven.

15.d: अबो॑ध्य॒ग्निः स॒मिधा॒ जना॑नां॒ प्रति॑ धे॒नुमि॑वाय॒तीमु॒षास॑म् । य॒ह्वा इ॑व॒ प्र व॒यामु॒ज्जिहा॑नाः॒ प्र भा॒नवः॑ सिस्रते॒ नाक॒मच्छ॑ ।।
15.e:
To him adorable, sage, strong and mighty we have sung
 forth our song of praise and homage.
 Gavishthira hath raised with prayer to Agni this laud
 far-reaching as the gold in heaven.

15.d: अवो॑चाम क॒वये॒ मेध्या॑य॒ वचो॑ व॒न्दारु॑ वृष॒भाय॒ वृष्णे॑ । गवि॑ष्ठिरो॒ नम॑सा॒ स्तोम॑मग्नौ दि॒वी॑व रु॒क्ममु॑रु॒व्यञ्च॑मश्रेत् ।।
15.e:
Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best
 at worship, to be praised at rites;
 Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine bright-coloured
 in the wood, spreading to every house.

15.d: अ॒यमि॒ह प्र॑थ॒मो धा॑यि धा॒तृभि॒र्होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रेष्वीड्यः॑ । यमप्न॑वानो॒ भृग॑वो विरुरु॒चुर्वने॑षु चि॒त्रं वि॒भ्वं॑ वि॒शेवि॑शे ।।
15.e:
The watchful Guardian of the people hath been born, Agni
 the very strong, for fresh prosperity.
 With oil upon his face, with high heaven-touching flame, he
 shineth splendidly, pure for the Bharatas.

15.d: जन॑स्य गो॒पा अ॑जनिष्ट॒ जागृ॑विर॒ग्निः सु॒दक्षः॑ सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से । घृ॒तप्र॑तीको बृह॒ता दि॑वि॒स्पृशा॑ द्यु॒मद्वि भा॑ति भर॒तेभ्यः॒ शुचिः॑ ।।
15.e:
Agni, Angirases discovered thee what time thou layest hidden,
 fleeing back from wood to wood.
 Thou by attrition art produced as conquering, might, and
 men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.

15.d: त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ अङ्गि॑रसो॒ गुहा॑ हि॒तमन्व॑विन्दञ्छिश्रिया॒णं वने॑वने । स जा॑यसे म॒थ्यमा॑नः॒ सहो॑ म॒हत्त्वामा॑हुः॒ सह॑सस्पु॒त्रम॑ङ्गिरः ।।
15.e:
Offer to Agni, O my friends, your seemly food, your seemly
 praise;
 To him supremest o’er the folk, the Son of Strength, the
 Mighty Lord.

15.d: सखा॑यः॒ सं वः॑ स॒म्यञ्च॒मिषँ॒ स्तोमं॑ चा॒ग्नये॑ । वर्षि॑ष्ठाय क्षिती॒नामू॒र्जो नप्त्रे॒ सह॑स्वते ।।
15.e:
Thou, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy
 friend:
 Bring us all treasure as thou art enkindled in libation's place.

15.d: सँस॒मिद्यु॑वसे वृष॒न्नग्ने॒ विश्वा॑न्य॒र्य आ । इ॒डस्प॒दे समि॑ध्यसे॒ स नो॒ वसू॒न्या भ॑र ।।
15.e:
O Agni, loved of many, thou of fame most wondrous, in
 their homes
 Men call on thee whose hair is flame to be the bearer of
 their gifts.

15.d: त्वां चि॑त्रश्रवस्तम॒ हव॑न्ते वि॒क्षु ज॒न्तवः॑ । शो॒चिष्के॑शं पुरुप्रि॒याग्ने॑ ह॒व्याय॒ वोढ॑वे ।।
15.e:
With this my reverent hymn I call Agni for you, the Son.
 of Strength,
 Dear, wisest envoy, served with noble sacrifice, immortal
 messenger of all.

15.d: ए॒ना वो॑ अ॒ग्निं नम॑सो॒र्जो नपा॑त॒मा हु॑वे । प्रि॒यं चेति॑ष्ठमर॒तिँ स्व॑ध्व॒रं विश्व॑स्य दू॒तम॒मृत॑म् ।।
15.e:
Immortal messenger of all, immortal messenger of all,
 His two red steeds, all-cherishing; he harnesseth: let him,
 well-worshipped, urge them fast.

15.d: विश्व॑स्य दू॒तम॒मृतं॒ विश्व॑स्य दू॒तम॒मृत॑म् । स यो॑जते अरु॒षा वि॒श्वभो॑जसा॒ स दु॑द्रव॒त्स्वा॑हुतः ।।
15.e:
Let him well-worshipped urge them fast, let him
 well-worshipped urge them fast.
 Then hath the sacrifice good prayer and happy end, and
 heavenly gift of wealth to men.

15.d: स दु॑द्रव॒त्स्वा॑हुतः॒ स दु॑द्रव॒त्स्वा॑हुतः । सु॒ब्रह्मा॑ य॒ज्ञः सु॒शमी॒ वसू॑नां दे॒वँ राधो॒ जना॑नाम् ।।
15.e:
O Agni, thou who art the Lord of wealth in kine, the Son
 of Strength,
 Vouchsafe to us, O Jâtavedas, high renown.

15.d: अग्ने॒ वाज॑स्य॒ गोम॑त॒ ईशा॑नः सहसो यहो । अ॒स्मे धे॑हि जातवेदो॒ महि॒ श्रवः॑ ।।
15.e:
He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be exalted in our
 song:
 Shine, thou of many forms, shine radiantly on us.

15.d: स इ॑धा॒नो वसु॑ष्क॒विर॒ग्निरी॒डेन्यो॑ गि॒रा । रे॒वद॒स्मभ्यं॑ पुर्वणीक दीदिहि ।।
15.e:
O Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning
 breaks,
 Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Râkshasas.

15.d: क्ष॒पो रा॑जन्नु॒त त्मनाग्ने॒ वस्तो॑रु॒तोषसः॑ । स ति॑ग्मजम्भ र॒क्षसो॑ दह॒ प्रति॑ ।।
15.e:
May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed
 One! and sacrifice bring bliss,
 Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.

15.d: भ॒द्रो नो॑ अ॒ग्निराहु॑तो भ॒द्रा रा॒तिः सु॑भग भ॒द्रो अ॑ध्व॒रः । भ॒द्रा उ॒त प्रश॑स्तयः ।।
15.e:
Yea, may our praises bring us bliss. Show forth the mind
 that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou
 conquerest in fights:

15.d: भ॒द्रा उ॒त प्रश॑स्तयो भ॒द्रं मनः॑ कृणुष्व वृत्र॒तूर्ये॑ । येना॑ स॒मत्सु॑ सा॒सहः॑ ।।
15.e:
Wherewith thou conquerest in fights. Bring down the many
 firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine
 aid.

15.d: येना॑ स॒मत्सु॑ सा॒सहो व॑ स्थि॒रा त॑नुहि॒ भूरि॒ शर्ध॑ताम् । व॒नेमा॑ ते अ॒भिष्टि॑भिः ।।
15.e:
I value Agni, that good Lord, the home to which the kind
 return;
 Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring
 steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

15.d: अ॒ग्निं तं म॑न्ये॒ यो वसु॒रस्तं॒ यं यन्ति॑ धे॒नवः॑ । अस्त॒मर्व॑न्त आ॒शवो स्तं॒ नित्या॑सो वा॒जिन॒ इषँ॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र ।।
15.e:
’Tis Agni whom we laud as good, to whom the milch-kine
 come in herds,
 To whom the coursers swift of foot, to whom our well-born
 princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

15.d: सो अ॒ग्निर्यो वसु॑र्गृ॒णे सं यमा॒यन्ति॑ धे॒नवः॑ । समर्व॑न्तो रघु॒द्रुवः॒ सँ सु॑जा॒तासः॑ सू॒रय॒ इषँ॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र ।।
15.e:
Thou, brilliant God, within thy mouth warmest both ladles
 of the oil.
 So fill us also in our hymns abundantly, O Lord of Strength.
 Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

15.d: उ॒भे सु॑श्चन्द्र स॒र्पिषो॒ दर्वी॑ श्रीणीष आ॒सनि॑ । उ॒तो न॒ उत्पु॑पूर्या उ॒क्थेषु॑ शवसस्पत॒ इषँ॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र ।।
15.e:
Agni, with lauds this day may we bring thee that which
 thou lovest,
 Right judgment, like a horse, with our devotions.

15.d: अग्ने॒ तम॒द्याश्वं॒ न स्तोमैः॒ क्रतुं॒ न भ॒द्रँ हृ॑दि॒स्पृश॑म् । ऋ॒ध्यामा॑ त॒ ओहैः॑ ।।
15.e:
For thou hast ever been the car-driver, Agni, of noble
 Strength, lofty sacrifice, and rightful judgment.

15.d: अधा॒ ह्य॑ग्ने॒ क्रतो॑र्भ॒द्रस्य॒ दक्ष॑स्य सा॒धोः । र॒थीरृ॒तस्य॑ बृह॒तो ब॒भूथ॑ ।।
15.e:
Through these our praises come thou to meet us, bright as
 the sunlight,
 O Agni, well-disposed, with all thine aspects.

15.d: ए॒भिर्नो॑ अर्कै॒र्भवा॑ नो अ॒र्वाङ्स्व॒र्ण ज्योतिः॑ । अग्ने॒ विश्वे॑भिः सु॒मना॒ अनी॑कैः ।।
15.e:
Agni I hold as Herald, the munificent, the gracious Son of
 Strength who knoweth all that live, as holy singer knowing
 all;
 Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected, turning to the
 Gods,
 He, when the flame hath sprung forth from the sacred oil,
 the offered fatness, longeth for it with his glow.

15.d: अ॒ग्निँ होता॑रं मन्ये॒ दास्व॑न्तं॒ वसुँ॑ सू॒नुँ सह॑सो जा॒तवे॑दसं॒ विप्रं॒ न जा॒तवे॑दसम् । य ऊ॒र्ध्वया॑ स्वध्व॒रो दे॒वो दे॒वाच्या॑ कृ॒पा । घृ॒तस्य॒ विभ्रा॑ष्टि॒मनु॑ वष्टि शो॒चिषा॒जुह्वा॑नस्य स॒र्पिषः॑ ।।
15.e:
O Agni, be our nearest Friend, be thou a kind deliverer and
 a gracious Friend.
 Come as good Agni, come as excellent and give us wealth
 most splendidly renowned.
 To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with
 prayer for happiness for our friends.

15.d: अग्ने॒ त्वं नो॒ अन्त॑म उ॒त त्रा॒ता शि॒वो भ॑व वरू॒थ्यः॑ । वसु॑र॒ग्निर्वसु॑श्रवा॒ अच्छा॑ नक्षि द्यु॒मत्त॑मँ र॒यिं दाः॑ । तं त्वा॑ शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सु॒म्नाय॑ नू॒नमी॑महे॒ सखि॑भ्यः ।।
15.e:
With what devotion, winning light, the Rishis came, kindling
 Agni, to the Holy session,
 Even with that in heaven I stablish Agni whom men call
 him whose sacred grass is scattered.

15.d: येन॒ ऋष॑य॒स्तप॑सा स॒त्रमाय॒न्निन्धा॑ना अ॒ग्निँ स्व॑रा॒भर॑न्तः । तस्मि॑न्न॒हं नि द॑धे॒ नाके॑ अ॒स्ग्निं यमा॒हुर्मन॑व स्ती॒र्णब॑र्हिषम् ।।
15.e:
Gods, let us follow him with wives beside us, with sons, with
 brothers, with our gold adornments,
 Grasping the sky up in the world of virtue, on the third
 height, the luminous realm of heaven.

15.d: तं पत्नी॑भि॒रनु॑ गच्छेम देवाः पुत्रै॒र्भ्रातृ॑भिरु॒त वा॒ हिर॑ण्यैः । नाकं॑ गृभ्णा॒नाः सु॑कृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के तृ॒तीये॑ पृ॒ष्ठे अधि॑ रोच॒ने दि॒वः ।।
15.e:
This Agni mounted up to Speech's Centre, Lord of the
 Brave, observant, ever-active.
 Laid on the back of Earth, may he, resplendent, cast under
 foot those who would fight against us.

15.d: आ वा॒चो मध्य॑मरुहद्गुर॒ण्युर॒यम॒ग्निः सत्प॑ति॒श्चेकि॑तानः । पृ॒ष्ठे पृ॑थि॒व्या निहि॑तो॒ दवि॑द्युतद॒धस्प॒दं कृ॑णुतां॒ ये पृ॑त॒न्यवः॑ ।।
15.e:
May this most manly Agni, strength-bestower, giver of thousands,
 shine with care that fails not.
 Resplendent in the middle of the water, make thine approach
 to the celestial mansions.

15.d: अ॒यम॒ग्निर्वी॒रत॑मो वयो॒धाः स॑ह॒स्रियो॑ द्योतता॒मप्र॑युच्छन् । वि॒भ्राज॑मानः सरि॒रस्य॒ मध्य॒ उप॒ प्र या॑हि दि॒व्यानि॒ धाम॑ ।।
15.e:
Make him go forth from all sides: meet, Approach ye. O
 Agni, make the paths for Godward travel.
 Making the Parents young with life's renewal, the out spun
 thread in thee have they extended.

15.d: स॒म्प्र च्य॑वध्व॒मुप॑ स॒म्प्र या॑ताग्ने प॒थो दे॑व॒याना॑न्कृणुध्वम् । पुनः॑ कृण्वा॒ना पि॒तरा॒ युवा॑ना॒न्वा ताँ॑सी॒त्त्वयि॒ तन्तु॑मे॒तम् ।।
15.e:
Wake up, O Agni, thou, and keep him watchful. Wish and
 fruition, meet, and he, together.
 In this and in the loftier habitation be seated, All-Gods!
 and the Sacrificer.

15.d: उद्बु॑ध्यस्वाग्ने॒ प्रति॑ जागृहि॒ त्वमि॑ष्टापू॒र्ते सँ सृ॑जेथाम॒यं च॑ । अ॒स्मिन्त्स॒धस्थे॒ अध्युत्त॑रस्मि॒न्विस्वे॑ देवा॒ यज॑मानाश्च सीदत ।।
15.e:
Convey our sacrifice to heaven that it may reach the God
 with that

Whereby thou, Agni, bearest wealth in thousands and all
 precious things.

15.d: येन॒ वह॑सि स॒हस्रं॒ येना॑ग्ने सर्ववेद॒सम् । तेने॒मं य॒ज्ञं नो॑ नय॒ स्व॑र्दे॒वेषु॒ गन्त॑वे ।।
15.e:
56 This is thine ordered place of birth whence sprung to life
 thou shonest forth.
 Knowing this, Agni, rise thou up and cause our riches to
 increase.

15.d: अ॒यं ते॒ योनि॑रृ॒त्वियो॒ यतो॑ जा॒तो अरो॑चथाः । तं जा॒नन्न॑ग्न आरो॒हाथा॑ नो वर्धया र॒यिम् ।।
15.e:
Tapa, Tapasya, pair of Dewy Seasons: thou art, etc. (as
 in XIII. 25).

15.d: तप॑श्च तप॒स्य॑श्च शैशि॒रावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तःश्ले॒षो॑ सि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्�प॒ ओष॑धयः॒ कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नयः॒ पृथ॒ङ्नम ज्यैष्ठ्याय॒ सव्र॑ताः । ये अ॒ग्नयः॒ सम॑नसो न्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे शै॑शि॒रावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒सं वि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम् ।।
15.e:
On the sky's back may Parameshthin lay thee, etc. (as in
 XIV. 14).
 Thy Lord is Sûrya, etc. (as in XIV. 14).

15.d: प॑रमे॒ष्ठी त्वा॑ सादयतु दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठे ज्योति॑ष्मतीम् । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नायो॑दा॒नाय॑ प्रति॒ष्ठायै॑ च॒रित्रा॑य । सूर्य॒स्ते धि॑पति॒स्तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ।।
15.e: Repeated from XII. 54.

15.d: लो॒कं पृ॑ण छि॒द्रं पृ॒णाथो॑ सीद ध्रु॒वा त्वम् । इ॑न्द्रा॒ग्नी त्वा॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒स्मिन्योना॑वसीषदन् ।।
15.e: Repeated from XII. 55.

15.d: ता अ॑स्य॒ सूद॑दोहसः॒ सोमँ॑ श्रीणन्ति॒ पृश्न॑यः । जन्म॑न्दे॒वानां॒ विश॑स्त्रि॒ष्वा रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः ।।
15.e: Repeated from XII. 56.

15.d: इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिरः॑ । र॒थीत॑मँ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑नाँ॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म् ।।
15.e:
Like a horse neighing, eager for the pasture, when he hath
 stepped forth from the great enclosure:
 Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and,
 straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.

15.d: प्रोथ॒दश्वो॒ न यव॑से वि॒ष्यन्य॒दा म॒हः सं॒वर॑णा॒द्व्यस्था॑त् । आद॑स्य॒ वातो॒ अनु॑ वाति शो॒चिरध॑ स्म ते॒ व्रज॑नं कृ॒ष्णम॑स्ति ।।
15.e:
In Âyu's seat I set thee, in the shadow of the protector in
 the heart of Ocean,
 Thee luminous, bright with eyes, thee who illumest the sky,
 the earth, and air's broad realm between them.

15.d: आ॒योष्ट्वा॒ सद॑ने सादया॒म्यव॑तश्छा॒यायाँ॑ समु॒द्रस्य॒ हृद॑ये । र॑श्मी॒वतीं॒ भास्व॑ती॒मा या द्यां भास्या पृ॑थि॒वीमोर्व॒न्तरि॑क्षम् ।।
15.e:
On the sky's back may Parameshthin set thee, etc. (as in
 XIV. 12, substituting sky for air and Sûrya for Vâyu).

15.d: प॑रमे॒ष्ठी त्वा॑ सादयतु दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठे व्यच॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्वती॒म्दिवं॑ यच्छ॒ दिवं॑ दृँह॒ दिवं॒ मा हिँ॑सीः । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नायो॑दा॒नाय॑ प्रति॒ष्ठायै॑ च॒रित्रा॑य । सूर्य॑स्त्वा॒भि पा॑तु म॒ह्या स्व॒स्त्या छ॒र्दिषा॒ शंत॑मेन॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम् ।।
15.e:
Thou art the measure of a thousand. Thou art the representative
 of a thousand. Thou art the equivalent of a thousand. Thou art
 worth a thousand. Thee for a thousand.

16.d: नम॑स्ते रुद्र म॒न्यव॑ उ॒तो त॒ इष॑वे॒ नमः॑ । बा॒हुभ्या॑मु॒त ते॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
HOMAGE be paid unto thy wrath, O Rudra, homage to thy
 shaft: to thy two arms be homage paid.

16.d: या ते॑ रुद्र शि॒वा त॒नूरघो॒रापा॑पकाशिनी । तया॑ नस्त॒न्वा॒ शंत॑मया॒ गिरि॑शन्ता॒भि चा॑कशीहि ।।
16.e:
With that auspicious form of thine, mild, Rudra! pleasant
 to behold,
 Even with that most blessèd form, look, Mountain-haunter!
 here on us.

16.d: यामिषुं॑ गिरिशन्त॒ हस्ते॑ बि॒भर्ष्यस्त॑वे । शि॒वां गि॑रित्र॒ तां कु॑रु॒ मा हिँ॑सीः॒ पुरु॑षं॒ जग॑त् ।।
16.e:
The shaft which, Mountain-haunter, thou art holding in
 thy hand to shoot,
 Make that auspicious, Mountain-Lord! Injure not man nor
 moving thing.

16.d: शि॒वेन॒ वच॑सा त्वा गिरि॒शाच्छा॑ वदामसि । यथा॑ नः॒ सर्व॒मिज्जग॑दय॒क्ष्मँ सु॒मना॒ अस॑त् ।।
अध्य॑वोचदधिव॒क्ता प्र॑थ॒मो दै॑व्यो भि॒षक् । अहीँ॑श्च॒ सर्वा॑न्ज॒म्भय॒न्त्सर्वा॑श्च यातुधा॒न्यो॑ ध॒राचीः॒ परा॑ सुव ।।
16.e:
The Advocate, the first divine Physician, hath defended us.
 Crushing all serpents, drive away all Yâtudhânis down below.

16.d: असौ॒ यस्ता॒म्रो अ॑रु॒ण उ॒त ब॒भ्रुः सु॑म॒ङ्गलः॑ । ये चै॑नँ रु॒द्रा अ॒भितो॑ दि॒क्षु श्रि॒ताः स॑हस्र॒शो वै॑षाँ॒ हेड॑ ईमहे ।।
16.e:
That most auspicious One whose hue is coppery and red
 and brown,
 And those, the Rudras who maintain their station in the
 regions, who surround him in a thousand bands, of these
 we deprecate the wrath.

16.d: असौ॒ यो॑ व॒सर्प॑ति॒ नील॑ग्रीवो॒ विलो॑हितः । उतैनं गो॒पा अ॑दृश्र॒न्नदृ॑श्रन्नुदहा॒र्यः॒ स दृ॒ष्तो मृ॑डयाति नः ।।
16.e:
May he who glides away, whose neck is azure, and whose
 hue is red,
 He whom the herdsmen, whom the girls who carry water
 have beheld, may he when seen be kind to us.

16.d: नमो॑ स्तु॒ नील॑ग्रीवाय सहस्रा॒क्षाय॑ मी॒ढुषे॑ । अथो॒ ये अ॑स्य॒ सत्वा॑नो॒ हं तेभ्यो॑ करं॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to him the Azure-nested, the thousand-eyed, the
 bountiful,
 Yea, and his spirit ministers—to them I offer reverence.

16.d: प्र मु॑ञ्च॒ धन्व॑न॒स्त्वमु॒भयो॒रार्त्न्यो॒र्ज्याम् । याश्च॑ ते॒ हस्त॒ इष॑वः॒ परा॒ ता भ॑गवो वप ।।
16.e:
Loosen thy bowstring, loosen it from thy bow's two
 extremities,
 And cast away, O Lord Divine, the arrows that are in thy
 hand.

16.d: विज्यं॒ धनुः॑ कप॒र्दिनो॒ विश॑ल्यो॒ वाण॑वाँ उ॒त । अने॑शन्नस्य॒ या इष॑व आ॒भुर॑स्य निषङ्ग॒धिः ।।
16.e:
Now stringless be Kapardin's bow, his quiver hold no pointed
 shaft.
 The shafts he had have perished and the sheath that held
 his sword is bare.

16.d: या ते॑ हे॒तिर्मी॑ढुष्टम॒ हस्ते॑ ब॒भूव॑ ते॒ धनुः॑ । तया॒स्मान्वि॒श्वत॒स्त्वम॑य॒क्ष्मया॒ परि॑ भुज ।।
16.e:
Thy weapon, O Most Bountiful, the bow that resteth in thy
 hand,—
 With that, deprived of power to harm, protect thou us on
 every side.

16.d: परि॑ ते॒ धन्व॑नो हे॒तिर॒स्मान्वृ॑णक्तु वि॒श्वतः॑ । अथो॒ य इ॑षु॒धिस्तवा॒रे अ॒स्मन्नि धे॑हि॒ तम् ।।
16.e:
So may the arrow of thy bow, in all directions, pass us by,
 And in a place remote from us lay thou the quiver that thou
 hast.

16.d: अ॑व॒तत्य॒ धनु॒ष्ट्वँ सह॑स्राक्ष॒ शते॑षुधे । नि॒शीर्य॑ श॒ल्यानां॒ मुखा॑ शि॒वो नः॑ सु॒मना॑ भव ।।
16.e:
Having unbent thy how O thou hundred-eyed, hundred-quivered
 One!
 And dulled thy pointed arrows' heads, be kind and gracious
 unto us.

16.d: नम॑स्त॒ आयु॑धा॒याना॑तताय धृ॒ष्णवे॑ । उ॒भाभ्या॑मु॒त ते॒ नमो॑ बा॒हुभ्यां॒ तव॒ धन्व॑ने ।।
16.e:
To thy fierce weapon, now unstrung, be reverent obeisance
 paid.
 Homage be paid to both thine arms, and to thy bow be
 reverence!

16.d: मा नो॑ म॒हान्त॑मु॒त मा नो॑ अर्भ॒कं मा न॒ उक्ष॑न्तमु॒त मा न॑ उक्षि॒तम् । मा नो॑ वधीः पि॒तरं॒ मोत मा॒तरं॒ मा नः॑ प्रि॒यास्त॒न्वो॑ रुद्र रीरिषः ।।
16.e:
Do thou no injury to great or small of us, harm not the
 growing boy, harm not the full grown man.
 Slay not a sire among us, slay no mother here, and to our
 own dear bodies, Rudra! do no harm.

16.d: मा न॑स्तो॒के तन॑ये॒ मा न॒ आयु॑षि॒ मा नो॒ गोषु॒ मा नो॒ अश्वे॑षु रीरिषः । मा नो॑ वी॒रान्रु॑द्र भा॒मिनो॑ वधीर्ह॒विष्म॑न्तः॒ सद॒मित्त्वा॑ हवामहे ।।
16.e:
Harm us not in our seed or in our progeny, harm us not in
 our life or in our cows or steeds.
 Slay not our heroes in the fury of their wrath. We with
 oblations ever call on only thee.

16.d: नमो॒ हिर॑ण्यबाहवे सेना॒न्ये॑ दि॒शां च॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ वृ॒क्षेभ्यो॒ हरि॑केशेभ्यः पशू॒नां पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमः॑ श॒ष्पिञ्ज॑राय॒ त्विषी॑मते पथी॒नां पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम्परि॑केशायोपवी॒तिने॑ पु॒ष्टानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e: Homage to the golden-armed leader of hosts, lord of the

16.d: नमो॑ बभ्लु॒शाय॑ व्या॒धिने न्ना॑नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ भ॒वस्य॑ हेत्यै॒ जग॑तां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ रु॒द्राया॑तता॒यिने॒ क्षेत्रा॑णां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमः॑ सू॒तायाह॑न्त्यै॒वना॑नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
regions, to the trees with their green tresses, to the Lord
 of beasts be homage; homage to him whose sheen is like
 green grass, homage to the radiant Lord of paths, homage
 to the golden-haired wearer of the sacrificial cord, homage
 to the Lord of the well-endowed.

16.d: नमो॒ रोहि॑ताय स्थ॒पत॑ये वृ॒क्षाणां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ भुव॒न्तये॑ वारिवस्कृ॒तायौ॑षधीनां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ म॒न्त्रिणे॑ वाणि॒जाय॒ कक्षा॑णां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम॑ उच्चैर्घोषायाक्र॒न्द�॑ते पत्ती॒नां पत॑ये॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to the brown-hued piercer, to the Lord of food be
 homage. Homage to Bhava's weapon, homage to the
 Lord of moving things! homage to Rudra whose bow is
 bent to slay, to the Lord of fields homage, homage to the
 charioteer who injures, none, to the Lord of forests be
 homage.

16.d: नमः॑ कृत्स्नाय॒तया॒ धाव॑ते॒ सत्व॑नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमः॒ सह॑मानाय निव्या॒धिन॑ आव्या॒धिनी॑नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ निष॒ङ्गिणे॑ ककु॒भाय॑ स्ते॒नानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम्नि॑चे॒रवे॑ परिच॒राया�नां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to the red architect, to the Lord of trees homage!
 Homage to him who stretched out the earth, to him who
 gives relief be homage. Homage to the Lord of Plants,
 homage to the prudent merchant! Homage to the Lord
 of bushes, to the shouting Lord of foot-soldiers who
 makes foes weep be homage.

16.d: नमो॒ वञ्च॑ते परि॒वञ्च॑ते स्तायू॒नां पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ निष॒ङ्गिण॑ इषुधि॒मते॒ तस्क॑राणां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमः॑ सृका॒यिभ्यो॒ जिघाँ॑सद्भ्यो मुष्ण॒तां पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ सि॒मद्भ्यो॒ नक्तं॒ चर॑द्भ्यो विकृ॒न्तानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to the runner at full stretch, to the Lord of
 ministering spirits, homage! Homage to the conquering,
 piercing Lord of assailing bands, homage to the towering
 sword-bearer, to the Lord of thieves homage! Homage to
 the gliding robber, to the roamer, to the Lord of forests
 homage!

16.d: नम॑ उष्णी॒षिणे॑ गिरिच॒राय॑ कुलु॒ञ्चानां॒ पत॑ये॒ नमो॒ नम॑ इषु॒मध्ब्यो॑ धन्वा॒यिभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑ आतन्वा॒नेभ्यः॑ प्रति॒दधा॑नेभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑ आ॒यच्छ॒द्भ्यो स्य॑द्भ्यश्च वो॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to the cheat, to the arch-deceiver, to the Lord of
 stealers homage! Homage to the wearer of sword and
 quiver, to the Lord of robbers homage! Homage to the
 boltarmed homicides, to the Lord of pilferers homage!
 Homage to the sword-bearers, to those who roam at night,
 to the Lord of plunderers homage!

16.d: नमो॑ विसृ॒जद्भ्यो॒ विध्य॑द्भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमः॑ स्व॒पद्भ्यो॒ जाग्र॑द्भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमः॒ शया॑नेभ्य॒ आसी॑नेभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॒स्तिष्ठ॑द्भ्यो॒ धाव॑द्भ्यश्च वो॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
To the turban-wearing haunter of mountains, Lord of
 land-grabbers homage! Homage to you who bear arrows
 and to you who carry bows. Homage to you with bent
 bows, and to you who adjust your arrows, to you who
 draw the bow and to you who shoot be homage!

16.d: नमः॑ स॒भाभ्यः॑ स॒भाप॑तिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो श्वे॒भ्यो श्व॑पतिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॑ आव्या॒धिनी॑भ्यो वि॒विध्य॑न्तीभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम॒ उग॑णाभ्यस्तृँह॒तीभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to you who let fly and to you who pierce, homage
 to you who sleep and to you who wake, homage to you
 who lie and to you who sit, homage to you who stand
 and to you who run.

16.d: नमो॑ ग॒णेभ्यो॑ ग॒णप॑तिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॒ व्राते॑भ्यो॒ व्रात॑पतिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नम्गृत्से॑भ्यो॒ गृत्स॑पतिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॒ विरू॑पेभ्यो वि॒श्वरू॑पेभ्यश्च वो॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to assemblies and to you lords of assemblies,
 homage to horses and to you masters of horses, homage to
 you hosts that wound and pierce, to you destructive
 armies with excellent bands be homage.

16.d: नमः॒ सेना॑भ्यः सेना॒निभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ र॒थिभ्यो॑ अर॒तेभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमः॑ क्ष॒त्तृभ्यः॑ संग्रही॒तृभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ म॒हद्भ्यो॑ अर्भ॒केभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to the troops and to you lords of troops be homage.
 Homage to the companies and to you lords of companies, homage.
 Homage to sharpers and to you lords of sharpers, homage.
 Homage to you the deformed, and to you who wear all forms, homage!

16.d: नम॒स्तक्ष॑भ्यो रथका॒रेभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमः॒ कुला॑लेभ्यः कु॒र्मारे॑भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ निषा॒देभ्यः॑ पु॒ञ्जिष्टे॑भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमः॑ श्व॒निभ्यो॑ मृग॒युभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to armies and to you the leaders of armies, homage.
 Homage to you car-borne and to you who are carless, homage.
 Homage to the charioteers and to you drivers of horses, homage.
 Homage to you the great and to you the small, homage.

16.d: नमः॒ श्वभ्यः॒ श्वप॑तिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ भ॒वाय॑ च रु॒द्राय॑ च॒ नमः॑ श॒र्वाय॑ च पशु॒पत॑ये च॒ नमो॒ नील॑ग्रीवाय च शिति॒कण्ठा॑य च ।।
16.e:
Homage to you carpenters, and to you chariot-makers homage.
 Homage to you potters and to you blacksmiths, homage.
 Homage to you Nishâdas and to you Puñjishthas, homage.
 Homage to you dog-leaders, and to you hunters, homage.

16.d: नमः॑ कप॒र्दिने॑ च॒ व्यु॑प्तकेशाय च॒ नमः॑ सहस्रा॒क्षाय॑ च श॒तध॑न्वने च॒ नमो॑ गिरिश॒याय॑ च शिपिवि॒ष्टाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ मी॒ढुष्ट॑माय॒ चेषु॑मते च ।।
16.e:
Homage to dogs, and to you masters of dogs, homage.
 Homage to Bhava, and to Rudra homage, homage to Sarva
 and to Pasupati, and to Nîlagrîva and Sitikantha, homage.

16.d: नमो॑ ह्र॒स्वाय॑ च वाम॒नाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ बृह॒ते च॒ वर्षी॑यसे च॒ नमो॑ वृ॒द्धाय॑ च स॒वृधे॑ च॒ नमो ग्र्या॑य च प्रथ॒माय॑ च ।।
16.e:
Homage to him with braided hair and to him with shaven
 hair, homage! homage to the thousand-eyed and to him
 with a hundred bows, homage!
 To the mountain-haunter and to Sipivishta, homage!
 To the most bountiful, armed with arrows, homage!

16.d: नम॑ आ॒शवे॑ चाजि॒राय॑ च॒ नमः॒ शीघ्र्या॑य च॒ शीभ्या॑य च॒ नम॒ ऊर्म्या॑य चावस्व॒न्या॑य च॒ नमो॑ नादे॒याय॑ च॒ द्वीप्या॑य च ।।
16.e:
Homage to the short, and to the dwarf, homage, homage to
 the great and to the adult, homage! Homage to the full-grown
 and to the growing, to the foremost and to the first
 be homage.

16.d: नमो॑ ज्ये॒ष्ठाय॑ च कनि॒ष्ठाय॑ च॒ नमः॑ पूर्व॒जाय॑ चापर॒जाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ मध्य॒माय॑ चापग॒ल्भाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ जघ॒न्या॑य च बु॒ध्न्या॑य च ।।
16.e:
Homage to the swift, and to the active be homage, and to
 the hasty and to the rapid mover be homage! Homage to
 him who dwells in waves, and in still waters, to him who
 dwells in rivers and on islands.

16.d: नमः॒ सोम्या॑य च प्रतिस॒र्या॑य च॒ नमो॒ याम्या॑य च॒ क्षेम्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ श्लोक्या॑य चावसा॒न्या॑य च॒ नम॑ उर्व॒र्या॑य च॒ खल्या॑य च ।।
16.e:
Homage to the eldest and to the youngest, to the first-born
 and to the last-born, homage! Homage to the middle-most
 and to the immature, to the lowest and to him who
 is in the depth, be homage!

16.d: नमो॒ वन्या॑य च॒ कक्ष्ण्या॑य च॒ नमः॑ श्र॒वाय॑ च प्रतिश्र॒वाय॑ च॒ नम॑ आ॒शुषे॑णाय चा॒शुर॑थाय च॒ नमः॒ शूरा॑य चावभे॒दिने॑ च ।।
16.e:
Homage to Sobhya and to the dweller in the magic amulet,
 homage! Homage to him who is allied to Yama, to him
 who prospers be homage! Homage to the famous and to
 the endmost, to him of the sown corn-land and to him of
 the threshing-floor be homage.

16.d: नमो॑ बि॒ल्मिने॑ च कव॒चिने॑ च॒ नमो॑ व॒र्मिणे॑ च वरू॒थिने॑ च॒ नमः॑ श्रु॒ताय॑ च श्रुतसे॒नाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ दुन्दु॒भ्याय॑ चाहन॒न्या॑य च ।।
16.e:
Homage to him in woods and to him in bushes, homage!
 Homage to him as sound and to him as echo, homage!
 Homage to him with swift armies and to him with swift
 chariots, homage! Homage to the hero, and to him who
 rends asunder be homage.

16.d: नमो॑ धृ॒ष्णवे॑ च प्रमृ॒शाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ निष॒ङ्गिणे॑ चेषुधि॒मते॑ च॒ नम॑स्ती॒क्ष्णेष॑वे चायु॒धिने॑ च॒ नमः॑ स्वायु॒धाय॑ च सु॒धन्व॑ने च ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who wears a helmet, and to him who wears
 a cuirass, homage! To him who wears mail and defensive
 armour, homage! To the renowned one and to him whose
 army is renowned be homage, to him who is in drums and
 to him who makes himself known by beating them.

16.d: नमः॒ स्रुत्या॑य च॒ पथ्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ काट्या॑य च॒ नीप्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ कुल्या॑य च सर॒स्या॑य च॒ नमो॑ नादे॒याय॑ च वैश॒न्ताय॑ च ।।
16.e:
Homage to the bold one and to the prudent, homage to him
 who carries sword and quiver, homage to him who hath
 keen arrows and is armed with weapons, homage to him
 who hath good weapons and a good bow.

16.d: नमः॒ कूप्या॑य चाव॒ट्या॑य च॒ नमो॒ वीध्र्या॑य चात॒प्या॑य च॒ नमो॒ मेघ्या॑य च च विद्यु॒त्या॑य॒ नमो॒ वर्ष्या॑य चाव॒र्ष्याय॑ च ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who dwells on paths and roads, homage to
 him who dwells in rugged spots and on the skirts of mountains,
 homage to him who dwells in water courses and
 lakes, homage to him who dwells in rivers and mores.

16.d: नमो॒ वात्या॑य च॒ रेष्म्या॑य च॒ नमो॑ वास्त॒व्या॑य च वास्तु॒पाय॑ च॒ नमः॒ सोमा॑य च रु॒द्राय॑ च॒ नम॑स्ता॒म्राय॑ चारु॒णाय॑ च ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who dwells in wells and pits, homage to him
 who dwells in bright sky and sunlight. Homage to him
 who dwells in cloud and lightning, homage to him who
 dwells in rain and to him who dwells in fair weather.

16.d: नमः॑ शं॒गवे॑ च पशु॒पत॑ये च॒ नम॑ उ॒ग्राय॑ च भी॒माय॑ च॒ नमो॑ अग्रेव॒धाय॑ च दूरेव॒धाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ ह॒न्त्रे च॒ हनी॑यसे च॒ नमो॑ वृ॒क्षेभ्यो॒ हरि॑केशेभ्यो॒ नम॑स्ता॒राय॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who dwells in wind and to him who dwells
 in tempest, homage to the dweller in houses and to the
 house-protector. Homage to Soma and to Rudra, homage
 to the copper-coloured and to the ruddy One.

16.d: नमः॑ शम्भ॒वाय॑ च मयोभ॒वाय॑ च॒ नमः॑ शंक॒राय॑ च मयस्क॒राय॑ च॒ नमः॑ शि॒वाय॑ च शि॒वत॑राय च ।।
16.e:
Homage to the giver of weal, and to Pasupati, homage to
 the fierce and to the terrific. Homage to him who slays
 in front and to him who slays at a distance, homage to
 the slayer and to the frequent slayer, homage to the
 green-tressed trees, homage to the deliverer.

16.d: नमः॒ पार्या॑य चावा॒र्या॑य च॒ नमः॑ प्र॒तर॑णाय चो॒त्तर॑णाय च॒ नम॒स्तीर्थ्या॑य च॒ कूल्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ शष्प्या॑य च॒ पेन्या॑य च ।।
16.e:
Homage to the source of happiness and to the source of
 delight, homage to the causer of happiness and to the causer
 of delight, homage to the auspicious, homage to the most
 auspicious.

16.d: नमः॑ सिक॒त्या॑य च प्रवा॒ह्या॑य च॒ नमः॑ किँशि॒लाय॑ च क्षय॒णाय॑ च॒ नमः॑ कप॒र्दिने॑ च पुल॒स्तये॑ च॒ नम॑ इरि॒ण्या॑य च प्रप॒थ्या॑य च ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who is beyond and to him who is on this
 side, homage to him who crosses over and to him who
 crosses back. Homage to him who is in fords and on
 river banks, homage to him who is in tender grass and in
 foam.

16.d: नमो॒ व्रज्या॑य च॒ गोष्ठ्या॑य च॒ नम॒स्तल्प्या॑य च॒ गेह्या॑य च॒ नमो॑ हृद॒य्या॑य च निवे॒ष्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ काट्या॑य च गह्वरे॒ष्ठाय॑ च ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who is in sand and to him who is in running
 water, homage to him who is on pebbly ground and to
 him who is where still water stands. Homage to him
 who wears braided hair and to him whose hair is smooth.
 Homage to him who is in deserts and to him who is on
 broad roads.

16.d: नमः॒ शुष्क्या॑य च हरि॒त्या॑य च॒ नमः॑ पाँस॒व्या॑य च रज॒स्या॑य च॒ नमो॒ लोप्या॑य चोल॒प्या॑य च॒ नम॒ ऊर्व्या॑य च॒ सूर्व्या॑य च ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who is in herds of cattle and to him who
 is in cow-pens, homage to him who is on beds and to
 him who is in houses. Homage to him who is in hearts,
 and to him who is in whirlpools, homage to him who is in
 wells and to him who is in abysses.

16.d: नमः॑ प॒र्णाय॑ च पर्णश॒दाय॑ च॒ नम॑ उद्गु॒रमा॑णाय चाभिघ्न॒ते च॒ नम॑ आखिद॒ते च॑ प्रखिद॒ते च॒ नम॑ इषु॒कृद्भ्यो॑ धनु॒ष्कृद्भ्यस्च॑ वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ वः किरि॒केभ्यो॑ दे॒वानाँ॒ हृद॑येभ्यो॒ नमो॑ विचिन्व॒त्केभ्यो॒ नमो॑ विक्षिण॒त्केभ्यो॒ नम॑ आनिर्ह॒तेभ्यः॑ ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who is in dry things and to him who is in
 green things. Homage to him who is in dust and to him
 who is in vapour. Homage to him who is in inaccessible
 places, homage to him who is in creeping plants, homage
 to him who is in the earth and to him who is in good soil.

16.d: द्रापे॒ अन्ध॑सस्पते॒ दरि॑द्र॒ नील॑लोहित । आ॒सां प्र॒जाना॑मे॒षां प॑शू॒नां मा भे॒र्मा रो॒ङ्मो च॑ नः॒ किं च॒नाम॑मत् ।।
16.e:
Homage to him who is in leaves and to him who is in the
 falling of leaves. Homage to him with the threatening
 voice and to him who slays, homage to him who troubles
 and to him who afflicts. Homage to you arrow-makers
 and to you bow-makers, homage to you sprinklers, to the
 hearts of the Gods. Homage to the discerners, homage
 to the destroyers; homage to the indestructible.

16.d: इ॒मा रु॒द्राय॑ त॒वसे॑ कप॒र्दिने॑ क्ष॒यद्वी॑राय॒ प्र भ॑रामहे म॒तीः । यथा॒ शमस॑द्द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे॒ विश्वं॑ पु॒ष्टं ग्रामे॑ अ॒स्मिन्न॑नातु॒रम् ।।
16.e:
Pursuer, Lord of Soma juice, thou cleaver, coloured blue
 and red,
 Cleave not, destroy not one of these our children, nor of
 these our beasts, let nothing that is ours be sick.

16.d: या ते॑ रुद्र शि॒वा त॒नूः शि॒वा वि॒श्वाहा॑ भेष॒जी । शि॒वा रु॒तस्य॑ भेष॒जी तया॑ नो मृड जी॒वसे॑ ।।
16.e:
To the strong Rudra bring we these our songs of praise, to
 him the Lord of Heroes, with the braided hair,
 That it be well with all our cattle and our men, that in this
 village all be healthy and well-fed.

16.d: परि॑ नो रु॒द्रस्य॑ हे॒तिर्वृ॑णक्तु॒ परि॑ त्वे॒षस्य॑ दुर्म॒तिर॑घा॒योः । अव॑ स्थि॒रा म॒घव॑द्भ्यस्तनुष्व॒ मीढ्व॑स्तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय मृड ।।
16.e:
Rudra, with that auspicious form of thine which healeth
 every day,
 Auspicious, healer of disease, be kind to us that we may live.

16.d: मीढु॑ष्टम॒ शिव॑तम शि॒वो नः॑ सु॒मना॑ भव । प॑र॒मे वृ॒क्ष आयु॑धं नि॒धाय॒ कृत्तिं॒ वसा॑न॒ आ च॑र॒ पिना॑कं॒ बिभ्र॒दा ग॑हि ।।
16.e:
May Rudra's missile turn aside and spare us, the great
 wrath of the impetuous One avoid us.
 Turn, Bounteous God, thy strong bow from our princes, and
 be thou gracious to our seed and offspring.
 I Most bounteous, most auspicious, be auspicious, well inclined
 to us.
 On some remotest tree lay down thy weapon. and clad in
 robe of skin approach, bearing thy bow come hitherward.

16.d: विकि॑रिद्र॒ विलो॑हित॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु भगवः । यास्ते॑ स॒हस्रँ॑ हे॒तयो॒ न्यम॒स्मन्नि व॑पन्तु॒ ताः ।।
16.e:
O Wound averter, purple-hued, to thee be homage, holy Lord!
 May all those thousand darts of thine strike dead another
 one than us.

16.d: स॒हस्रा॑णि सहस्र॒शो बा॒ह्वोस्तव॑ हे॒तयः॑ । तासा॒मीशा॑नो भगवः परा॒चीना॒ मुखा॑ कृधि ।।
16.e:
Thousands of thousands are the shafts, the missiles ready
 in thy hands:
 Thou holy Lord, who hast the power, turn thou their
 points away from us.

16.d: असं॑ख्याता स॒हस्रा॑णि॒ ये रु॒द्रा अधि॒ भूम्या॑म् । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Innumerable thousands are the Rudras on the face of earth:
 Of all these Rudras we unbend the bows a thousand leagues
 away.

16.d: अ॒स्मिन्म॑ह॒त्य॑र्ण॒वे॒ न्तरि॑क्षे भ॒वा अधि॑ । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Bhavas there are above us in this mighty billowy sea of air,
 Of all of these do we unbend, etc.

16.d: नील॑ग्रीवाः शिति॒कण्ठा॒ दिवँ॑ रु॒द्रा उपा॑श्रिताः । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Rudras are dwelling in the sky, whose necks are blue, whose
 throats are white:
 Of these do we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away
 from us.

16.d: नील॑ग्रीवाः शिति॒कण्ठाः॑ श॒र्वा अ॒धः क्ष॑माच॒राः । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Sarvas haunt realms beneath the earth—their necks are blue,
 their throats are white:
 Of these, etc.

16.d: ये वृ॒क्षेषु॑ श॒ष्पिञ्ज॑रा॒ नील॑ग्रीवा॒ विलो॑हिताः । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
These, green like young grass, in the trees, with azure necks
 and purple hue,
 Of those, etc.

16.d: ये भू॒ताना॒मधि॑पतयो विशि॒खासः॑ कप॒र्दिनः॑ । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Those, ministering spirits’ lords, with no hair-tufts, with
 braided locks,
 Of these, etc.

16.d: ये प॒थां प॑थि॒रक्ष॑स ऐलबृ॒दा आ॑यु॒र्युधः॑ । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Those, the protectors of the paths, bringers of food, who
 fight for life. Of these, etc.

16.d: ये ती॒र्थानि॑ प्र॒चर॑न्ति सृ॒काह॑स्ता निष॒ङ्गिणः॑ । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Those who with arrows in their hand, and armed with
 words, frequent the fords, Of these, etc.

16.d: ये न्ने॑षु वि॒विध्य॑न्ति॒ पात्रे॑षु॒ पिब॑तो॒ जना॑न् । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Those who, inhabiting the food, vex men while drinking from
 their cups, etc.

16.d: ये ए॒ताव॑न्तश्च॒ भूयाँ॑सश्च॒ दिशो॑ रु॒द्रा वि॑तस्थि॒रे । तेषाँ॑ सहस्रयोज॒ने व॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ।।
16.e:
Rudras so many and still more, lodged in the quarters of
 the sky, etc.

16.d: नमो॑ स्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ ये दि॒वि येषां॑ व॒र्षमिष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः । तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ वन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ।।
16.e:
Homage to Rudras, those whose home is sky, whose arrows
 floods of rain.
 To them ten eastward, southward ten, ten to the south, ten
 to the north, ten to the region uppermost!
 To them be homage! May they spare and guard us. Within
 their jaws we lay the man who hates us and whom we
 abhor.

16.d: नमो॑ स्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ ये॒ न्तरि॑क्षे॒ येषां॒ वात॒ इष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः । तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ वन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ।।
16.e:
Homage to Rudras, those whose home is air, whose arrows
 is the rain. To them, etc.

16.d: नमो॑ स्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ ये पृ॑थि॒व्यां येषा॒मन्न॒मिष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः । तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ वन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ।।
16.e:
Homage to Rudras, those whose home is earth, whose arrows
 is men's food.
 To them be homage, etc.

17.d: अश्म॒न्नूर्जं॒ पर्व॑ते शिश्रिया॒णाम॒द्भ्य ओष॑धीभ्यो॒ वन॒स्पति॒भ्यो धि॒ सम्भृ॑तं॒ पयः॑ । तां न॒ इष॒मूर्जं॑ धत्त मरुतः सँररा॒णाः । अश्मँ॑स्ते॒ क्षुत् । मयि॑ त॒ ऊर्क् । यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ।।
17.e:
THE food and strength contained in stone and mountain,
 drink gathered from the plants and trees and waters,
 That food and strength, Maruts! free-givers, grant us.
 In the stone is thy hunger. In me is thy food. Let thy
 pain reach the man we hate.

17.d: इ॒मा मे॑ अग्न॒ इष्ट॑का धे॒नवः॑ स॒न्त्वेका॑ च॒ दश॑ च॒ दश॑ च श॒तं च॑ श॒तं च॑ स॒हस्रं॑ च स॒हस्रं॑ चा॒युतं॑ चा॒युतं॑ च नि॒युतं॑ च नि॒युतं॑ च प्र॒युतं॒ चार्बु॑दं च॒ न्य॑र्बुदँ समु॒द्रश्च॒ मध्यं॒ चान्त॑श्च परा॒र्धश्चै॒ता मे॑ अग्न॒ इष्ट॑का धे॒नवः॑ सन्त्व॒मुत्रा॒मुष्मिं॑ल्लो॒के ।।
17.e:
O Agni, may these bricks be mine own milch kine: one, and
 ten, and ten tens, a hundred, and ten hundreds, a thousand,
 and ten thousand a myriad, and a hundred thousand,
 and a million, and a hundred millions, and an ocean middle
 and end, and a hundred thousand millions, and a billion.
 May these bricks be mine own milch-kine in yonder world
 and in this world.

17.d: ऋ॒तव॑ स्थ ऋता॒वृध॑ ऋतु॒ष्ठा स्थ॑ ऋता॒वृधः॑ । घृ॑त॒श्च्युतो॑ मधु॒श्च्युतो॑ वि॒राजो॒ नाम॑ काम॒दुघा॒ अक्षी॑यमाणाः ।।
17.e:
Ye are the Seasons, strengthening Law, fixed in due season,
 strengthening Law,
 Called Splendid, dropping butter down and honey, yielders
 of every wish, imperishable.

17.d: स॑मु॒द्रस्य॒ त्वाव॑क॒याग्ने॒ परि॑ व्ययामसि । पा॑व॒को अ॒स्मभ्यँ॑ शि॒वो भ॑व ।।
17.e:
With the lake's mantling need we robe thee, Agni: to us
 he purifying and auspicious.

17.d: हि॒मस्य॑ त्वा ज॒रायु॒णाग्ने॒ परि॑ व्ययामसि । पा॑व॒को अ॒स्मभ्यँ॑ शि॒वो भ॑व ।।
17.e:
With cold's investing garb we gird thee, Agni: to us be purifying
 and auspicious.

17.d: उप॒ ज्मन्नुप॑ वेत॒से व॑ तर न॒दीष्वा । अग्ने॑ पि॒त्तम॒पाम॑सि । मण्डू॑कि॒ ताभि॒रा ग॑हि॒ सेमं नो॑ य॒ज्ञं पा॑व॒कव॑र्णँ शिवं कृधि ।।
17.e:
Descend upon the earth, the reed, the rivers: thou art the
 gall, O Agni, of the waters.
 With them come hither, female Frog, and render this sacrifice
 of ours bright-hued, successful.

17.d: अ॒पामि॒दं न्यय॑नँ समु॒द्रस्य॑ नि॒वेश॑नम् । अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तयः॑ पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्यँ॑ शि॒वो भ॑व ।।
17.e:
This is the place where waters meet; here is the gathering
 of the flood.
 Let thy shaft burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious
 unto us.

17.d: अग्ने॑ पावक रो॒चिषा॑ म॒न्द्रया॑ देव जि॒ह्वया॑ । आ दे॒वान्व॑क्षि॒ यक्षि॑ च ।।
17.e:
O Agni, purifier, God, with splendour and thy pleasant
 tongue
 Bring hither, and adore, the Gods.

17.d: स नः॑ पावक दीदि॒वो ग्ने॑ दे॒वाँ इ॒हा व॑ह । उप॑ य॒ज्ञँ ह॒विश्च॑ नः ।।
17.e:
So, Agni, purifying, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice,
 To our oblation bring the Gods.

17.d: पा॑व॒कया॒ यश्चि॒तय॑न्त्या कृ॒पा क्षाम॑न्रुरु॒च उ॒षसो॒ न भा॒नुना॑ । तूर्व॒न्न याम॒न्नेत॑शस्य॒ नू रण॒ आ यो घृ॒णे न त॑तृषा॒णो अ॒जरः॑ ।।
17.e:
He who with purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon
 the earth as with the light of Dawn;
 Who speeding on, as in the fleet steed's race, in fight, cometh
 untouched by age, as one athirst in heat.

17.d: नम॑स्ते॒ हर॑से शो॒चिषे॒ नम॑स्ते अस्त्व॒र्चिषे॑ । अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तयः॑ पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्यँ॑ शि॒वो भ॑व ।।
17.e:
Obeisance to thy wrath and glow! Obeisance to thy fiery
 flame!
 Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser,
 propitious unto us.

17.d: नृ॒षदे॒ वेट् । अ॑प्सु॒षदे॒ वेट् । ब॑र्हि॒षदे॒ वेट् । व॑न॒सदे॒ वेट् । स्व॒र्विदे॒ वेट् ।।
17.e:
To him who dwells in man, Hail! To him who dwells in
 waters, Hail!
 To him who dwells in sacred grass, Hail! To him who dwells
 in the wood, Hail! To him who finds the light, Hail!

17.d: ये दे॒वा दे॒वानां॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑नाँ संवत्स॒रीण॒मुप॑ भा॒गमास॑ते । अ॑हु॒तादो॑ ह॒विषो॑ य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्त्स्व॒यं पि॑बन्तु॒ मधु॑नो घृ॒तस्य॑ ।।
17.e:
Worshipful Gods of Gods who merit worship, those who sit
 down beside their yearly portion,
 Let them who eat not sacrificial presents drink in this rite
 of honey and of butter.

17.d: ये दे॒वा दे॒वेष्वधि॑ देव॒त्वमाय॒न्ये ब्रह्म॑णः पुरए॒तारो॑ अस्य । येभ्यो॑ न ऋ॒ते पव॑ते॒ धाम॒ किं च॒न न ते दि॒वो न पृ॑थि॒व्या अधि॒ स्नुषु॑ ।।
17.e:
Those Gods who have attained to Godhead over Gods, they
 who have led the way in this our holy work,
 Without whose aid no body whatsoever moves, not on heaven's
 heights are they, nor on the face of earth.

17.d: प्रा॑ण॒दा अ॑पान॒दा व्या॑न॒दा व॑र्चो॒दा व॑रिवो॒दाः । अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तयः॑ पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्यँ॑ शि॒वो भ॑व ।।
17.e:
Giver of breath, of out-breath, breath diffusive, giver of
 lustre, giving room and freedom,
 Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser,
 propitious unto us.

17.d: अ॒ग्निस्ति॒ग्मेन॑ शो॒चिषा॒ यास॒द्विश्वं॒ न्य॒त्रिण॑म् । अ॒ग्निर्नो॑ वनते र॒यिम् ।।
17.e:
May Agni with his sharpened blaze cast down each fierce
 devouring fiend.
 May Agni win us wealth by war.

17.d: य इ॒मा विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ जुह्व॒दृषि॒र्होता॒ न्यसी॑दत्पि॒ता नः॑ । स आ॒शिषा॒ द्रवि॑णमि॒च्छमा॑नः प्रथम॒च्छदव॑राँ॒ आ वि॑वेश ।।
17.e:
He who sate down as Hotar priest, the Rishi, our Father
 offering, up all things existent
 He, seeking with his wish a great possession, came among
 men on earth as archetypal.

17.d: किँ स्वि॑दासीदधि॒ष्ठान॑मा॒रम्भ॑णं कत॒मत्स्वि॑त्क॒थासी॑त् । यतो॒ भूमिं॑ ज॒नय॑न्वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ वि द्याऔ॑र्णोन्महि॒ना वि॒श्वच॑क्षाः ।।
17.e:
What was the place whereon he took his station? What was
 it that upheld him? What the manner,
 Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with
 mighty power disclosed the heavens?

17.d: वि॒श्वत॑श्चक्षुरु॒त वि॒श्वतो॑मुखो वि॒श्वतो॑बाहुरु॒त वि॒श्वत॑स्पात् । सं बा॒हुभ्यां॒ धम॑ति॒ सं पत॑त्रै॒र्द्यावा॒भूमी॑ ज॒नय॑न्दे॒व एकः॑ ।।
17.e:
He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on
 all sides, arms and feet on all sides,
 He the sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them
 with his arms as wings together.

17.d: किँ स्वि॒द्वनं॒ क उ॒ स वृ॒क्ष आ॑स॒ यतो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी नि॑ष्टत॒क्षुः । मनी॑षिणो॒ मन॑सा पृ॒च्छतेदु॒ तद्यद॒ध्यति॑ष्ठ॒द्भुव॑नानि धा॒रय॑न् ।।
17.e:
What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from
 which they fashioned out the earth and heaven?
 Ye thoughtful men, inquire within your spirit whereon he
 stood when he established all things.

17.d: या ते॒ धामा॑नि पर॒माणि॒ याव॒मा या म॑ध्य॒मा वि॑श्वकर्मन्नु॒तेमा । शिक्षा॒ सखि॑भ्यो ह॒विषि॑ स्वधावः स्व॒यं य॑जस्व त॒न्वं॑ वृधा॒नः ।।
17.e:
Thine highest, lowest sacrificial natures, and these thy
 midmost here, O Visvakarman,
 Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessèd, and come thy-
 self, exalted, to our worship.

17.d: विश्व॑कर्मन्ह॒विषा॑ वावृधा॒नः स्व॒यं य॑जस्व पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम् । मुह्य॑न्त्व॒न्ये अ॒भितो॑ स॒पत्ना॑ इ॒हास्माकं॑ म॒घवा॑ सू॒रिर॑स्तु ।।
17.e:
Bring those, thyself exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman,
 Earth and Heaven to worship.
 Let enemies around us live in folly: here let us have a rich
 and liberal patron.
 23, 24. = VIII. 45, 46.

17.d: वा॒चस्पतिं॑ वि॒श्वक॑र्माणमू॒तये॑ मनो॒जुवं॒ वाजे॑ अ॒द्या हु॑वेम । स नो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ हव॑नानि जोषद्वि॒श्वश॑म्भू॒रव॑से सा॒धुक॑र्मा ।।
17.e:
The Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these
 worlds submerged in fatness.
 Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens
 and the earth were far extended.

17.d: विश्व॑कर्मन्ह॒विषा॒ वर्ध॑नेन त्रा॒तार॒मिन्द्र॑मकृणोरव॒ध्यम् । तस्मै॒ विशः॒ सम॑नमन्त पू॒र्वीर॒यमु॒ग्रो वि॒हव्यो॒ यथास॑त् ।।
17.e:
Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer,
 and most lofty Presence.

Their offerings joy in rich juice where they value One, only
 One beyond the Seven Rishis.

17.d: चक्षु॑षः पि॒ता मन॑सा॒ हि धीरो॑ घृ॒तमे॑ने अजन॒न्नम्न॑माने । य॒देदन्ता॒ अद॑दृहन्त॒ पूर्व॒ आदिद्द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑प्रथेताम् ।।
17.e:
Father who made us, he who, as Disposer, knoweth all races
 and all things existing,
 Even he alone, the Deities’ name-giver,—him other beings
 seek for information.

17.d: वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ विम॑ना॒ आद्विहा॑या धा॒ता वि॑धा॒ता प॑र॒मोत सं॒दृक् । तेषा॑मि॒ष्टानि॒ समि॒षा म॑दन्ति॒ यत्रा॑ सप्तऋ॒षीन्प॒र एक॑मा॒हुः ।।
17.e:
To him in sacrifice they offered treasures,—Rishis of old, in
 numerous troops, as singers,
 Who, in the distant, near, and lower region, made ready all
 these things that have existence.

17.d: यो नः॑ पि॒ता ज॑नि॒ता यो वि॑धा॒ता धामा॑नि॒ वेद॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ । यो दे॒वानां॑ नाम॒धा एक॑ ए॒व तँ सं॑प्र॒श्नं भुव॑ना यन्त्य॒न्या ।।
17.e:
That which is earlier than this earth and heaven, before the
 Asuras and Gods had being,
 What was the germ primeval which the waters received where
 the first Gods beheld each other?

17.d: त आय॑जन्त॒ द्रवि॑णँ॒ सम॑स्मा॒ ऋष॑यः॒ पूर्वे॑ जरि॒तारो॒ न भू॒ना । अ॒सूर्ते॒ सूर्ते॒ रज॑सि निष॒त्ते ये भू॒तानि॑ स॒मकृ॑ण्वन्नि॒मानि॑ ।।
17.e:
The waters, they received that germ primeval wherein the
 Gods were gathered all together.
 It rested set upon the Unborn's navel, that One wherein abide
 all things existing.

17.d: प॒रो दि॒वा प॒र ए॒ना पृ॑थि॒व्या प॒रो दे॒वेभि॒रसु॑रै॒र्यदस्ति॑ । कँ स्वि॒द्गर्भं॑ प्रथ॒मं द॑ध्र॒ आपो॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वाः स॒मप॑श्यन्त॒ पूर्वे॑ ।।
17.e:
Ye will not find him who produced these creatures: another
 thing hath risen up among you.
 Enwrapt in misty cloud, with lips that stammer, hymn-chanters
 wander and are discontented.

17.d: तमिद्गर्भं॑ प्रथ॒मं द॑ध्र॒ आपो॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वाः स॒मग॑च्छन्त॒ विश्वे॑ । अ॒जस्य॒ नाभा॒वध्येक॒मर्पि॑तं॒ यस्मि॒न्विश्वा॑नि॒ भुव॑नानि त॒स्थुः ।।
17.e:
First was the God engendered, Visvakarman: then the
 Gandharva sprang to life as second.
 Third in succession was the plants’ begetter: he laid the
 waters’ germ in many places.

17.d: न तं वि॑दाथ॒ य इ॒मा ज॒जाना॒न्यद्यु॒ष्माक॒मन्त॑रं बभूव । नी॑हा॒रेण॒ प्रावृ॑ता॒ जल्प्या॑ चासु॒तृप॑ उक्थ॒शास॑श्चरन्ति ।।
17.e:
Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns,
 terrific, stirring up the people,
 With eyes that close not, bellowing, Sole Hero, Indra subdued
 at once a hundred armies.

17.d: वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ ह्यज॑निष्ट दे॒व आदिद्ग॑न्ध॒र्वो अ॑भवद्द्वि॒तीयः॑ । तृ॒तीयः॑ पि॒ता ज॑नितौषधीनाम॒पां गर्भं॒ व्य॑दधात्पुरु॒त्रा ।।
17.e:
With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, Victor, bold, hard to
 overthrow, Rouser of battle,
 Indra the Strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye
 warriors, now, now vanquish in the combat.

17.d: आ॒शुः शिशा॑नो वृष॒भो न भी॒मो घ॑नाघ॒नः क्षोभ॑णश्चर्षणी॒नाम् । सं॒क्रन्द॑नो निमि॒ष ए॑कवी॒रः श॒तँ सेना॑ अजयत्सा॒कमिन्द्रः॑ ।।
17.e:
He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who
 with his band brings hosts together,
 Foe-conquering, strong of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty
 bow, shooting with well-laid arrows.

17.d: सं॒क्रन्द॑नेनानिमि॒षेण॑ जि॒ष्णुना॑ युत्का॒रेण॑ दुश्च्यव॒नेन॑ धृ॒ष्णुना॑ । तदिन्द्रे॑ण जयत॒ तत्स॑हध्वं॒ युधो॑ नर॒ इषु॑हस्तेन॒ वृष्णा॑ ।।
17.e:
Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons,
 driving off our foemen.
 Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle,
 breaker-up of armies.

17.d: स इषु॑हस्तैः॒ स नि॑ष॒ङ्गिभि॑र्व॒शी सँस्र॑ष्टा॒ स युध॒ इन्द्रो॑ ग॒णेन॑ । सँ॑सृष्ट॒जित्सो॑म॒पा बा॑हुश॒र्ध्यु॒ग्रध॑न्वा॒ प्रति॑हिताभि॒रस्ता॑ ।।
17.e:
Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty
 and fierce, victorious, all-subduing,
 The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kine-winner,
 mount thy conquering car, O Indra.

17.d: बृह॑स्पते॒ परि॑ दीया॒ रथे॑न रक्षो॒हामित्रा॑नप॒बाध॑मानः । प्र॑भ॒ञ्जन्त्सेनाः॑ प्रमृ॒णो यु॒धा जय॑न्न॒स्माक॑मेध्यवि॒ता रथा॑नाम् ।।
17.e:
Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells
 an army and with might destroys it,
 Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like
 this Indra show your zeal and courage.

17.d: ब॑लविज्ञा॒य स्थवि॑रः॒ प्रवी॑रः॒ सह॑स्वान्वा॒जी सह॑मान उ॒ग्रः । अ॒भिवी॑रो अ॒भिस॑त्वा सहो॒जा जै॑त्रमिन्द्र॒ रथ॒मा ति॑ष्ठ गो॒वित् ।।
17.e:
Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra, the
 pitiless Hero, wild with anger,
 Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless,—may he protect our
 armies in our battles.

17.d: गो॑त्र॒भिदं॑ गो॒विदं॒ वज्र॑बाहुं॒ जय॑न्त॒मज्म॑ प्रमृ॒णन्त॒मोज॑सा । इ॒मँ स॑जाता॒ अनु॑ वीरयध्व॒मिन्द्रँ॑ सखायो॒ अनु॒ सँ र॑भध्वम् ।।
17.e:
Indra guide these: Brihaspati precede them, the guerdon,
 and the sacrifice, and Soma;
 And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly
 hosts that conquer and demolish.

17.d: अ॒भि गो॒त्राणि॒ सह॑सा॒ गाह॑मानो द॒यो वी॒रः श॒तम॑न्यु॒रिन्द्रः॑ । दु॑श्च्यव॒नः पृ॑तना॒षाड॑यु॒ध्यो॒ स्माकँ॒ सेना॑ अवतु॒ प्र यु॒त्सु ।।
17.e:
Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna, and
 Maruts, and Âdityas.
 Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, high-minded Gods
 who cause the worlds to tremble.

17.d: इन्द्र॑ आसां ने॒ता बृह॒स्पति॒र्दक्षि॑णा य॒ज्ञः पु॒र ए॑तु॒ सोमः॑ । दे॑वसे॒नाना॑मभिभञ्जती॒नां जय॑न्तीनां म॒रुतो॑ य॒न्त्वग्र॑म् ।।
17.e:
Bristle thou up, O Bounteous Lord, our weapons: excite the
 spirits of my warring heroes.
 Urge on the strong steeds’ might, O Vritra-slayer, and let the
 din of conquering cars go upward.

17.d: इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वृष्णो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ राज्ञ॑ आदि॒त्यानां॑ म॒रुताँ॒ शर्ध॑ उ॒ग्रम् । म॒हाम॑नसां भुवनच्य॒वानां॒ घोषो॑ दे॒वानां॒ जय॑ता॒मुद॑स्थात् ।।
17.e:
May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be
 the arrows of our army.
 May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods protect
 us in the shout of onset.

17.d: उद्ध॑र्षय मघव॒न्नायु॑धा॒न्युत्सत्व॑नां माम॒कानां॒ मनाँ॑सि । उद्वृ॑त्रहन्वा॒जिनां॒ वाजि॑ना॒न्युद्रथा॑नां॒ जय॑तां यन्तु॒ घोषाः॑ ।।
17.e:
Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies
 and depart, O Apvâ.
 Attack them, set their hearts on fire and burn them: so let
 our foes abide in utter darkness.

17.d: अ॒स्माक॒मिन्द्रः॒ समृ॑तेषु ध्व॒जेष्व॒स्माकं॒ या इष॑व॒स्ता ज॑यन्तु । अ॒स्माकं॑ वी॒रा उत्त॑रे भवन्त्व॒स्माँ उ॑ देवा अवता॒ हवे॑षु ।।
17.e:
Loosed from the bowstring fly awry, O Arrow, sharpened by
 our prayer.
 Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one of
 them escape.

17.d: अ॒मीषां॑ चि॒त्तं प्र॑तिलो॒भय॑न्ती गृहा॒णाङ्गा॑न्यप्वे॒ परे॑हि । अ॒भि प्रेहि॒ निर्द॑ह हृ॒त्सु शोकै॑र॒न्धेना॒मित्रा॒स्तम॑सा सचन्ताम् ।।
17.e:
Advance, O heroes, win the day. May Indra be your sure
 defence.
 Exceeding mighty be your arms, that none may wound or
 injure you.

17.d: अव॑सृष्टा॒ परा॑ पत॒ शर॑व्ये॒ ब्रह्म॑सँशिते । गच्छा॒मित्रा॒न्प्र प॑द्यस्व॒ मामीषां॒ कं च॒नोच्छि॑षः ।।
17.e:
That army of our enemies, O Maruts, that comes against
 us with its might,
contending
,
 Meet ye and wrap it in unwelcome darkness so that not one
 of them may know another.

17.d: प्रेता॒ जय॑ता नर॒ इन्द्रो॑ वः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु । उ॒ग्रा वः॑ सन्तु बा॒हवो॑ नाधृ॒ष्या यथास॑थ ।।
17.e:
There where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks
 are yet unshorn,
 May Indra, may Brihaspati, may Aditi protect us well, protect
 us well through all our days.

17.d: असौ॒ या सेना॑ मरुतः॒ परे॑षामभ्यैति न॒ ओज॑सा॒ स्पर्ध॑माना । तां गू॑हत॒ तम॒साप॑व्रतेन॒ यथा॒मी अ॒न्यो अ॒न्यं न जा॒नन् ।।
17.e:
Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality
 King Soma clothe thee.
 Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy
 triumph may the Gods be joyful.

17.d: यत्र॑ वाणाः स॒म्पत॑न्ति कुमा॒रा वि॑शि॒खा इ॑व । तत्र॒ इन्द्रो॒ बृह॒स्पति॒रदि॑तिः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु वि॒श्वाहा॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु ।।
17.e:
Worshipped with butter, Agni, lead this man to high
 preeminence.
 Vouchsafe him growth of riches and multiply him with

progeny
.

17.d: मर्मा॑णि ते॒ वर्म॑णा छादयामि॒ सोम॑स्त्वा॒ राजा॒मृते॒नानु॑ वस्ताम् । उ॒रोर्वरी॑यो॒ वरु॑णस्ते कृणोतु॒ जय॑न्तं॒ त्वानु॑ दे॒वा म॑दन्तु ।।
17.e:
Indra, lead him to eminence: controller of his foes be he.
 Vouchsafe him lustre: let him give their sacred portions to
 the Gods.

17.d: उदे॑नमुत्त॒रां न॒याग्ने॑ घृतेनाहुत । रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ रँ सृ॑ज प्र॒जया॑ च ब॒हुं कृ॑धि ।।
17.e:
The man within whose house we pay oblation, Indra, prosper
 him.
 May the Gods bless and comfort him, they and this
 Brahmanaspati.

17.d: इन्द्रे॒मं प्र॑त॒रां न॑य सजा॒ताना॑मसद्व॒शी । समे॑नं॒ वर्च॑सा सृज दे॒वानां॑ भाग॒दा अ॑सत् ।।
17.e:
May the All-Gods, O Agni, bear and lift thee upward with
 their thoughts.
 Fair to be looked on, rich in light, he thou propitious unto
 us.

17.d: यस॑य कु॒र्मो गृ॒हे ह॒विस्तम॑ग्ने वर्धया॒ त्वम् । तस्मै॑ दे॒वा अधि॑ ब्रवन्न॒यं च॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॑ ।।
17.e:
May the Five Regions guard, divine, our worship, Goddesses
 chasing lack of thought and hatred,
 Giving the Sacrificer growth of riches. Let sacrifice be based
 on growth of riches.

17.d: उदु॑ त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अग्ने॑ भरन्तु॒ चित्ति॑भिः । स नो॑ बह्व शि॒वस्त्वँ सु॒प्रती॑को वि॒भाव॑सुः ।।
17.e:
Inspirited above enkindled Agni, adorable, winged with
 hymns, was it accepted,
 When the Gods offered sacrifice with viands, circling the
 heated caldron, paving worship.

17.d: पञ्च॒ दिशो दैवीर्य॒ज्ञम॑वन्तु दे॒वीरपाम॑तिं॒ दुर्म॑तिं॒ बाध॑मानाः । रा॒यस्पोषे॑ य॒ज्ञप॑तिमा॒भज॑न्ती रा॒यस्पोषे॒ अधि॑ य॒ज्ञो अ॑स्थात् ।।
17.e:
Lord of a hundred draughts. benign, God-serving—to him
 divine, establisher, protector,
 The Gods approached the sacrifice, encircling. Gods for the
 Gods stood fain for sacred service.

17.d: समि॑द्धे अ॒ग्नावधि॑ मामहा॒न उ॒क्थप॑त्र॒ ईड्यो॑ गृभी॒तः । त॒प्तं घ॒र्मं प॑रि॒गृह्या॑यजन्तो॒र्जा यद्य॒ज्ञमय॑जन्त दे॒वाः ।।
17.e:
When the fourth sacrifice reaches the oblation, accepted offering
 which hath been made ready, fit for the Inmolator's
 sacrificing,
 Thence bless us prayers and holy recitations!

17.d: दै॑व्याय ध॒र्त्रे जोष्ट्रे॑ देव॒श्रीः श्रीम॑नाः श॒तप॑याः । प॑रि॒गृह्य॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञमा॑यन्दे॒वा दे॒वेभ्यो॑ अध्व॒र्यन्तो॑ अस्थुः ।।
17.e:
Savitar, golden-hued, hath lifted eastward, bright with the
 sunbeams, his eternal lustre,
 He at whose furtherance wise Pûshan marches surveying all
 existence like a herdsman.

17.d: वी॒तँ ह॒विः श॑मि॒तँ श॑मि॒ता य॒जध्यै॑ तु॒रीयो॑ य॒ज्ञो यत्र॑ ह॒व्यमेति॑ । ततो॑ वा॒का आ॒शिषो॑ नो जुषन्ताम् ।।
17.e:
He sits, the measurer, in the midst of heaven, filling the two
 world-halves and air's mid-region.
 He looks upon the rich far-spreading pastures between the
 eastern and the western limit.

17.d: सूर्य॑रश्मि॒र्हरि॑केशः पु॒रस्ता॑त्सवि॒ता ज्योति॒रुद॑याँ॒ अज॑स्रम् । तस्य॑ पू॒षा प्र॑स॒वे या॑ति वि॒द्वान्त्स॒म्पश्य॒न्विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि गो॒पाः ।।
17.e:
Steer, Sea, Red Bird with strong wings, he hath entered the
 dwelling-place of the Primeval Father.
 A gay-hued Stone set in the midst of heaven, he hath gone
 forth and guards the air's two limits.

17.d: वि॒मान॑ ए॒ष दि॒वो मध्य॑ आस्त आपप्रि॒वान्रोद॑सी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । स वि॒श्वाची॑र॒भि च॑ष्टे घृ॒ताची॑रन्त॒रा पूर्व॒मप॑रं च के॒तुम् ।।
17.e:
All sacred songs have glorified Indra expansive as the sea,
 The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the Very Lord
 of strength.

17.d: उ॒क्षा स॑मु॒द्रो अ॑रु॒णः सु॑प॒र्णः पूर्व॑स्य॒ योनिं॑ पि॒तुरा वि॑वेश । मध्ये॑ दि॒वो निहि॑तः॒ पृश्नि॒रश्मा॒ वि च॑क्रमे॒ रज॑सस्पा॒त्यन्तौ॑ ।।
17.e:
May God-invoking sacrifice bring the Gods hitherward to us.
 May bless-invoking sacrifice bring the Gods hitherward to us.
 May Agni, God, make offering and hither bring the Gods to
 us.

17.d: इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिरः॑ । र॒थीत॑मँ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑नाँ॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म् ।।
17.e:
May the abundant growth of wealth with elevation lift me
 up,
 And with his subjugating power may Indra keep my foemen
 down.

17.d: दे॑व॒हूर्य॒ज्ञ आ च॑ वक्षत्सुम्न॒हूर्य॒ज्ञ आ च॑ वक्षत् । यक्ष॑द॒ग्निर्दे॒वो दे॒वाँ आ च॑ वक्षत् ।।
17.e:
Upraising and depression and devotion may the Gods increase.
 May Indra, too, and Agni drive my foes away to every side.

17.d: वज॑स्य मा प्रस॒वे उ॑द्ग्रा॒भेणोद॑ग्रभीत् । अध॑ स॒पत्ना॒निन्द्रो॑ मे निग्रा॒भेणाध॑राँ अकः ।।
17.e:
Go ye by Agni to the sky bearing the Ukhya in your hands.
 Reaching the heights of sky and heaven stay intermingled
 with the Gods.

17.d: उ॑द्ग्रा॒भं च॑ निग्रा॒भं च॒ ब्रह्म॑ दे॒वा अ॑वीवृधन् । अधा॑ स॒पत्ना॑निन्द्रा॒ग्नी मे॑ विषू॒चीना॒न्व्य॑स्यताम् ।।
17.e:
Agni, go forward to the eastern region, well-skilled, be here
 the fire in front of Agni.
 Illuming all the quarters, shine with splendour: supply with
 food our quadrupeds and bipeds.

17.d: क्रम॑ध्वम॒ग्निना॒ नाक॒मुख्यँ॒ हस्ते॑षु॒ बिभ्र॑तः । दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठँ स्व॑र्ग॒त्वा मि॒श्रा दे॒वेभि॑राध्वम् ।।
17.e:
From earth to air's mid-region have I mounted, and from
 mid-air ascended up to heaven.
 From the high pitch of heaven's cope I came into the world
 of light.

17.d: प्राची॒मनु॑ प्र॒दिशं॒ प्रेहि॑ वि॒द्वान॒ग्नेर॑ग्ने पुरोअग्निर्भवे॒ह । विश्वा॒ आशा॒ दीद्या॑नो॒ वि भा॒ह्यूर्जं॑ नो धेहि द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे ।।
17.e:
Mounting the sky they look not round: they rise to heaven
 through both the worlds—
 Sages who span the sacrifice that pours its stream on every side.

17.d: पृ॑थि॒व्या अ॒हमुद॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मारु॑हम॒न्तरि॑क्षा॒द्दिव॒मारु॑हम् । दि॒वो नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठात्स्व॒र्ज्योति॑रगाम॒हम् ।।
17.e:
Foremost of those who seek the Gods come forward, thou
 who art eye of Gods and men, O Agni.
 Accordant with the Bhrigus, fain to worship, to heaven in
 safety go the Sacrificers.

17.d: स्व॒र्यन्तो॒ नापे॑क्षन्त॒ आ द्याँ रो॑हन्ति॒ रोद॑सी । य॒ज्ञं ये वि॒श्वतो॑धारँ॒ सुवि॑द्वाँसो वितेनि॒रे ।।
17.e: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, etc., as in XII. 2.

17.d: अग्ने॒ प्रेहि॑ प्रथ॒मो दे॑वय॒तां चक्षु॑र्दे॒वाना॑मु॒त मर्त्या॑नाम् । इय॑क्षमाणा॒ भृगु॑भिः स॒जोषाः॒ स्व॑र्यन्तु॒ यज॑मानाः स्व॒स्ति ।।
17.e:
O Agni, thousand-eyed and hundred-headed, thy breaths are
 hundred, thy through-breaths a thousand.
 Thou art the Lord of thousandfold possessions. To thee;
 for strength, may we present oblation.

17.d: नक्तो॒षासा॒ सम॑नसा॒ विरू॑पे धा॒पये॑ते॒ शिशु॒मेकँ॑ समी॒ची । द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ रु॒क्मो अ॒न्तर्वि भा॑ति दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाः ।।
17.e:
Thou art the Bird of goodly wing: be seated on the ridge
 of earth.
 Fill air's mid-region with thy glow, supporting with thy
 light the sky, confirm the quarters with thy sheen.

17.d: अग्ने॑ सहस्राक्ष शतमूर्धञ्छ॒तं ते॑ प्रा॒णाः स॒हस्रं॑ व्या॒नाः । त्वँ सा॑ह॒स्रस्य॑ रा॒य ई॑शिषे॒ तस्मै॑ ते विधेम॒ वाजा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
17.e:
Receiving offerings, fair of aspect, eastward be duly seated
 in thy place, O Agni.
 In this the more exalted habitation be seated All-Gods and
 the Sacrificer.

17.d: सु॑प॒र्णो॑ सि ग॒रुन्मा॑न्पृ॒ष्ठे पृ॑थि॒व्याः सी॑द । भा॒सान्तरि॑क्ष॒मा पृ॑ण॒ ज्योति॑षा॒ दिव॒मुत्त॑भान॒ तेज॑सा॒ दिश॒ उद्दृँ॑ह ।।
17.e:
That wondrous all-mankind-embracing favour of Savitar,
 choice-worthy, I solicit,
 Even his which Kanva wont to milk, the mighty, the teeming
 Cow who yields a thousand milk-streams.

17.d: आ॒जुह्वा॑नः सु॒प्रती॑कः पु॒रस्ता॒दग्ने॒ योनि॒मा सी॑द साधु॒या । अ॒स्मिन्त्स॒स्हस्थे॒ अध्युत्त॑रस्मि॒न्विश्वे॑ देवा॒ यज॑मानश्च सीदत ।।
17.e:
May we adore thee in thy loftiest birth place, Agni! with
 praise-songs in thy lower station.
 The place whence those hast issued forth I worship. In thee,
 well kindled, have they paid oblations

17.d: तँ स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यस्य चि॒त्रामाहं वृ॑णे सुम॒तिं वि॒श्वज॑न्याम् । याम॑स्य॒ कण्वो॒ अदु॑ह॒त्प्रपी॑नाँ स॒हस्र॑धारां॒ पय॑सा म॒हीं गाम् ।।
17.e:
Shine thou before us, Agni, well enkindled, with flame, most
 youthful God, that never fadeth.
 Unceasing unto thee come sacred viands.

17.d: वि॒धेम॑ ते पर॒मे जन्म॑न्नग्ने वि॒धेम॒ स्तोमै॒रव॑रे स॒धस्थे॑ । यस्मा॒द्योने॑रु॒दारि॑था॒ यजे॒ तं प्र त्वे ह॒वीँषि॑ जुहुरे॒ समि॑द्धे ।।
17.e: Agni, this day with lands, etc., as in XV. 44.

17.d: प्रेद्धो॑ अग्ने दीदिहि पु॒रो नो ज॑स्रया सू॒र्म्या॑ यविष्ठ । त्वाँ शश्व॑न्त॒ उप॑ यन्ति॒ वाजाः॑ ।।
17.e:
I dedicate the thought with mind and butter so that the
 Gods may come who love oblation, strengthing Law,
 To Visvakarman, Lord of all the earth, I offer up day after
 day the inviolable sacrifice.

17.d: अग्ने॒ तम॒द्याश्वं॒ न स्तोमैः॒ क्रतुं॒ न भ॒द्रँ हृ॑दि॒स्पृश॑म् । ऋ॒ध्यामा॑ त॒ ओहैः॑ ।।
17.e:
Seven fuel logs hast thou, seven tongues, O Agni, seven Rishis
 hast thou, seven belovèd mansions.
 Seven-priests in sevenfold manner pay thee worship. Fill
 full—All-hail to thee!—seven wombs with butter.

17.d: चित्तिं॑ जुहोमि॒ मन॑सा घृ॒तेन॒ यथा॑ दे॒वा इ॒हागम॑न्वी॒तिहो॑त्रा ऋता॒वृधः॑ । पत्ये॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भूम॑नो जु॒होमि॑ वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे वि॒श्वाहादा॑भ्यँ ह॒वि ।।
स॒प्त ते॑ अग्ने स॒मिधः॑ स॒प्त जि॒ह्वाः स॒प्त ऋष॑यः स॒प्त धाम॑ प्रि॒याणि॑ । स॒प्त होत्राः॑ सप्त॒धा त्वा॑ यजन्ति स॒प्त योनी॒रा पृ॑णस्व घृ॒तेन॒ स्वाहा॑ ।।
17.e:
Such, Other-Looking, Equal, Similar, Measured, Commensurate,
 Jointly-Bearing-up.

17.d: शु॒क्रज्यो॑तिश्च चि॒त्रज्यो॑तिश्च स॒त्यज्यो॑तिश्च॒ ज्योति॑ष्माँश्च । शु॒क्रश्च॑ ऋत॒पाश्चात्यँ॑हाः ।।
17.e:
Right, Real, Firm, Strong-to-Support, Bearer, Disposer,
 Manager.

17.d: ई॒दृङ्चा॑न्य॒दृङ्च॑ स॒दृङ्च॒ प्रति॑सदृङ्च । मि॒तश्च॒ संमि॑तश्च॒ सभ॑राः ।।
17.e:
Winner-of-Right, Winner-of-Truth, Host-Conquering,
 Lord-of-Goodly-Host,
 Whose-Friends-are-Near-at-Hand, Whose-Banded-Enemies-are-Far-Away:

17.d: ऋ॒तश्च॑ स॒त्यश्च॑ ध्रु॒वश्च॑ ध॒रुण॑श्च । ध॒र्ता च॑ विध॒र्ता च॑ विधार॒यः ।।
17.e:
To day in this our sacrifice be present, Such, Looking-Thus,
 Same, Similar-in-appearance,
 Measured, Commensurate, Joint-Bearers, Maruts!

17.d: ऋ॑त॒जिच्च॑ सत्य॒जिच्च॑ सेन॒जिच्च॑ सु॒षेण॑श्च । अन्ति॑मित्रश्च दूरेअमित्रश्च ग॒णः ।।
17.e:
Self-Powerful, Voracious-One, Kin-to-the-Sun, The
 House-holder,
 Play-Lover, Mighty, Conqueror.
 Fierce, Terrible, The Resonant, The Roaring. Victorious,
 Assailant, and Dispeller, All-Hail!

17.d: ई॒दृक्षा॑स एता॒दृक्षा॑स ऊ॒ षु णः॑ स॒दृक्षा॑सः॒ प्रति॑सदृक्षास॒ एत॑न । मि॒तास॑श्च॒ संमि॑तासो नो अ॒द्य सभ॑रसो मरुतो य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन् ।।
17.e:
The Maruts, clans divine, became the followers of Indra; as
 The Maruts, clans divine, became the followers of Indra, so
 May clans divine and human he the Sacrificer's followers.

17.d: स्वत॑वाँश्च प्रघा॒सी च॑ सांतप॒नश्च॑ गृहमे॒धी च॑ । क्री॒डी च॑ शा॒की चो॑ज्जे॒षी ।।
17.e:
Drink in the middle of the flood, O Agni, this breast stored
 full of sap, teeming with water.
 Welcome this fountain redolent of sweetness. O Courser,
 enter those thy watery dwelling.

17.d: उ॒ग्रश्च॑ भी॒मश्च॒ ध्वा॑न्तश्च॒ धुनि॑श्च । सा॑स॒ह्वाँश्चा॑भियु॒ग्वा च॑ वि॒क्षिपः॒ स्वाहा॑ । इन्द्रं दैवी॒र्विशो॑ म॒रुतो नु॑वर्त्मानो भव॒न्यथेन्द्रं दैवी॒र्विशो॑ म॒रुतो नु॑वर्त्मा॒नो भ॑वन् । ए॒वमि॒मं यज॑मानं दैवीश्च॒ विशो॑ मानु॒षीश्चानु॑वर्त्मानो भवन्तु ।।
17.e:
Oil hath been mixed: oil is his habitation. In oil he rests:
 oil is his proper province.
 Come as thy wont is. O thou Steer, rejoice thee. Bear off
 the oblation duly consecrated.

17.d: इ॒मँ स्तन॒मूर्ज॑स्वन्तं धया॒पां प्रपी॑नमग्ने सरि॒रस्य॒ मध्ये॑ । उत्सं॑ जुषस्व॒ मधु॑मन्तमर्वन्त्समु॒द्रियँ॒ सद॑न॒मा वि॑शस्व ।।
17.e:
Forth from the ocean sprang the wave of sweetness: together
 with the stalk it turned to Amrit,
 That which is holy oil's mysterious title: but the Gods’
 tongue is truly Amities centre.

17.d: घृ॒तं मि॑मिक्षे घृ॒तम॑स्य॒ योनि॑र्घृ॒ते श्रि॒तो घृ॒तम्व॑स्य॒ धाम॑ । अ॑नुष्व॒धमा व॑ह मा॒दय॑स्व॒ स्वाहा॑कृतं वृषभ वक्षि ह॒व्यम् ।।
17.e:
Let us Declare aloud the name of Ghrita, and at this sacrifice
 held it up with homage.
 So let the Brahman hear the praise we utter. This hath the
 four-horned Buffalo emitted.

17.d: स॑मु॒द्रादू॒र्मिर्मधु॑माँ॒ उदा॑र॒दुपाँ॒शुना॒ सम॑मृत॒त्वमा॑नट् । घृ॒तस्य॒ नाम॒ गुह्यं॒ यदस्ति॑ जि॒ह्वा दे॒वाना॑म॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभिः॑ ।।
17.e:
Four are his horns, three are the feet that bear him: his
 heads are two, his hands are seven in number.
 Bound with a triple bond the Bull roars loudly: the mighty
 God hath entered into mortals.

17.d: व॒यं नाम॒ प्र ब्र॑वामा घृ॒तस्या॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे धा॑रयामा॒ नमो॑भिः । उप॑ ब्र॒ह्मा शृ॑णवच्छ॒स्यमा॑नं॒ चतुः॑शृङ्गो वमीद्गौ॒र ए॒तत् ।।
17.e:
That oil in triple shape the Gods discovered laid down with-
 in the Cow, concealed by Panis.
 Indra produced one shape, Sûrya another: by their own
 power they formed the third from Vena.

17.d: च॒त्वारि॒ शृङ्गा॒ त्रयो॑ अस्य॒ पादा॒ द्वे शी॒र्षे स॒प्त हस्ता॑सो अस्य । त्रिधा॑ ब॒द्धो वृ॑ष॒भो रो॑रवीति म॒हो दे॒वो मर्त्याँ॒ आ वि॑वेश ।।
17.e:
From inmost reservoir in countless channels flow down these
 rivers which the foe beholds not.
 I look upon the streams of oil descending, and lo! the
 Golden Reed is there among them.

17.d: त्रिधा॑ हि॒तं प॒णिभि॑र्गु॒ह्यमा॑नं॒ गवि॑ दे॒वासो॑ घृ॒तमन्व॑विन्दन् । इन्द्र॒ एकँ॒ सूर्य॒ एकं॑ जजान वे॒नादेकँ॑ स्व॒धया॒ निष्ट॑तक्षुः ।।
17.e:
Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves
 in inmost heart and spirit.
 The streams of holy oil pour swiftly downward like the wild
 beasts that fly before the bowman.

17.d: ए॒ता अ॑र्षन्ति॒ हृद्या॑त्समु॒द्राच्छ॒तव्र॑जा रि॒पुणा॒ नाव॒चक्षे॑ । घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि हिर॒ण्ययो॑ वेत॒सो मध्य॑ आसाम् ।।
17.e:
As rushing down the rapids of a river, flow swifter than the
 wind the vigorous currents,
 The streams of oil in swelling fluctuation like a red courser
 bursting through the fences.

17.d: स॒म्यक्स्र॑वन्ति स॒रितो॒ न धेना॑ अ॒न्तर्हृ॒दा मन॑सा पू॒यमा॑नाः । ए॒ते अ॑र्षन्त्यू॒र्मयो॑ घृ॒तस्य॑ मृ॒गा इ॑व क्षिप॒णोरीष॑माणाः ।।
17.e:
Like women at a gathering fair to look on and gently smiling,
 they incline to Agni.
 The streams of holy oil attain the fuel, and Jâtavedas joyfully
 receives them.

17.d: सिन्धो॑रिव प्राध्व॒ने शू॑घ॒नासो॒ वात॑प्रमियः पतयन्ति य॒ह्वाः । घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अरु॒षो न वा॒जी काष्ठा॑ भि॒न्दन्नू॒र्मिभिः॒ पिन्व॑मानः ।।
17.e:
As maidens deck themselves with gay adornment to join the
 bridal feast, I now behold them.
 Where Soma flows and sacrifice is ready, thither the streams
 of holy oil are running.

17.d: अ॒भि प्र॑वन्त॒ सम॑नेव॒ योषाः॑ कल्या॒ण्यः॒ स्मय॑मानासो अ॒ग्निम् । घृ॒तस्य॒ धाराः॑ स॒मिधो॑ नसन्त॒ ता जु॑षा॒णो ह॑र्यति जा॒तवे॑दाः ।।
17.e:
Send to our eulogy a herd of cattle: bestow upon us excellent
 possessions.
 Bear to the Gods the sacrifice we offers the streams of oil flow
 pure and full of sweetness.

17.d: क॒न्या॑ इव वह॒तुमेत॒वा उ॑ अ॒ञ्ज्य॑ञ्जा॒ना अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि । यत्र॒ सोमः॑ सू॒यते॒ यत्र॑ य॒ज्ञो घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि तत्प॑वन्ते ।।
17.e:
The universe depends upon thy power and might within the
 sea, within the heart, within all life.
 May we attain that sweetly-flavoured wave of thine, brought,
 at this gathering, o’er the surface of the floods.

18.d: वज॑श्च मे प्रस॒वश्च॑ मे॒ प्रय॑तिश्च मे॒ प्रसि॑तिश्च मे धी॒तिश्च॑ मे॒ क्रतु॑श्च मे॒ स्वर॑श्च मे॒ श्लोक॑श्च मे श्र॒वश्च॑ मे॒ श्रुति॑श्च मे॒ ज्योति॑श्च मे॒ स्व॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
MAY my strength and my gain, and my inclination and my
 influence, and my thought and my mental power, and
 my praise and my fame, and my renown and my light,
 and my heaven prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: प्रा॒णश्च॑ मे पा॒नश्च॑ मे व्या॒नश्च॒ मे सु॑श्च मे चि॒त्तं च॑ म॒ आधी॑तं च मे॒ वाक्च॑ मे॒ मन॑श्च मे॒ चक्षु॑श्च मे॒ श्रोत्रं॑ च मे॒ दक्ष॑श्च मे॒ बलं॑ च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my breathing and my out-breathing, and my
 through-breathing and my vital spirit, and my thought and my
 reflection, and my voice and my mind, and my eye and
 my ear, and my ability and my strength prosper by
 sacrifice.

18.d: ओज॑स्च मे॒ सह॑श्च म आ॒त्मा च॑ मे त॒नूश्च॑ मे॒ शर्म॑ च मे॒ वर्म॑ च॒ मे ङ्गा॑नि च॒ मे स्था॑नि च मे॒ परूँ॑षि च मे॒ शरी॑राणि च म॒ आयु॑श्च मे ज॒रा च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my energy and my force, and my self and my body,
 and my shelter and my shield, and my limbs and my
 bones, and my joints and my members, and my life and
 my old age prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: ज्यै॑ष्ठ्यं च मे॒ आधि॑पत्यं च मे म॒न्युश्च॑ मे॒ भाम॑श्च॒ मे म॑श्च॒ मे म्भ॑श्च मे महि॒मा च॑ मे वरि॒मा च॑ मे प्रथि॒मा च॑ मे वर्षि॒मा च॑ मे द्राघि॒मा च॑ मे वृ॒द्धं च॑ मे॒ वृद्धि॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my preëminence and my overlordship, and my wrath
 and my angry passion, and my violence and my impetuosity,
 and my victorious power and my greatness, and my
 breadth and my width, and my height and my length,
 and my increase and my improvement prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: स॒त्यं च॑ मे श्र॒द्धा च॑ मे॒ जग॑च्च मे॒ धनं॑ च मे॒ विश्वं॑ च मे॒ मह॑श्च मे क्री॒डा च॑ मे॒ मोद॑श्च मे जा॒तं च॑ मे जनि॒ष्यमा॑णं च मे सू॒क्तं च॑ मे सुकृ॒तं च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my truth and my faith, and my cattle and my wealth,
 and my goods and my pleasure, and my play and my
 enjoyment, and my children and my future children, and
 my hymn and my pious act prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: ऋ॒तं च॒ मे मृतं॑ च॒ मे य॒क्ष्मं च॒ मे ना॑मयच्च मे जी॒वातु॑श्च मे दीर्घायु॒त्वं च॑ मे नमि॒त्रं च॒ मे भ॑यं च मे सु॒खं च॑ मे॒ शय॑नं च मे सु॒षाश्च॑ मे सु॒दिनं॑ च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my religious rite and my immortality, and my freedom
 from consumption and my freedom from disease, and my
 life and my longevity, and my freedom from enemies
 and my freedom from danger, and my happiness and my
 lying down, and my fair dawn and my fair day prosper
 by sacrifice.

18.d: य॒न्ता च॑ मे ध॒र्ता च॑ मे॒ क्षेम॑श्च मे॒ धृति॑श्च मे॒ विश्वं॑ च मे॒ मह॑श्च मे सं॒विच्च॑ मे॒ ज्ञात्रं॑ च मे॒ सूश्च॑ मे प्र॒सूश्च॑ मे॒ सीरं॑ च मे॒ लय॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my controller and my supporter, and my security and
 my firmness, and my goods and my pleasure, and my
 knowledge and my understanding, and my begetting and
 my propagation, and my plough and my harrow prosper
 by sacrifice.

18.d: शं च॑ मे॒ मय॑श्च मे प्रि॒यं च॑ मे नुका॒मश्च॑ मे॒ काम॑श्च मे सौमन॒सश्च॑ मे॒ भग॑श्च मे॒ द्रवि॑णं च मे भ॒द्रं च॑ मे॒ श्रेय॑श्च मे॒ वसी॑यश्च मे॒ यश॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my welfare and my comfort, and what I hold dear and
 what I desire, and my love and my gratification, and my
 enjoyment and my substance, and my happiness and my
 felicity, and my higher bliss and my fame prosper by
 sacrifice.

18.d: ऊर्क्च॑ मे सू॒नृता॑ च मे॒ पय॑श्च मे॒ रस॑श्च मे घृ॒तं च॑ मे॒ मधु॑ च मे॒ सग्धि॑श्च मे॒ सपी॑तिश्च मे कृ॒षिश्च॑ मे॒ वृष्टि॑श्च मे जैत्रं च म औद्भिद्यं च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my vigour and my pleasantness, and my milk and my
 sap, and my butter and my honey, and my meal in company
 and my drinking in company, and my ploughing
 and my husbandry, and my superiority and my preëminence
 prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: र॒यिश्च॑ मे॒ राय॑श्च मे पु॒ष्टं च॑ मे॒ पुष्टि॑श्च मे वि॒भु च॑ मे प्र॒भु च॑ मे पू॒र्णं च॑ मे पू॒र्णत॑रं च मे॒ कुय॑वं च॒ मे क्षि॑तं च॒ मे न्नं॑ च॒ मे क्षु॑च्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my wealth and my property, and my prosperity and
 my growth, and my pervading power and my lordship,
 and my abundance and my greater abundance, and my
 bad harvest and my unwasted crop, and my food and
 my satiety prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: वि॒त्तं च॑ मे॒ वेद्यं॑ च मे भू॒तं च॑ मे भवि॒ष्यच्च॑ मे सु॒गं च॑ मे सुप॒थ्यं॑ च म ऋ॒द्धं च॑ म॒ ऋद्धि॑श्च मे॒ क्ळ्प्तं च॑ मे क्े६प्ति॑श्च मे म॒तिश्च॑ मे सुम॒तिश्च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my gain and my future gain, and what I have and
 what I shall have, and my good road and my good path,
 and my success and my succeeding, and my achievement
 and my contrivance, and my thought and my good counsel
 prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: व्री॒हय॑श्च मे॒ यवा॑श्च मे॒ माषा॑श्च मे॒ तिला॑श्च मे मु॒द्राश्च॑ मे॒ खल्वा॑श्च मे प्रि॒यङ्ग॑वश्च॒ मे ण॑वश्च मे श्या॒माका॑श्च मे नी॒वारा॑श्च मे गो॒धूमा॑श्च मे म॒सूरा॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my rice-plants and my barley, and my beans and my
 sesamum, and my kidney-beans and my vetches, and my
 millet and my Panicum Milliaceum, and my Panicum
 Frumentaceum and my wild rice, and my wheat and my
 lentils prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: अश्मा॑ च मे॒ मृत्ति॑का च मे गि॒रय॑श्च मे॒ पर्व॑ताश्च मे॒ सिक॑ताश्च मे॒ वन॒स्पत॑यश्च मे॒ हिर॑ण्यं च॒ मे य॑श्च मे श्या॒मं च॑ मे लो॒हं च॑ मे॒ सीसं॑ च मे॒ त्रपु॑ च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my stone and my clay, and my hills and my mountains,
 and my pebbles and my trees, and my gold and my bronze,
 and my copper and my iron, and my lead and my tin
 prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: अ॒ग्निश्च॑ म॒ आप॑श्च मे वी॒रुध॑श्च म॒ ओष॑धयश्च मे कृष्टप॒च्याश्च॑ मे कृष्टप॒च्याश्च॑ मे ग्रा॒म्याश्च॑ मे प॒शव॑ आर॒ण्याश्च॑ मे वि॒त्तं च॑ मे॒ वित्ति॑श्च मे भू॒तं च॑ मे॒ भूति॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my fire and my water, and my creepers and my plants,
 and lily plants with culture-ripened fruit and my plants
 with fruit ripened without culture, and my domestic
 animals and my wild animals, and my substance and my
 future substance, and my belongings and my power be
 produced by sacrifice.

18.d: वसु॑ च मे वस॒तिश्च॑ मे॒ कर्म॑ च मे॒ शक्ति॑श्च॒ मे र्थ॑श्च म॒ एम॑श्च म इ॒त्या च॑ मे॒ गति॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my treasure and my dwelling, and my religious service
 and my ability to perform it, and my object and my
 course, and my way and my going prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: अ॒ग्निश्च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ सोम॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे सवि॒ता च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ सर॑स्वती च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे पू॒षा च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ बृह॒स्पति॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my Agni and my Indra, and my Soma and my Indra,
 and my Savitar and my Indra, and my Sarasvatî and my
 Indra, and my Pûshan and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: मि॒त्रश्च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ वरु॑णश्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे धा॒ता च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ त्वष्टा॑ च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे म॒रुत॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ विश्वे॑ च मे दे॒वा इन्द्र॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my Mitra and my Indra, and my Varuna and my Indra,
 and my Dhâtar and my Indra, and my Maruts and my
 Indra, and my All-Gods and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च॒ मे न्तरि॑क्षं च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे द्यौश्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ समा॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ नक्ष॑त्राणि च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ दिश॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my earth and my Indra, and my Air and my Indra,
 and my Sky and my Indra, and my Half-months and my
 Indra, and my Lunar Mansions and my Indra, and my
 Sky-regions and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: अँ॒शुश्च॑ मे र॒श्मिश्च॒ मे दा॑भ्यश्च॒ मे धि॑पतिश्च म उपाँ॒शुश्च॑ मे न्तर्या॒मश्च॑ म ऐन्द्रवायश्च॑ मे मैत्रावरु॒णश्च॑ म आश्वि॒नश्च॑ मे प्रतिप्र॒स्थान॑श्च मे शु॒क्रश्च॑ मे म॒न्थी च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my Amsu and my Rasmi, and my Adhipati and my
 Upâmsu, and my Antaryâma and my Aindra-Vâyava, and
 my Maitrâ-Varuna, and my Âsvina and my Pratiprasthâna,
 and my Sukra and my Manthin proper by sacrifice.

18.d: आ॑ग्रया॒णश्च॑ मे वैश्वदे॒वश्च॑ मे ध्रु॒वश्च॑ मे वैश्वान॒रश्च॑ म ऐन्द्रा॒ग्नश्च॑ मे म॒हावै॑श�श्च मे मरुत्व॒तीया॑श्च मे॒ निष्के॑वल्यश्च मे सावि॒त्रश्च॑ मे सारस्व॒तश्च॑ मे पत्नीव॒तश्च॑ मे हारियओज॒नश्च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my Âgrayana and my Vaisvadeva, and my
Dhruvâ
 and
 my Vaisvânara, and my Aindrâgna and my Mahâvaisvadeva,
 and my Marutvatîya and my Nishkevalya, and my Sâvitra
 and my Sârasvata, and my Pâtnîvata and my Hâriyojana
 prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: स्रुच॑श्च मे चम॒साश्च॑ मे वाय॒व्या॑नि च मे द्रोणकल॒शश्च॑ मे॒ ग्रावा॑णश्च मे धि॒षव॑णे च मे पूत॒भृच्च॑ म आधव॒नीय॑श्च मे॒ वेदि॑श्च मे ब॒र्हिश्च॑ मे वभृ॒तश्च॑ मे स्वगाका॒रश्च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my ladles and my cups, and my Vâyu, vessels and my
 Soma reservoirs, and my pressing-stones and my two press-boards,
 and my Pûtabhrit and my Âdhavanîya, and my
 altar and altar-grass, and my Avabhritha and my cries of
 Good-speed prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: अ॒ग्निश्च॑ मे घ॒र्मश्च॑ मे॒ र्कश्च॑ मे॒ सूर्य॑श्च मे प्रा॒णश्च॑ मे स्वमे॒धश्च॑ मे पृथि॒वी च॒ मे दि॑तिश्च मे॒ दिति॑श्च मे द्यौश्च मे॒ ङ्गुल॑यः॒ शक्व॑रयो॒ दिश॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my Agni and my charms, and my Arka and my Sûrya,
 and my Prâna and my Asvamedha, and my Prithivî and
 my Aditi, and my Diti and my Sky, and my fingers, powers,
 and sky-regions prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: व्र॒तं च॑ म ऋ॒तव॑श्च मे॒ तप॑श्च मे संवत्स॒रश्च॑ मे होरा॒त्रे ऊ॑र्वष्ठी॒वे बृ॑हद्रथन्त॒रे च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my vow and my seasons, and my austere devotion, and
 my day and night, thighs and knees, and two Great
 Rathantaras prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: एका॑ च मे ति॒स्रश्च॑ मे ति॒स्रश्च॑ मे॒ पञ्च॑ च मे॒ पञ्च॑ च मे स॒प्त च॑ मे स॒प्त च॑ मे॒ नव॑ च मे॒ नव॑ च म॒ एका॑दश च म॒ एका॑दश च मे॒ त्रयो॑दश च मे॒ त्रयो॑दश च मे॒ पञ्च॑दश च मे॒ पञ्च॑दश च मे स॒प्तद॑श च मे श॒प्तद॑श च मे॒ नव॑दश च मे॒ नव॑दश च म॒ एक॑विँशतिश्च म॒ एक॑विँशतिश्च मे॒ त्रयो॑विँशतिश्च मे॒ त्रयो॑विँशतिश्च मे॒ पञ्च॑विँशतिश्च मे॒ पञ्च॑विँशतिश्च मे स॒प्तविँ॑�श्च मे स॒प्तविँ॑शतिश्च मे॒ नव॑विँशतिश्च मे॒ नव॑विँशतिश्च म॒ एक॑त्रिँशच्च म॒ एक॑त्रिँशच्च मे॒ त्रय॑स्त्रिँशच्च मे॒ त्रय॑स्त्रिँशच्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May me One and my Three, and my Three and my Five,
 and my Five and my Seven (and similarly up to thirty-three)
 prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: चत॑स्रश्च मे ष्टौ च मे ष्टौ च मे॒ द्वाद॑श च मे॒ द्वाद॑श च मे॒ षोड॑श च मे॒ षोड॑श च मे विँश॒तिश्च॑ मे विँशतिश्च मे॒ चतु॑र्विँशतिश्च मे॒ चतु॑र्विँश॒तिश्च॑ मे॒ ष्टाविँ॑शतिश्च मे॒ ष्टाविँ॑�श्च मे॒ द्वात्रिँ॑शच्च मे॒ द्वात्रिँ॑शच्च मे॒ षट्त्रिँ॑शच्च मे॒ षट्त्रिँ॑शच्च मे चत्वारिँ॒शच्च॑ मे चत्वारिँ॒शच्च॑ मे॒ चतु॑श्चत्वारिँशच्च मे॒ चतु॑श्चत्वारिँशच्च मे॒ ष्टाच॑त्वारिँशच्च मे॒ ष्टाच॑त्वारिँशच्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my Four and my Eight and my Twelve (and similarly
 up to forty-eight) prosper by sacrifice

18.d: त्र्यवि॑श्च मे त्र्य॒वी च॑ मे दित्य॒वाट्च॑ मे दित्यौ॒ही च॑ मे पञ्चा॒विश्च॑ मे पञ्चा॒वी च॑ मे त्रिव॒त्सश्च॑ मे त्रिव॒त्सा च॑ मे तुर्य॒वाट्च॑ मे तुर्यौ॒ही च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my eighteen-months steer and my eighteen-months
 heifer, and my two-year bull and cow (and similarly up
 to four-year) prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: प॑ष्ठ॒वाट्च॑ मे पष्ठौ॒ही च॑ म उ॒क्षा च॑ मे व॒शा च॑ म ऋष॒भश्च॑ मे वे॒हच्च॑ मे न॒ड्वाँश्च॑ मे धे॒नुश्च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ।।
18.e:
May my six-year bull and my six-year cow, and my bull and
 my barren cow, and my young bull and my calf-slipping
 cow, and my ox and my milch-cow prosper by sacrifice.

18.d: वाजा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ प्रस॒वाय॒ स्वाहा॑पि॒जाय॒ स्वाहा॒ क्रत॑वे॒ स्वाहा॒ वस॑वे॒ स्वाहा॑ह॒र्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहाह्ने॒ स्वाहा॑ मु॒ग्धाय॒ स्वाहा॑ मु॒ग्धाय॑ वैनँशि॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॑विनँ॒शिन॑ आन्त्याय॒नाय॒ स्वाहान्त्या॑य भौव॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ पत॑ये॒ स्वाहाधि॑पतये॒ स्वाहा॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॑ । इ॒यं ते॒ राण्मि॒त्राय॑ य॒न्तासि॒ यम॑न ऊ॒र्जे त्वा॒ वृष्ट्यै॑ त्वा प्र॒जानां॒ त्वाधि॑पत्याय ।।
18.e:
To strength, Hail! To Gain, Hail! To After-born, Hail! To
 Power, Hail! To Vasu, Hail! To the Lord of Days, Hail!
 To the Failing Day, Hail! To the Failing Sprung from
 the Transitory, Hail! To the Transitory sprung from the
 Final, Hail! To the Final Mundane, Hail! To the Lord
 of the World, Hail! To the Sovran Lord, Hail! To Prajâpati,
 Hail! This is thy kingdom. Thou art a guiding controller
 for the friend. Thee for vigour, thee for rain,
 thee for the sovran lordship of creatures.

18.d: आयु॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां प्रा॒णो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ चक्षु॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पताँ॒ श्रोत्रं॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ वाग्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ मनो॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतामा॒त्मा य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां ब्र॒ह्मा य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ ज्योति॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पताँ॒ स्व॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां पृ॒ष्ठं य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां य॒ज्ञो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पताम् । स्तोम॑श्च य्श्च॒ ऋक्च॒ साम॑ च बृ॒हच्च॑ रथन्त॒रं च॑ । स्व॑र्देवा अगन्मा॒मृता॑ अभूम प्र॒जाप॑तेः प्र॒जा अ॑भूम॒ वेट्स्वाहा॑ ।।
18.e:
May life succeed through sacrifice. May life-breath thrive
 by sacrifice. May the eye thrive by sacrifice. May the
 ear thrive by sacrifice. May the voice thrive by sacrifice.
 May the mind thrive by sacrifice. May the self thrive by
 sacrifice. May Brahma thrive by sacrifice. May light
 succeed by sacrifice. May heaven succeed by sacrifice.
 May the hymn thrive by sacrifice. May sacrifice thrive
 by sacrifice; And laud and sacrificial text, and verse of
 praise and Sâma chant, The Brihat and Rathantara.

Gods, we have gone to light. We have become the children
 of Prajâpati. We have become immortal.

18.d: वाज॑स्य॒ नु प्र॑स॒वे मा॒तरं॑ म॒हीमदि॑तिं॒ नाम॒ वच॑सा करामहे । यस्या॑मि॒दं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नमावि॒वेश॒ तस्यां॑ नो दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता धर्म॑ साविषत् ।।
18.e: In gain of wealth we celebrate, etc: = IX. 5.
